labels: Use an air current to slow Paige down!
Throw food in each other's mouths!
The intricacies of high school life.

options.label: Episode Five: Paige and Owen's Valentine's Outing

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's... That's exactly what people say to someone when it `is` their fault.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... That's exactly what people say to someone when it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] their fault.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I could have run faster, pushed you guys harder, passed even fancier!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's really nothing I can say to make you think otherwise, is there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm afraid that ship has sailed, Benjamin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Everyone's?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure. We all practice together, Erik. It's as much your responsibility to get us prepared for games as it is everyone else's.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! When you think about it like that, we're all stars of the team!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pigs in a blanket! That cheers me up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So then, you're going to be ready for practice?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am now!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Cool. I'll see you then.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Benjamin! You really pulled me out of a dark place!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Something tells me you don't really have any dark places, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just my armpits!
After trying to rally all the other guys on the team, Ben heads to the library to find Erik.
He finally finds him sitting in a quiet corner, painting a small figurine with black paint.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey there, Benjamin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who's the figurine?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is Derek, my Ogres 'N' Elves character. His army was recently obliterated in the Glen of Willows.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't save any of them!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Pretty dark, Erik. You seem... Pretty chipper, considering this... And the basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you mean, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, all the other guys are feeling pretty down after our loss to Willow Glen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I don't know if I've ever felt this depressed in my whole life!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you seem so cheerful...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On the outside, maybe. But on the inside, I feel like I'm falling into a chasm of depression!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't help but feel like the loss was all my fault!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your fault? But Erik, you spent most of the game on the bench!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know, but there are a lot of things I do for the team to prepare for games.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I'm not playing my best against you guys in practice, you won't be ready for the guys you play against in the games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I assure you, we were as ready as we could have been.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige? I thought for sure if you were to pick one, it'd be $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not about me, it's about who `you` love. And even though it's love-hate with Paige, it's still `love.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not about me, it's about who [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] love. And even though it's love-hate with Paige, it's still [color=#e23b3b][i]love.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Even thinking about making a choice seems... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well you're going to have to choose because the longer you wait, the more likely you're going to hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But avoiding hurting one of them is no reason to rush into a choice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, don't listen to me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't! Because it doesn't seem like good advice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I give up then! See you at practice!
Ben stands up and marches off!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I figured you'd pick $ZOE. You two are pretty good friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, there are times to pick a side and there are times not to...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But when it comes to Paige vs. $ZOE, I'm always going to pick $ZOE. Paige is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Paige is what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'll just say that you're right when you say that $ZOE is really nice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Even thinking about making a choice seems... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well you're going to have to choose because the longer you wait, the more likely you're going to hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But avoiding hurting one of them is no reason to rush into a choice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, don't listen to me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't! Because it doesn't seem like good advice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I give up then! See you at practice!
Ben stands up and marches off!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A distraction? You're not going to tell me to take up a hobby, are you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No. It's pretty simple, actually...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't know what you want right now, and you shouldn't force it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if it's on my mind?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's where a distraction comes in. You need something to keep you from going crazy. Just like how weightlifting helps take your mind off of whatever's upsetting you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And as self-serving as this seems...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you wanted something to take your mind off the girls long-term, basketball's probably your best bet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! Another case solved by Ben Kale, detective, girl division.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Better title.
Ben stands and heads off to class.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See you at practice?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... I'll see you there!
Owen takes a quick break, and then resumes lifting again...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: With Paige, it's like every time I'm around her, I'm annoyed. She antagonizes me to no end.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's like I want to kiss her and kill her all at the same time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Classic love-hate relationship.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: On the other hand, $ZOE's like the nicest person who's ever existed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Understatement. I heard she's even helping Autumn with that Art Showcase thing...
Owen can barely lift the weight at all, so Ben lifts it up onto the rack for him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What would you do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I were in your shoes, I'd...

nodes.prompt: If I were in your shoes, I'd...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If I were in your shoes, I'd...

nodes.text: Ben helps Owen lift the weight.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Consider yourself `spotted!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Consider yourself [color=#e23b3b][i]spotted![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben doesn't notice Owen struggling...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Owen? You were going to tell me what's got you confused...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Little! Help! Here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh!
Ben lifts the weight up for Owen...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...
After a short walk, Ben finds Owen in the weight room, lifting weights.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Ben... Don't see you in here often. You here to lift?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm here to talk to you, actually!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you're going to have to spot me while you talk. When I'm upset, I workout, and nothing prevents me from doing that.
Owen gets into position for a bench press. Ben is still standing in front of Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You need to get behind me. Over here.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, right, of course. I just didn't know what spotting school you subscribed to.
Ben gets into position behind Owen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... Spotting... Do I just, like, tell you that you're doing good? Or make recommendations on your technique?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. No... If I'm struggling with the weight, you help me lift it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, right. I knew that.
Ben holds his hands out under the bar as Owen lifts it off the rack.
Owen begins pumping the weight.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... You're upset, eh?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If it's about the game, let me tell you, `I'm focused!` We are going to beat Wilson High!
nodes.text_bbcode: If it's about the game, let me tell you, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm focused![/i][/color] We are going to beat Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not it. It's about Paige and $ZOE.
Owen's lifting speed slows.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well say no more!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ben Kale, girl detective, at your service!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You realize that 'girl detective' could mean that you are a girl who is a detective, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The name's in beta, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now... Tell me what's got you confused!
Owen's arms shake as he tries to talk... His elbows wobble! The weight sinks!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Little help?!
Ben tries to leap over Spencer!
But Spencer grabs him out of the air and slams him into the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You really thought you could jump over `me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You really thought you could jump over [color=#e23b3b][i]me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I see the ridiculousness of that idea `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I see the ridiculousness of that idea [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You couldn't get by me... That means get off my field. I've got football to prepare for.
Ben slowly gets up and trudges his way back to the school...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See you at practice...
Ben stops, his eyes going wide!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dude, what happened to your shoes?!
Spencer stops and looks at them!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My shoes?! What's wrong with them? Did--
Ben breaks away from Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You tricked me!
Spencer races after him and dives into the air for the tackle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So fast!
Ben leaps forward for the end zone just as Spencer grabs onto his leg!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoop!
Ben falls to the ground, but has just enough energy to stretch the ball out over the goal line!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I should have known you'd pull a dirty trick like that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was the only way!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well, a deal's a deal. I'll be at practice, and I'll be ready.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good.
Ben dusts himself off and immediately heads back toward the school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're not the only guy on the team, remember?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear, Kale!
Ben hesitates... And Spencer slams right into him, knocking him to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You really thought you could get by `me?!`

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Basketball isn't over, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seems pretty over to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We only lost by two points! We can beat Wilson High.
Spencer slams into the dummy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah? After we lost to Willow Glen, what did we care about most? A dumb dance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You were there with us!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not happy about my behavior either.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you're upset because we didn't seem to care?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not upset! I'm just being real.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've been on a championship team! Do you know what happens when the football team loses a game?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We spend time together. We practice. We get focused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're having basketball practice today!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But are we together? Are we focused? Where's Owen? Where's Andy? Where's Jacob? Where's Nerd?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean Erik?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. We're not together, man! Practice is going to suck, and we're going to lose our game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, what? You're just skipping ahead to football?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: At least I'm getting a head start...
Ben picks up a football from a nearby bin. As Spencer gets into position, Ben stands between him and the dummy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! If you're going to be out here, then I'm going to be out here with you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Move!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine! You want to play football? Let's play football!
Spencer walks over to the end zone and stands on the goal line.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on! Bring it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get by me! Score a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And if I do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You won't! But if you do, then I won't give up on basketball.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... I need to score a touchdown... To save basketball?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just shut up and try to get by me so I can tackle you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer's the star linebacker... There's no way I can get by him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unless...
Ben starts running toward Spencer, who gets down in a fearsome defensive stance.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr!
As Ben nears him, Spencer surges forward!
Just as Spencer's about to tackle Ben, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pfft! Get your head out of your butt, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've still got one game left.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Which we're going to lose. Stick a fork in us. We're done.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How? How will that happen?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're upset because Willow Glen beat us. I get it. But if we beat Wilson High in our next game, we'll get a chance to play Willow Glen in Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll get our chance for revenge, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I like the idea, but you're dreaming.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I'm not.
Then he stops and turns back, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Colt wasn't doing anything wrong two nights ago. I was just having fun with you.
He leaves.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great. Now I'm actually worried.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What a peculiar guy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Pot. Kettle. Black. Come on! You're the poster girl for peculiar!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Guilty as charged.
You are now playing as Ben...
Ben finds Spencer on the football field, lining up in front of a tackling dummy.
Spencer gets down low, growls, and explodes forward! His body slams into the dummy with a loud `whomp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer gets down low, growls, and explodes forward! His body slams into the dummy with a loud [b]whomp![/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing out here, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was going to ask you the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's it look like?
Spencer explodes forward again, knocking the dummy backwards.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It looks like you're practicing for football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's why you get straight A's.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think you could stop for a moment?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is stupid, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I don't get straight A's, so everyone's doing as expected.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I mean, why are you practicing for football? The season's over!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What else do I have to look forward to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can look forward to...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're a book, all right, but you're more like a collection of sad ballads.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Uh... That's...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow, I've never seen you speechless before.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ahem. I just, uh, had something in my throat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: In case you're wondering how I did that? It's a talent.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I wasn't wondering.
Wes winks at Autumn and walks away...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Bored? You think I'm bored doing what I do?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You haven't lived until you've pulled the kind of strings I've pulled.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Like what? Give me one example of something exciting you've done.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, I got one. Last year, I got a school I `didn't go to` to pay me money to test their new security system.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I got one. Last year, I got a school I [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't go to[/i][/color] to pay me money to test their new security system.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Which they installed because of a series of false reports `I` filed about suspicious activity on campus!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which they installed because of a series of false reports [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] filed about suspicious activity on campus!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That all sounds like something you can do from your computer.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I didn't tell you the best part!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: After they installed the security system, I went with a rival to the school to steal some stupid thing I made up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I had already alerted the police to his presence, telling them that he was the suspicious person, and that I'd be `working undercover.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I had already alerted the police to his presence, telling them that he was the suspicious person, and that I'd be [color=#e23b3b][i]working undercover.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: As soon as the alarm tripped, they nabbed him, and gave me a reward for the tip.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Most of that sounds despicable.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ah, but you don't have all the facts. You don't know what he'd done to become my rival.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: True... And I guess it does sound pretty exciting.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's okay. Not everyone's as talented as I am.
He winks at Autumn and walks away.
Wes slips in through the front doors.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Denni! How's the Art Showcase promo going?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Should I even bother asking how you knew what we were doing?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No, that would be a total waste of your time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But for just twenty bucks, I'll tell you what Colt was up to two nights ago.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And that's some info you may find worth your while.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll pass. Colt and I have a little thing called `trust` between us.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll pass. Colt and I have a little thing called [color=#3b78e2][i]trust[/i][/color] between us.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Trust. Blindness. Stupidity. It goes by so many names.
Wes notices Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hello.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's no point in me saying this, but Wes, this is--

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Autumn, the freshman artist...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You prefer using watercolors when you paint, but your real passion is photography...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Even though it goes against every fiber of your being, you enjoy pop music.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, and you broke your arm a long time ago in a nasty fall down some stairs.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Neat trick. I'm impressed.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's a talent.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: My turn.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `You're` going to read `me?` I'm afraid that can't be done. I'm a book written in a language no one knows.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] going to read [color=#e23b3b][i]me?[/i][/color] I'm afraid that can't be done. I'm a book written in a language no one knows.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're Wes. The guy who gets things. Always conniving, always looking for the angle.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No secret.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But no one knows your past, which you will do anything and everything to hide.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Easy enough.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: When I look at you, I see past this facade of confidence. I see a guy who's hiding just how...

nodes.prompt: I see a guy who's hiding just how...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I see a guy who's hiding just how...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Very sloppy. A collection of teeth `is` teeth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Very sloppy. A collection of teeth [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] teeth!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The only possible difference is that a collection might indicate that the teeth are loose, outside of any mouth.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And teeth are always better when they're in your mouth. Conclusion... Best case scenario is you're less wrong!
Andrew rushes past them in a huff.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: He gets like this sometimes. By sometimes I mean everyday.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Life of the artist... Always wear a thick skin!
Kevin and Ashley nod and walk away.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I see you have a flair for metaphor. I always tip my proverbial cap to a fellow bard.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A pleasure.
Andrew takes a flyer, and the nerds walk away.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A painting is a what?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: An endless nothingness?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sloppy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A tooth collection?
A moment later, a couple of nerds stumble through the door...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come to the Art Showcase! Have a flyer!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Thanks! I love these kind of events!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'll be there!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Pfft! I won't. Why look at a bunch of paintings and photos when you can imagine them with words, the greatest medium of art known to man?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: After all, the word is to painting as a giant flat-screen TV is to a cardboard box.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I disagree. Words are mere teeth. But a painting is a...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, yeah, of course we care about how they look! But we only want them to look like they'll go fast!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Or hug a corner!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Or last for years!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're more concerned about the function than the form?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How presumptuous of me to think you overvalued aesthetics!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Huh?
Denni whispers to Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You've got the right idea, but you're not working on the right level. Allow me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ryan, how would you feel if I colored your motorcycle hot pink?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What?! No! Walter isn't a girl bike!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or Kenji, what if I painted yours with glitter!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'd... I'd look weak!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or Megan...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I get it. Colors matter.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh! Colors are art? Why didn't you just say so in the first place?!
They take some flyers and leave.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wow... I really gave them too much credit.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh... Well, yeah. You have to have a good ink-man.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Or ink-woman.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Or tattoo `artist.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or tattoo [color=#3b78e2][i]artist.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! Good point! Artist is in the name! I guess art `is` important to us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! Good point! Artist is in the name! I guess art [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] important to us!

nodes.text: As the rebels take their flyers and leave, Autumn makes an off-handed remark to Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You got awfully quiet when the subject of tattoos came up. Something you're not telling us?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Heh. Let's just say I don't have any `visible` tattoos.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Let's just say I don't have any [color=#e23b3b][i]visible[/i][/color] tattoos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I see. It'll be our secret.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't you think you've done enough to impress my dad, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not at all. We lost one game, and he started doubting whether I can operate a stopwatch!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Does it really matter so much whether he likes you or not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, when he thought I was a winner, I ate a Thanksgiving meal at your house, `and` I got the chance to spend more time with you at practice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, when he thought I was a winner, I ate a Thanksgiving meal at your house, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] I got the chance to spend more time with you at practice.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I did like that this morning...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did too. And until we've got a better idea, the best way for me to be in his good graces is to win.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ugh. It's so stupid.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Them's the breaks, kid. Now... My team needs me.
Ben gives her a quick kiss and hurries off around the corner...
...And slams into a table near the school's doors. He falls to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: An artistic-looking girl helps him up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'd say... Watch where you're going, but that's dumb advice. Aren't we all watching where we're going?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So instead, I'll say I'm sorry we put this table where you were running!
The girl sits back down behind the table next to Denni!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Ben! Nasty fall! You all right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm okay. What's all this for?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Autumn's Art Showcase!
Autumn hands Ben a flyer.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You'll never have a more mystical experience!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Then, I guess I'll be there. It was nice running into you, Autumn!
Ben carefully exits through the school doors toward the Twin Branches football field.
You are now playing as freshman hipster, Autumn...
As students head into the school, Autumn and Denni hand out ornately colored flyers for the Art Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Pretty cool of $ZOE to help put this together. Won't it be awesome to have a bunch of people come to the Showcase?!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It will! It increases the odds of me finding that special someone!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow. Look at you, Miss On-The-Prowl!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't mean it that way. I just meant that the more people who come, the more likely `one` of them will be inspired by my work!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I didn't mean it that way. I just meant that the more people who come, the more likely [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] of them will be inspired by my work!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I find the connection between artist and viewer to be my principal motivation!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? With writing, I'm just happy when someone actually `reads` an article I've written.
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? With writing, I'm just happy when someone actually [color=#3b78e2][i]reads[/i][/color] an article I've written.

nodes.text: Ryan, Megan, and Kenji walk in.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Art Showcase! Here's a flyer! Check it out!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Art? I'd rather drive a hybrid tractor than look at art!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'd rather join the cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Same here! If I had to choose between staring at some kooky artist's idea of art or wearing a cheerleading skirt, I'd pick the skirt.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You do have the legs for it, Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! Ha! She got you!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I get it. Art is boring. Art is some stuffy thing pretentious people do to make themselves feel more important than they actually are.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But what if I told you that art is important to you?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'd say you've inhaled too much exhaust.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Ditto.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So then, you don't care how your...

nodes.prompt: So then, you don't care how your...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: So then, you don't care how your...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Funky? That doesn't sound like my dad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, as soon as I said it, I knew it wasn't going to fly...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't imagine your dad telling anyone to be funky... Unless they had a soul patch.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben! How about you focus on what's important?! Like why you lied to me just now?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry... I... I saw how upset you got when I mentioned your dad, and I kinda freaked out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He told me what you just told me... That I had to focus. Like father, like daughter, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He said that the team gets its energy from me. That if I'm focused, they'll be focused.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's... Actually pretty good advice.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See? Swimsuit... Unbunched.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sometimes I forget that my dad can be a pretty good teacher.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean, when he's not being a--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll go ahead and stop you there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good call.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Should... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Should, uh, be... Something. Funky, maybe?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Of course I did! You heard how he lost the basketball game! I couldn't risk him being incompetent in case you set a record time...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Which you did!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What? I did?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yup! You did it, sweetie!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She did? That's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Can it, Ben! If I'd trusted you, we never would have known.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Frankly, my confidence in you is waning!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll... I'll earn it back. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Pretty good. I clocked you at, uh, 43.5 seconds.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! I could have sworn I was swimming faster than that!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's because you were!
Coach Kessler pulls a stopwatch out of his pocket that's showing a much faster time!
Emily pops her head over the pool's edge.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How'd I do?
The timer stops!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got that right!
The timer's still running!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oops! Wrong button!
Ben quickly presses the start-stop button!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope they don't notice!
Ben hesitates, forgetting which button to press!
He closes his eyes and picks one at random!
When he opens his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Now listen, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You probably don't realize what it is you have to do for your team...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Shoot better?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This is not the time for jokes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right. 'Cause that's what I was doing... Joking.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You've never really been a sports guy. I know that.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But right now, you `are` the leader of the basketball team.
nodes.text_bbcode: But right now, you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] the leader of the basketball team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Whether you want to be or not.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you don't care, your team doesn't care. You set their mood. You set the tone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I care, Coach.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then do something about it! You've got a must-win game coming up against Wilson High... Your last chance to make Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you don't win, the season's over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And once again I'll be an unambitious loser to you...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You should be focused! You need to rally the team together for this game! Otherwise, you've got no chance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've never been the leader of anything...
Just then, Emily finishes her last lap, touching the near wall!
Ben presses the...
The timer stops running!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Something the matter?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Ben frantically presses the start-stop button, then the lap button, and then the start-stop button again!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I, uh... Just remembered a homework assignment I forgot to do.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You shouldn't be doing this if it's going to interfere with your schoolwork!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, sir. It's not going to be a problem. I swear!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope no one notices my mistake!
The timer saves Emily's lap time, but keeps counting!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow! She's swimming at a remarkable pace!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yes, she is!
Ben hesitates, unsure of which button to press!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Eeny, meeny, miney... Moe!
Emily dives into the pool, knifing through the water at top speed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow! She's so fast! It never fails to impress me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Just make sure you don't lose focus!
Across the way, Emily touches the far wall! Ben presses the...
Ben presses the start button on his stopwatch!
A second after, Coach Kessler blows the whistle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoops! Looks like I pressed the button a hair early!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hopefully, they won't notice...
Ben waits patiently...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not until he blows the whistle...
A split second later, Coach Kessler blows the whistle!
Ben presses the start button on his stopwatch!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, let's get started! On my whistle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, Ben... Wait for the whistle...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Three, two, one...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good. Don't mess this up! It's important that Emily's times be recorded accurately!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Coach,` want to relax a bit?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach,[/i][/color] want to relax a bit?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I just wanted to make sure Ben understood that his job is more important than it seems.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you were, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: See? We're good.
Emily rolls her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't give me attitude, young man!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Especially not after the way you performed in that game!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! Go easy!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Let him fight his own fights!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I understand how the stopwatch works.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Your mumbling isn't exactly inspiring my confidence!
Coach Kessler arrives on the far side of the pool. He shoots a glare at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know he's been tough to deal with.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Try impossible. Every chance he gets, he reminds me how I missed the game-winning shot... How I don't have a winner's eye, whatever that is.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: An eye that wins?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really helpful.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just trying to cheer you up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The part about this whole thing that really bothers me is that when I started playing basketball, I really wanted to impress him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought that his approval would make life easier for us.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cough. Cough. Mistake!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: After we lost to Willow Glen, I felt down, but I didn't realize just how much until I saw what the loss did to our team...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Still haven't seen much of the guys?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer said he's, 'focusing on what matters now.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Every time I see Owen, he's lost in thought about something, like a zombie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Andy and Jacob are sort of okay...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What about Erik?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's hard to tell with that guy, but I almost feel like he's taking it worse than anyone.
Coach Kessler bellows at the swim team!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, girls! Line up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I gotta go!
Emily drops down into the water, pushing off toward the far end.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... How do I get out of your dad's doghouse?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You mean, besides beating Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't exactly do that now, can I?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You don't want to make me angry, ladies!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just... Do a good job timing me with the stopwatch.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Really? The key to winning over your dad is pressing a button on a timer?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I think you were off by a couple of seconds last practice. He doesn't exactly have a lot of confidence in you...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: All you can do is restore his confidence a little bit at a time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. Nice pun!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Unintentional!
Emily swims over to the girls who are lining up along the far edge of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So, Sam, when are you going to give us the dirt on $ZOE at the Snow Ball?!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Not that I encourage gossip... But yeah, when?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do `I` seem like someone who gossips?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] seem like someone who gossips?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whatever. I heard $ZOE punched Nate! Then, I heard that after she stormed out of the gym, she had this, like, crazy long make-out session with Owen!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You `actually` believe that?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] believe that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's not even the best part! Then Paige, like, came up to Owen and $ZOE and just straight up `stole` him away from her!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not even the best part! Then Paige, like, came up to Owen and $ZOE and just straight up [color=#3b78e2][i]stole[/i][/color] him away from her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When has $ZOE `ever` punched anyone? You need to get your facts straight!
nodes.text_bbcode: When has $ZOE [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] punched anyone? You need to get your facts straight!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: All those facts sound curvy!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know every rumor has some truth to it...
Coach Kessler blows on his whistle!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right! Less chatter, more swimming! Get warm!
The girls push off the edge and start swimming warm-up laps. Coach Kessler walks over to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good morning, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: There's nothing good about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So... We've had a few talks now about your mistakes in the Willow Glen game. What's your plan?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My plan? I'm not really sure...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hold that thought.
The swimmers finish their warm-ups and return to the pool's edge. Emily climbs up on one of the platforms and gets into her starting pose.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Ready, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yup. Ben, you're good to time me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Just press the `start-stop` button on the stopwatch when Emily starts and then the `lap` button when she touches the far wall.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just press the [color=#e23b3b][i]start-stop[/i][/color] button on the stopwatch when Emily starts and then the [color=#e23b3b][i]lap[/i][/color] button when she touches the far wall.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And don't forget to press the `start-stop` button when she finishes! Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to press the [color=#e23b3b][i]start-stop[/i][/color] button when she finishes! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I got it. I remember how to do this.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really? You're going there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, he `was` on my side! And I `did` tell you that playing basketball would help me bond with your dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, he [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] on my side! And I [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] tell you that playing basketball would help me bond with your dad.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, and `I` told `you` that it wasn't worth it to try and impress him like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] told [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] that it wasn't worth it to try and impress him like this.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because now that you guys have lost...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know, I know. Crazy Dad's been activated.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First stopwatch duty, then a clipboard... Before you know it, I'll be the swim team's official towel guy.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Towel guy? Don't set your sights `too` high.
nodes.text_bbcode: Towel guy? Don't set your sights [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] high.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? My own girlfriend doesn't think I'm cut out for towel guy?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt your feelings, Ben, but... I've seen how you dry. It's not pretty.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: To put it delicately, I'm saying you couldn't dry the desert.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow. The truth stings.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee! This. This is what I've been missing!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's too bad he doesn't feel the same way about you now...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow. Captain Killjoy arrives.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, but it had to be said...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't realize how important it was that I win these basketball games...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Except?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Except... I told you so?
You are now playing as Twin Branches' newest basketball star, Ben...
Ben is sitting poolside with his girlfriend, Emily, before swim practice starts. The other swimmers are hanging out in the water.
Ben takes the stopwatch dangling from his neck and holds it up for Emily to see.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I think I'm starting to get used to this thing. I might start wearing it around campus as an accessory.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Very fashionable.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's my way of spending `time` with you. Get it? 'Cause time.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's my way of spending [color=#e23b3b][i]time[/i][/color] with you. Get it? 'Cause time.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I get it. I get it. If I didn't groan yet, it's because I'm still in shock about how bad that was.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. I guess when it comes to puns, I'll have to `watch` myself.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. I guess when it comes to puns, I'll have to [color=#e23b3b][i]watch[/i][/color] myself.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, `that` was pretty good.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Brought it home.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You know, I'm glad my dad trusted you enough to help out at practices.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What can I say? Except...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, all of you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We are in this together!
The guys straighten up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right now our lungs might be screaming for air, but that just means we're training them to deal without it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: In the game, that will be the difference between us and Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we push ourselves now, then while they're quitting and giving up, we'll be running past them. We'll be winning.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: On this team, we do `not` quit! We do `not` give up!
nodes.text_bbcode: On this team, we do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] quit! We do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] give up!

nodes.text: Ben turns and runs back toward the baseline. Slowly, all of the guys follow behind him... When they reach the baseline, the Coach blows his whistle.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Great job, Kale. I think that's enough for--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One more!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Excuse me, son?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One more, Coach!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Uh... You got it.
The Coach blows his whistle, and the team runs down and back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wilson's going down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha ha! I can't feel my legs!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's it, guys! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Quit being such a bunch of big babies!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm not a baby.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You think you're the only one who's tired?! I'm tired too!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hearing that makes me even more tired!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All you do is pout and gripe and moan...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I don't really `moan, ` per se.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't really [color=#e23b3b][i]moan, [/i][/color] per se.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you guys suck!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who sucks? Do you mean Jacob and Andy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `All` of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]All[/i][/color] of you!

nodes.text: Coach is now standing right behind Ben.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You'd better include yourself in that list, Kale, because that was one of the least inspiring speeches I've ever heard!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And I once tried to inspire my team by telling them they were flat-out uninspiring!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You're worse than they are, you know? Not only because you're doing all the things you're complaining about...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But also because you're doing `my` job too!
nodes.text_bbcode: But also because you're doing [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] job too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not going to be punished for that, am I?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You bet your butt you are! Now go over on that wall and sit against it!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I want your thighs parallel to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds like it's going to hurt!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Oh, it will! And you don't stop until `I` say so!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, it will! And you don't stop until [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] say so!

nodes.text: Ben trudges over to the wall and sits against it while the rest of practice continues...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This isn't so bad. It's almost like resting...
A minute later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So! Much! Pain!
Coach looks over at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Legs `parallel,` Kale! Get down lower!
nodes.text_bbcode: Legs [color=#e23b3b][i]parallel,[/i][/color] Kale! Get down lower!

nodes.text: Ben slides lower to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow. Ow. Ow.
Two minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. This is easy. `Soooooooo` easy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. This is easy. [color=#e23b3b][i]Soooooooo[/i][/color] easy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Once you get past the initial pain threshold...
Ben's muscles spasm!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Beakers and onions! Ow! Ow! Ow! This sucks!
A few minutes later...
Ben watches from afar as Coach wraps up the practice.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I hope all of you are prepared for the game against Wilson High...
The players head to the locker room. Coach shuts off the lights.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Coach? Am I done here?
But Coach walks away...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, there's no way I'm going to stay sitting on this wall all night!
Ben tries to stand up, but his legs immediately give out, and he flops onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Little help here?
He crawls toward the exit.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyone?
As Ben crawls through the gym, his legs aching, his team broken, it's clear...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Well, I'm impressed. Good work, guys.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It was all Benjamin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was the team.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Bull! You've impressed me, Kale! You're going to be our team captain against Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me? Captain?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Don't let it go to your head!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet you're so focused, you're not going to miss any shots against Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah, with how zoned in you are, I'm almost certain you're going to be the high-scorer!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: And I `always` choose me first!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] choose me first!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What's the matter? Not confident all of a sudden?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Relax. Kale's confident enough! He's just modest.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Phew! Thanks, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And I guarantee he scores `thirty points` in our next game!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I guarantee he scores [color=#e23b3b][i]thirty points[/i][/color] in our next game!

nodes.text: The other guys let out a big yell and head off toward the locker room, leaving Ben alone in the gym...
He picks up a basketball and slowly walks out toward the three-point line... Instinctively, he looks at the empty stands...
Then, he shoots... The ball bouncing off the backboard, not even close.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just like in the Willow Glen game, I can't shoot without Emily...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Without her support... I might not score `any` points. Without her...
nodes.text_bbcode: Without her support... I might not score [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] points. Without her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll lose...
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 1: Full Court Pressure!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 4, Episode 1: Full Court Pressure![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
A long time ago, we asked our fans to vote on the genre we would focus on next...
The winner was `Magic School...` And now it's available in our store!
nodes.text_bbcode: The winner was [b]Magic School...[/b] And now it's available in our store!

nodes.text: Learn spells, encounter magical creatures, and explore the Wilde in this HUGE pack!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
They run more...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: This is the worst!
And more...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: How does running make me shoot better?
And more...
When they reach the far baseline, Erik buckles over!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's it! I'm pooped! I got nothing left!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Me neither!
Andy stops running... Jacob follows suit.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm done!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you guys really quitting?
Coach's face contorts into something bordering on rage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've gotta do something!
Ben steps out in front of the team, putting himself in between Coach and the players!

options: You're all a bunch of babies!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: Ben jumps in between them!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys! Relax, okay? It's just water.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then why's Andy being such a jerk?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know, Spencer. Why are you drinking like a hippo?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hippo?
The guys laugh.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right. You got me. I was hogging it. Er, `hippo-ing` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: All right. You got me. I was hogging it. Er, [color=#e23b3b][i]hippo-ing[/i][/color] it.

nodes.text: Spencer steps out of Andy's way.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Problem over there, boys?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, sir.
The guys finish getting their water and return to the baseline.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You know the drill.
Ben just stands there as Andy takes a swing at Spencer!
Spencer blocks it and lifts Andy up by his jersey!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You ready to die, pirate?!
Coach blows his whistle!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What is going on over there?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Just a water dispute, Coach!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Well, I'll end the dispute! Everyone get back on the baseline, now!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But some of us haven't gotten any water!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You think I care? If you can't get water without fighting amongst yourselves, you don't deserve water!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aw, man, I didn't even get that much!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Shut up! You drank enough to quench a camel!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All of you, get back on the baseline!
The guys reluctantly trudge back to the baseline...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And another thing! What are you other idiots doing standing around while your teammates fight?!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: One of you needs to step up and take control!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: This is exactly the lack of leadership that caused us to lose the last game!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess he's talking about me...
The guys run up and down the court repeatedly. After several solid minutes of running...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Water break! Get back on the line in five!
Ben heads for the drinking fountain. Spencer beats him to it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Too slow, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just save some for me.
Spencer drinks...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Don't put your mouth on the spigot!
And drinks...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Seriously, we don't have much time!
And drinks!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That's it!
Andy rushes Spencer, pulling him away from the fountain!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Stop hogging the fountain!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll do what I want!
Spencer shoves Andy back! Andy's fist clenches, and Ben...
As the guys reach the baseline, Ben pulls Jacob aside.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This isn't the time to be bashing Coach.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I... I know. I just don't want to run.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: None of us do, but attacking him isn't going to help.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah... You're right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right now, we need a show of solidarity. That means we do what Coach says. Cool?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All right, you lumps of waste! Get to running!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! Maybe the reason we lost has nothing to do with Coach! Maybe some of it has to do with you!
Jacob looks around at the other guys first before meeting Ben's glare!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Me? It has more to do with you than me! You're the one who missed the shot that could have won us the game!
Ben sees the downcast looks in the other guys' faces.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I missed! We all missed a lot of shots!
Jacob gets right in Ben's face!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't try to put it on `us,` man!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't try to put it on [color=#e23b3b][i]us,[/i][/color] man!

nodes.text: Coach blows hard on his whistle!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Shut up, you primadonnas, and get to running!
A moment later, Erik slumps into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Erik? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How can I be okay... When everything I've ever done is wrong?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa... What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I realized something, Benjamin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not only was that loss my fault... But so was everything that's ever gone wrong in my life!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik, you can't take the blame for `everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik, you can't take the blame for [color=#e23b3b][i]everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I already have!
Erik trudges on past.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow... Sad Erik is `really` a downer.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... Sad Erik is [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] a downer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't talk to me, Ben! I'm still mad at you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? Because I gave you my opinion?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because you gave me horrible advice!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you I've got confused feelings about `two` girls...
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you I've got confused feelings about [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] girls...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you told me to go after one of them and ignore the other one!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?
Owen pushes past Ben!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's callous, man! And that's not how I roll!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't talk to me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for coming, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not here for you, Kale! I'm here because I have to be!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're still giving up on basketball?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Until I see a reason not to!
After school, Ben waits in the gym for the basketball team to arrive...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are they even going to show?
The gym doors open, and Spencer walks in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, I know this is really upsetting, but try not to worry about everything all at once.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How can I do that?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, first off, don't worry about the Art Showcase. We can reschedule.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff... Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, really. I'm the Social Chair.  If anyone can reschedule, it's me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's one of the perks of being in power.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Heh. I guess so.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And second, as for your photos... You can reprint them, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, I guess I can. But it'll take some time to print and mount them again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's all right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And of course, I'll swear to you that we'll find out who did this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I found her in the photo lab one day after school, looking really shaken.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She told me she'd found a note in her locker that said she was a 'creep' who should 'burn all her pictures'.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It really upset her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who sent the note?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I have my guesses.
Nick opens his laptop and navigates to his images folders. He opens a folder entitled 'Autumn Art' and sifts through them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Autumn's entire exhibit focused around the juxtaposition between what is real and what is portrayed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Meaning?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Meaning that she put candid pictures of the cheerleaders during practice next to their polished cheer photos in the yearbook.
Nick pulls up some pictures and shows them to $ZOE and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Here. These are the thumbnails of what Autumn's exhibit actually looked like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's see... There's Keith doing a cheer with the megaphone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And another photo of him looking `super` depressed on the bleachers.
nodes.text_bbcode: And another photo of him looking [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] depressed on the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Check out Nicole's. All made up, cheering with her pom-poms in the yearbook... And then draped over some college guy on the sidelines during practice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then there's Maria doing an impressive toe touch with a wide smile...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Followed by a picture of her yelling at everyone else for dropping her after that last cheerleading routine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Man, I did not know her face contorted that way...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... These pictures aren't exactly `flattering.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... These pictures aren't exactly [color=#e23b3b][i]flattering.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE looks from the pictures to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You think one of them destroyed Autumn's photos?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, it makes sense, doesn't it? That's probably why she didn't want to talk to you about it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't cross the cheerleading team.
$ZOE gives him a look.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not that all cheerleaders are bad! I'd cross you any day!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But do you really think Maria, Nicole, or Keith would destroy Autumn's photos over this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Social wars have been waged for far less. And people are way more sensitive about bad photos ever since memes caught on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's a meme?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's an internet thing. In this case, it's a funny or embarrassing photo with a caption in big letters on it. There are a ton on Erik Ericson. See?
Nick opens a website on his smart phone and shows it to $ZOE. $ZOE can see a picture of Erik Ericson's face with big white letters around him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'ENJOYS FRUITS... `AND` VEGETABLES!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'ENJOYS FRUITS... [color=#3b78e2][i]AND[/i][/color] VEGETABLES!'

nodes.text: Nick scrolls down and shows them another one.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'WEARS GLASSES... BECAUSE HE HAS POOR VISION!'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: These go on and on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I don't really get it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They're funny, they're catchy, and most of all, they're embarrassing. Just think what would happen if the `Dirty Dish` got one of Maria, Nicole, or Keith's photos?
nodes.text_bbcode: They're funny, they're catchy, and most of all, they're embarrassing. Just think what would happen if the [color=#e23b3b][i]Dirty Dish[/i][/color] got one of Maria, Nicole, or Keith's photos?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They'd be a laughingstock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's not like Autumn's making these memes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But she would have put the photos out there, and someone probably wanted to stop her. My guess is that it's one of these cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maria, Nicole, and Keith. Would any of them really do something like this?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Face it... People aren't as nice as you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that not everyone is nice, but I'm serious. I couldn't see any of them trashing Autumn's art!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Maria's more vindictive than you think. Nicole has `no` morals whatsoever. Keith gets made fun of all the time for being a male cheerleader... He's gotta be holding a grudge!
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Maria's more vindictive than you think. Nicole has [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] morals whatsoever. Keith gets made fun of all the time for being a male cheerleader... He's gotta be holding a grudge!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I saw some people bugging Keith just the other day about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Poor Keith. No wonder he looks so depressed in that picture.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is... Any one's capable of anything if you push hard enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And if there's a chance that a bad picture is going to be floating around school, then you've got a lot to lose.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll try to talk to them at lunch. Thanks for the help, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. You can talk to me anytime. Let me know what you find out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm going to try to get ahold of Autumn. She usually comes by to discuss her art projects. It's not like her to not show up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good idea. Let us know if you find her. I hope she's okay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you know anything about that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know... Now that you mention it, I do remember Autumn was having a hard time earlier this week as well.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think this is the first incident.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened before?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, who would? No one wants to be a whistleblower.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A whistleblower?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know, a snitch, a blabbermouth, a tattletale?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, you are so weird some days...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Don't blame me for your poor vocabulary.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `know` what a whistleblower is!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] what a whistleblower is!

nodes.text: She punches him playfully on the shoulder, nearly knocking him off his chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, `that` didn't give me any more information...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] didn't give me any more information...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But back to the destroyed art...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything going on with Autumn? Anything at all that you remember?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, I do remember something from earlier this week...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I will. Thanks, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, wait, why are you guys here? Did you need something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Someone vandalized Autumn's art project!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're trying to figure out who did it. Do you know anyone who'd have something against her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, no one jumps out at me. But my social life's pretty much been basketball. At least until the game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you know, if you can find someone who really knows Autumn, I'm sure you'll find who did it.
Ben picks up a basketball and starts shooting around as $ZOE and Sam head out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ben's right. If we're going to figure this out, we need to get inside her head. We need to think like a pretentious artist...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know just the pretentious artist to ask...
$ZOE and Sam find Nick in the room where the journalism club meets. He's looking over pictures in his camera's viewfinder.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. I was just thinking about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Er, about what you said. The other day. When we were hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh, you guys were hanging out? I didn't know about `this.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, you guys were hanging out? I didn't know about [color=#3b78e2][i]this.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stop it, cuz. I know where you're going with this. Do `not` embarrass me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop it, cuz. I know where you're going with this. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] embarrass me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of `course` not...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of [color=#3b78e2][i]course[/i][/color] not...

nodes.text: She winks at Sam, who groans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, all we did was watch a frightening zombie movie!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Frightening? Please. The only thing scary about it was that someone actually thought it was worth making.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So what brings you to my neck of the woods? Don't you guys have class?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, in like ten minutes. But we want some information from you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Intriguing. I'm betting you probably don't want to know the complex relationship between aperture and depth of field...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, it's about Autumn. All three of the photos that Autumn put up for the showcase have been defaced.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? When did this happen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh no... Poor Autumn. She's been working hard on pulling together the right photos for that exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, she did. I tried to talk to her yesterday about who might have done it, but she just ran away. I was hoping you could help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I talked to her, Autumn said that...

options.label: She didn't want to go to the principal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I bake a lot of cupcakes! The cuter the better. It cheers me up, and you can't be stressed when you smile.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE, but I'm not really a baker.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Plus, I don't think eating cupcakes before a basketball game will help me that much. Coach is always making us run. All that sugar might make me sick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see your point. Well, whenever I'm stressed, it also helps to talk Sam or my aunt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Having friends around is important.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just to be able to talk to someone and know they're there makes a big difference.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You helped me so much with the Halloween Dance and party-planning. If you need anything from me, just let me know!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything I've done up until now has been successful because I've had a lot of support.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, you helped me with the house party and the Halloween Dance. And I couldn't have done anything without Sam helping me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that you should rely on someone else all the time, but sometimes support is the best thing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. How'd you figure that one out?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just something I've learned.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least Wilson High isn't as far away from home as that last school. You'll have all the support you need in the stands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you know, I definitely owe you a favor, so if you need anything from me, just let me know!
$ZOE blanks out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, what's the question again?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do you deal with stress?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe someone's trying to get revenge on Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean like Autumn pissed someone off?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. I don't know who though.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you asked her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think she's going to tell me anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should have seen her, Sam. She was shaking. She took off when I tried to ask about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I texted her last night a bunch. She hasn't replied yet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you tried calling her?
$ZOE finds Autumn's number and calls. The phone rings, but there's no answer.
She tries again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No answer. We're on our own for now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great. What now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I've been out of touch with what's happening lately at the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Ben might know something! Let's check with him!
$ZOE and Sam find Ben shooting baskets in the empty gymnasium.
He stands at the three-point line and takes a shot. It bounces off the rim.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Well, that sucked.
They walk up to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong? Bad morning?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bad week. The basketball game against Wilson is coming up really soon. There's a lot of pressure to win.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And even more pressure on `me` to help the team win.
nodes.text_bbcode: And even more pressure on [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] to help the team win.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I can't lead the team to victory, then not only do we lose our chance at Sectionals, but... I think I'll be back to square zero with Emily's dad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, that's tough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Being a leader's never easy, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As Social Chair, I feel a lot more responsible now. There's pressure to not let people down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, funny how that works.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do you deal with it? It's a lot of stress.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For me, it's a good work out. What about you, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I find that I deal with it better when I have...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like someone had something against her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The only damage that was done was to her art. It's not like people pushed the garbage cans over, or messed with the instruments.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This doesn't feel like it was done for kicks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I agree. Whoever did this was angry at Autumn.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what were they angry about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have no idea.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great... So we're looking for someone cruel.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Cheerleaders can be pretty cruel... But then again so can outcasts... And I've heard the nerds can be pretty cruel to each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess that doesn't really narrow anything down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... And Besides, I'm thinking this was personal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoever did this didn't trash the whole room. They `just` targeted Autumn.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoever did this didn't trash the whole room. They [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] targeted Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't know where to start. Autumn doesn't want me to talk to the principal.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There are other ways to find things out than asking the principal. In fact, I'm sure you can do a better job anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right.
Taylor leans across the table, glowering...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Find the scumbag who did this. Do `not` let this injustice stand!
