nodes.text: You are `waaay` too cheerful this early in the morning. What do you do, eat glitter for breakfast?
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]waaay[/i][/color] too cheerful this early in the morning. What do you do, eat glitter for breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, I just kind of wake up this way...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course you do. I don't know why I bother asking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there any news about Lindsay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, after you told me what she did to Autumn's art yesterday, I decided to take it up with Principal McCormick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, yeah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not about to let Lindsay get away with defacing Autumn's photos just because `she` wasn't featured in the Showcase.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not about to let Lindsay get away with defacing Autumn's photos just because [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] wasn't featured in the Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Geez, who `does` that? Back when I was Head Cheerleader, you had to `earn` your popularity, not just whine about not having it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, who [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] that? Back when I was Head Cheerleader, you had to [color=#3b78e2][i]earn[/i][/color] your popularity, not just whine about not having it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What did McCormick say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She was going to suspend Lindsay, but Lindsay's parents talked her down.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Instead, she'll be serving detention every day this week, and she's suspended from extracurriculars for the next two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Extracurriculars? Like cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does that mean she can't cheer at the basketball game against Wilson on Friday?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's not allowed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? I thought this was what you wanted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess. It's just...

options.label: I didn't want the cheerleading team to suffer.

nodes.text: Can $ZOE and Autumn save the Art Showcase in time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now, we have some prints to deliver.
In the Student President's office, Taylor is just putting on her jacket to leave when $ZOE and Autumn burst in, breathless.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't leave! We're here! We're here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Geez, talk about cutting it close. I was just about to count you out. What took you so long?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I felt like I learned a valuable lesson today. People care a lot about how they're perceived.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And if you ignore that, then you devalue them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You were late because of a life lesson?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That and she retook all her photos.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about the pictures?
Autumn shows off her mounted photos.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, these look professional.
Taylor skims over Emily's passionate face, the focus in Ben's eyes, the quiet strength of Owen, and...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You took pictures of Lindsay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't want any bad blood between us.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's probably a wise move. You don't want to be enemies with crazy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And there's another lesson learned.
Taylor nods at the model-perfect photos of Lindsay on the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Her photos seem a little different than the others.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I like how her photos turned out. Not my usual style.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, she looks pretty, just like she wanted.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, she does. Good work, Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks. I just hope I don't offend anyone this time around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We'll see what everyone else thinks at the Art Showcase. Until then.
Taylor grabs her bag and heads out of the office.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Until then!
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 3: Showcase Sabotage, Part 2!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 4, Episode 3: Showcase Sabotage, Part 2![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Magic School: Book 2 is here!
Learn new spells, train your familiar, and find romance as the epic adventure continues! Now in `More Episodes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Learn new spells, train your familiar, and find romance as the epic adventure continues! Now in [b]More Episodes![/b]

nodes.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Why should we care about the school?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because you're in it?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, $ZOE. I mean, why should `we` care? You're always planning a dance or a party or a showcase...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, $ZOE. I mean, why should [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] care? You're always planning a dance or a party or a showcase...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But you're helping everyone else `except` for us!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you're helping everyone else [color=#3b78e2][i]except[/i][/color] for us!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: When are the cheerleaders going to get a special event?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, after--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah. `After`. After everyone else.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. [color=#3b78e2][i]After[/i][/color]. After everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know what? I can't kick you off the team, but if you can't even bother to `try` to make practice, don't bother coming at all!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what? I can't kick you off the team, but if you can't even bother to [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to make practice, don't bother coming at all!

nodes.text: Maria turns on her heel and leaves $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Whoa. Sorry if I caused you any trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's kind of right. I haven't been thinking about cheerleading since I became Social Chair. But I'll figure it out later.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do her photos have to do with us?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What Lindsay did doesn't make us look good. It reflects badly on the entire cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If the Art Showcase is canceled, we look like bullies.
Maria sighs.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah. That's true...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that it doesn't really excuse me from missing practice, but I swear, after this, I'll try to figure it all out.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Fine. Do what you have to do. But the team expects you to know your routines by the basketball game, so you'd better learn all of them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll study them all.
Maria steps aside to let them pass.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Whoa, that was close. It was like watching a giant panda bear about to leap on a yak!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do panda bears eat yaks?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't know, but it's a fun image.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right. Carnage. Fun. Whee.
$ZOE hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Um, help the school?
Autumn bursts out of the room, carefully holding each completed print.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Success?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes! Let's get these photos to Taylor!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
$ZOE and Autumn dash into the hallway, each carefully carrying one of the new prints.
They're almost at the office when they run into Maria!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE! We need to talk!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can we talk in a minute? It's really important that--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I'm not waiting another second. You've been blowing off all the emergency meetings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought we didn't have any! Amanda said they were all popcorn parties!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's the `code word` for `emergency dance meeting` which you would know if you went to the first `cupcake party` to begin with!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the [color=#3b78e2][i]code word[/i][/color] for [color=#3b78e2][i]emergency dance meeting[/i][/color] which you would know if you went to the first [color=#3b78e2][i]cupcake party[/i][/color] to begin with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then why did Amanda ask me to bring party hats?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That's what she calls the megaphones.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Which you'd know if you came to practice `last` week. Geez, $ZOE. Everything's more important than the cheerleading team to you, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Which you'd know if you came to practice [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] week. Geez, $ZOE. Everything's more important than the cheerleading team to you, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's not!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yesterday you said that you'd try to make it to at least `some` of the practices, but you haven't come to any!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yesterday you said that you'd try to make it to at least [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] of the practices, but you haven't come to any!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I needed to make sure something got done for the Art Showcase and...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Stop! Just stop it! You're always doing something for Social Chair, and we let it go before because you're our friend.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But now we really need you, and it's clear that you've deserted us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's not like Autumn needs you around to hold her hand. She takes pictures fine without you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel awful about not making it to practice... And I know I haven't been there lately, but this is important. It's...
Autumn comes out of the darkroom, dejected.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I made a mistake. The photos are ruined. I can't do Lindsay's exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That is a shame. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh well. Maybe the Art Showcase wasn't meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what? But what about the other photos? Ben's, Emily's, and Owen's photos look great!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I know, but... I can't submit them. If Lindsay finds out that I went ahead with their pictures, but not hers, it'll be like the first photos all over again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: She'll be `so` upset.
nodes.text_bbcode: She'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what? You don't have to bow down to her. You should still be in the Art Showcase. Forget about her.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can't. If she retaliates and does something to my photos--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then she's won. And she'll be mad at you anyway.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, but it'll be worse. I can't see my photos ruined again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. I'm withdrawing. I'm sorry, $ZOE. Tell Taylor I tried.
Autumn walks out of the classroom, her camera in hand. She hangs her head and, in her heart of hearts...
She knows she's failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Developer, stopper, and fixer.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just a few more minutes... And I'm done!
A tense half hour later, Autumn dries the photo and holds it carefully in her hand.
Even in the dim light, she can see that the picture's come out perfectly.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot! That's not what I wanted to do!
A tense twenty minutes goes by as Autumn develops the photo. She looks at the finished product...
And sees splotches of light and shadow ruin the effect of the picture...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no...
Autumn absentmindedly sticks it in the fixer solution!
Autumn dumps in twelve cups of water.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I feel like the tray is too full... But there's no going back now...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's it!
Autumn dumps in eight cups of water and sticks the photo in.
A few minutes later, Lindsay's smiling face shows up on the photo paper...
Autumn fumbles and dumps so much water into the tray that it overflows!
A tense twenty minutes goes by as Autumn develops the film. She looks at the finished photo...
The picture of Lindsay has come out, but instead of a dream-like blur, Lindsay's face looks fuzzy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot... I put it down the wrong way!
Autumn places the strip emulsion side down and prepares for the next step.
Autumn flips the negatives back and forth trying to see which is the shiny side...
But it slips out of her hands and lands in the solution film shiny side down!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That seems fine...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay... But what about your other photo?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: My 'other photo'?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Everyone else I've taken a picture of has done two different shots. If your first is 'pretty', what's your second?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Duh. It's also 'pretty'. Just take the picture from a different angle.
Autumn considers this then nods.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All right. Give me 'pretty.'
Lindsay tilts her chin down and gives Autumn's camera an intense, sultry look. Autumn snaps the picture.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Great. Try a different pose.
Lindsay then torques her body, so she's looking at Autumn's camera over her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And again.
The third picture shows Lindsay blowing a kiss at the camera.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And that's it. Thanks, Lindsay. You'll see your photos at the Art Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Great. You know, this was actually not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Anyway, bye.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She is... Not who I thought she was.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, that's probably the closest I've ever heard you come to an insult.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. I'm not nice all the time.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, you are. Now come on, we have some film to develop.
$ZOE checks her phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have a little more than an hour before Taylor's office closes down.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Cutting it close, but we can make it! The photos can dry on the way.
$ZOE and Autumn rush into the art studio.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All we need to do is develop the pictures and run them over to Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If you want to help, can you put the photos I've already developed into frames?
Autumn gestures to a work table that has printed photos of Emily, Ben, and Owen. Empty frames are propped up against the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds like so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Only you would think framing photos is that exciting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you? You're the photographer.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I do. But not as much as I care about the picture itself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Makes sense. Well, don't sweat it. I'll get these photos framed. Go develop the rest!
Autumn brings the roll of film into the darkroom and shuts off the lights.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, first things first... I make the negatives, and then I mount them on my enlarger `emulsion side down` for it to come out right... That's the dull side!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, first things first... I make the negatives, and then I mount them on my enlarger [color=#3b78e2][i]emulsion side down[/i][/color] for it to come out right... That's the dull side!

nodes.text: Working as fast as she can, Autumn develops the film, creating negatives for her photos.
Then, Autumn turns to her enlarger and mounts the first negative of Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: It's better than 'excitement', I'll tell you that much.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's something.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: But it's not really what all girls want to aspire to.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think girls should 'aspire to'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't know. Looking pretty?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You want your emotion to be 'pretty'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: 'Fury'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: `Fury?!` Does `this` look like the face of fury to you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Fury?![/i][/color] Does [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] look like the face of fury to you?!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually. yeah.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I come here for a photo shoot at `your` request, and you just insult me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I come here for a photo shoot at [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] request, and you just insult me.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't mean 'fury' in a bad way. 'Anger' is not a bad emotion. It tells you when something's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Now you're calling me `wrong?` I want the photos to show how `attractive` I am.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you're calling me [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong?[/i][/color] I want the photos to show how [color=#3b78e2][i]attractive[/i][/color] I am.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You and I probably have different ideas of what 'attractive' is.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, that much is `obvious.` Just make my photo 'pretty.'
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that much is [color=#3b78e2][i]obvious.[/i][/color] Just make my photo 'pretty.'

nodes.text: They walk out to the football field, and Autumn has Lindsay sit in the bleachers in her cheerleading outfit.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How's this?
Lindsay perches on the edge of a bench, her hands folded in her lap and a bright smile on her face.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: There should be a point to the photos I take of you. Like an emotion that you're displaying.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The way you're sitting doesn't really show anything about your personality.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: All right. What do you want me to do then?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What if you do some cheering? We can get some exuberance or excitement in the picture.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't want to tell you how to do your job, but... Wait, I do.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't want to jump around and cheer. Do you know how long it took me to do my hair today?
She steamrolls on before Autumn can talk.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: `An hour.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]An hour.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't realize it took so long to make straight hair, uh, straight.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Think of another emotion or whatever that doesn't involve me doing something weird or silly or active.
Autumn looks over Lindsay's angry face, trying to decide what to say.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You can represent...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm assuming you care about that.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So my pictures would be with the hottest guy in school, his swim pro girlfriend, and a football superstar?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If that's how you see them... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What about the other cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's not using them. You're the only cheerleader she's photographing.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Then I'm `definitely` in.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] in.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How do we do this?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So what? Now you feel sorry for me or something?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That's even worse!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't feel sorry for you. I just thought I owed you one.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: After you left me out last time because I wasn't popular enough?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay... Autumn didn't care whether or not you were popular.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, I just wanted the best pictures.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And my pictures were awful?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They weren't what I was looking for. The others just showed a specific emotion or trait.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Besides, the last time, I was looking for the best pictures out of an entire group. If I work with you by yourself, then I can get the exact pictures that we both want.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Hmmm... Fine. How do we do this?
After school, $ZOE drops by the photo lab to check in on Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you get the prints done?
Autumn looks at her photos of Ben, Emily, and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong with the photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not that. I was just thinking about my exhibit and about what happened last time when Lindsay destroyed the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't have to worry about that now. Lindsay's not going to try something like that again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That may be so, but...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I want my art to make people `feel.` But that doesn't include wanting people to feel left out.
nodes.text_bbcode: I want my art to make people [color=#3b78e2][i]feel.[/i][/color] But that doesn't include wanting people to feel left out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't include everyone in the photo shoot.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I can include Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure, Autumn? You don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay did something awful to you. If you include her, she might think that she can get her way if she does bad things to people.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I thought about that. But what's the alternative? She hated me for not including her, she'll hate me more for getting punished...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe I can turn this Art Showcase into a peace offering. Even if I'm upset that she destroyed my photos, I kind of understand how she feels now.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No one wants to feel left out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do we have enough time?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If we hurry.
Autumn and $ZOE spot Lindsay coming out of the detention classroom.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay, do you have a second?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh, well, if it's little Miss Perky and her hipster sidekick.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I have to sit in detention with boring Ms. Fitzpootie for an hour all thanks to you, so I'm sure you can figure out why I don't want to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to sit in detention with boring Ms. Fitzpootie for an hour all thanks to you, so I'm sure you can figure out why I don't want to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She turns away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay, wait!
Lindsay stops.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm... I'm redoing my photo shoot. And I wanted you to be in it.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Give me one good reason why I should bother.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: Ben, Emily, and Owen are in it.
I left you out last time.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway... Thanks, guys! Good luck tonight!
Paige leaves. Owen and Ben reach the bus and climb aboard.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Nice of you to join us!
The guys find a seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: See what I mean about something being up with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't even need to say anything. She's getting `our` advice for a party? It's weird enough to see her smiling so much, let alone actually `caring` about other people.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't even need to say anything. She's getting [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] advice for a party? It's weird enough to see her smiling so much, let alone actually [color=#e23b3b][i]caring[/i][/color] about other people.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, you were saying something about her before she showed up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I was just going to give you some advice...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no reason for stuff with her to affect how you play basketball. You just have to separate the two.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't you think that's a little hypocritical of you to say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I mean Emily totally affects how you play... Why can't Paige affect how I play?
Ben sits there, feeling foolish, as the bus lurches forward and drives off in the direction of Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course it does! I'm really good at it too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem. I'm not so sure the 'poor' people are going to like you guessing how much their clothes cost.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. It's settled.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: People who don't have much money aren't going to want you calling them out on it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't relate, but you might have a point.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess you'll have to think of another game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to be so mean about it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but no one's going to want you telling them how much you think their purse cost!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because not everyone spends more than three hundred dollars on a purse!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha! Funny joke! Like you can even find a purse for under five!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It sounds...?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's just say I don't have the words for it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That just leaves the entertainment. Not that I need your help or anything since I already have the `best` party game in mind.
nodes.text_bbcode: That just leaves the entertainment. Not that I need your help or anything since I already have the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] party game in mind.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do I want to know?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called Guess How Much! You try to guess how much everyone's clothes and purses cost! My friends and I play all the time!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That game idea sounds...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wouldn't that just cater to guys?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It doesn't have to. There's the cheerleading team, the girls basketball team, the girls swim team.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All the athletes could wear their uniforms! The whole thing would be like one big pep rally!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: One last hurrah...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Or not.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I... I love it! I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? I'm trying to throw a party for poor people, and your idea is to theme it around money?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, it might not be my best--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I love it! I'm totally going to do it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What better way to encourage other people to work harder than to show them what hard work can `earn?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What better way to encourage other people to work harder than to show them what hard work can [color=#3b78e2][i]earn?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, 'cause you earned it...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Around what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I dunno... Money?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That covers snacks. What about a theme to decorate around?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you really need a theme?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you really need a face?! Of course the party needs a theme!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, what happened to nice Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah... I meant, uh... Great question, Ben! Sometimes we have to question the obvious!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, why don't you theme it around...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You guys like chips and salsa?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's not to like? Crispy tortilla chips, diced tomatoes, onions, and peppers. So much spicy goodness!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Plus, you get to eat with your hands!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hands? Ew. I might throw up now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Although... Maybe I could use a caviar spoon for the salsa and my diamond-studded tongs for the chips.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I take back all my previous 'wow's' and put them here. I didn't know diamond-studded tongs were coming.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Does this meet her royal Highness's needs?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes. Although I'd appreciate less attitude from my subjects.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pigs in a blanket? I... I guess I could do that. You sure eat some disgusting things.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Cause eating the eggs of a fish is a totally pleasant idea.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, at least I don't serve those eggs in a heated aquarium!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry... I didn't mean to get snappy. What I meant to say was, um, of course I'll serve whatever barbaric-sounding delicacies you want!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to go. I hope you find your mother's brooch.
Emily leaves, and Ben lets her go.
You are now playing as Owen.
It's the day of the basketball game. As class lets out, Owen heads down the hall toward the parking lot where the team's bus is waiting.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owen! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey... Man, I never thought that class would end.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mr. Russell really knows how to put the please-end-my-life-I'm-going-to-die-of-boredom into physics.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You ready for the game tonight?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I actually wanted to talk to you about, you know, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I was thinking maybe you could just--
Paige suddenly appears next to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ben! Were you and Owen just talking about me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I mean, er--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's nothing to fret over! There's no reason to be tense... Especially not before an important game! Do you need anything from me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A massage? A beverage? A massaging beverage? I don't know if those exist, but they should!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Is... Is she for real?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you she was acting weird!
A frown flashes across Paige's lips. For an instant, she looks hopelessly sad. Then she forces a smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Weird? What are you talking about, Owen? Is it weird to finally realize that we should treasure every second with our friends? There are so many things we take for granted.
Ben mutters under his breath.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where did Paige go?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Paige? Does this have something to do with that big talk you told me you were having with your mom?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `That` is not important. What's important is celebrating!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] is not important. What's important is celebrating!

nodes.text: Ben whispers to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How long before the real Paige shows up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey! You don't get to keep secrets from me, Owen! `I` keep secrets from you, got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! You don't get to keep secrets from me, Owen! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] keep secrets from you, got it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, that didn't take long.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, I mean... Excuse me. I don't know what came over me. Don't you two gentlemen have a bus to attend to? I can escort you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I say for the record that you're really weirding me out?
They exit the school doors into the parking lot. Coach is standing near the bus.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hurry up, ladies!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We've gotta go, Paige. See you at the game?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait! I need your help. I'm throwing an after-party and--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No way! The last `party` of yours I went to was a trap! My kind of parties involve lots of people who are `our` age!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! The last [color=#e23b3b][i]party[/i][/color] of yours I went to was a trap! My kind of parties involve lots of people who are [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] age!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you go to a baby party?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I swear this won't be like that! My mom's out of town with Tad! They're not going to be back for another week!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, what do you need our help for?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want to throw...
Paige has trouble getting the words out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want to throw a party that you guys would enjoy. A... A poor people party.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So nice when you put it like that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Can you help me or not? I know enough not to serve beluga caviar. But which eggs does your kind prefer? Ossetra? Just don't tell me you eat Stevruga. I'm not ready to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know, right? I'm `even` thinking about a flexible dress code that permits casual evening gowns and laid-back tuxedos.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, right? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]even[/i][/color] thinking about a flexible dress code that permits casual evening gowns and laid-back tuxedos.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I take back my previous 'wow' and insert it here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As much fun as it'd be to watch you attempt this party on your own, we'll help you. But make it quick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, We don't want to have to chase after the bus again, and Coach is starting to get that impatient look in his eye.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay! Okay! If you guys don't want caviar, what kind of hors d'oeuvres should I serve?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You should definitely serve...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! What could I possibly be jealous of?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're jealous because all of a sudden your dad cares more about me than he ever did for you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe you said that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, go ahead! Say what you were going to say!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think it would be better for both of us if I kept my mouth shut instead...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine...
Ben doesn't say anything.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you know what that means, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If you say something about my dad, I swear...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's like the whole point, Emily. If we win Sectionals, you and I will be able to spend so much time together without any hassle from your father.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! This isn't about `us,` Ben! Maybe it was before, but it's not about us anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! This isn't about [color=#3b78e2][i]us,[/i][/color] Ben! Maybe it was before, but it's not about us anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Look! We're hanging out together `right` now! I don't see my dad anywhere. Do you? It's not like he's nearly as strict with me as he used to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look! We're hanging out together [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] now! I don't see my dad anywhere. Do you? It's not like he's nearly as strict with me as he used to be!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This is about `your` dad, Ben. It's pretty obvious, so let's just get it out in the open.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is about [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] dad, Ben. It's pretty obvious, so let's just get it out in the open.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? This has nothing to do with my dad, okay?! You're just...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... You're only happy because I'll help you win?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Well, it's true.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm not sacrificing my schedule to make you play better, you know. I'm coming to support you. To be there for you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know. I know. But it `does` increase our odds of winning.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know. I know. But it [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] increase our odds of winning.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What moves are those?
Ben does a quick spin move, circling around Emily.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... The moves of `attraction.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I don't know... The moves of [color=#e23b3b][i]attraction.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee hee! Okay, that was kind of slick. For you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: With me trying to impress you, we'll win for sure.
Owen walks off toward the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Owen plays how he did today against Wilson High, it doesn't matter how many points everyone else scores, we'll still lose!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know it's up to me now to help him... But how?
That night, Ben and Emily are at Ben's house, rummaging through a dusty, unused dining room. Boxes are piled up everywhere.
Elsewhere, the house is perfectly quiet. No one else is home. Ben's father is away on business... Again.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: At least you tried to do something. That seems pretty captain-like to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm telling you I missed an opportunity to help Owen. Someone better than me would have known what to say.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're being too hard on yourself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Am I? We lost in practice because of him. If I don't help Owen, I'm pretty sure we're going to lose against Wilson High too!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe you should just talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Besides, would losing be the end of the world?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! Your dad would go back to thinking I'm Ben the Slacker, bent on corrupting his daughter.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Right... `My` dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right... [color=#3b78e2][i]My[/i][/color] dad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Forget it. What is it we're trying to find again?
Emily lifts up a stack of boxes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My mom's brooch. She probably just lost it. When she called me this morning, she accused my dad of 'selling it before the ink dried on the divorce papers'.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry things are so messy between your parents.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was never all that 'clean'.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If it makes you feel better, I have good news to share with you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Did you buy me a brooch for Valentine's Day?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No. You're not special enough for jewelry. But I `am` coming to your game.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. You're not special enough for jewelry. But I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] coming to your game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do I swim the 50m backstroke in under 32 seconds?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You totally do!
Ben does a little jig, then stops abruptly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... How did you find the time?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I had a talk with my dad. I promised him some extra swim sessions over the weekend. He couldn't say no to that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You weren't kidding about it being good news!
Emily notices a box with the top slightly open.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's this?
She opens it. Inside are a collection of odds and ends... Photographs, a school ribbon for science achievement, and a folded piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Emily unfolds the paper.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: 'To Dad. The owner of this coupon is entitled to ten free hugs from your son, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Happy Father's Day!'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, this is the cutest thing I've ever seen! It even has a drawing of you two hugging!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, it's really cute. Let's, um, let's just look for my mom's brooch.
Ben takes the paper from Emily and stuffs it into his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... I can't even begin to tell you how excited I am that you're coming to my game!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And why's that?

options.label: It gives me a chance to show off my moves!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What, Ben?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's... A great player? Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: A great player?! What game were you watching?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: If he's a great player, I should play professionally!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't know what you're saying, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow. Thanks for your help, Ben. Maybe you could help set up another round of insults.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I was trying to be honest.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, they're right. I'm not a great player.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the next time you want to be honest, try saying something closer to the truth.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm no good for this team right now...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Did you just say 'best `looking`'?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say 'best [color=#e23b3b][i]looking[/i][/color]'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, have you lost your mind?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you saying, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, um... Look at him! He's got a, um, a great smile!
The guys stop for a second and look at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know one thing for sure, he looks better than me!
The guys laugh.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least they're not ragging on Owen anymore...
As they continue laughing...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Harris! Get out here!
Ben and Owen sprint out onto the court and get into position.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Since we don't have enough players to scrimmage against ourselves, I enlisted some of the players from the girls' team to help us out!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Great. I needed a confidence boost!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'd need one too if I lost the way you guys did to Willow Glen!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Grr!
Coach blows his whistle, and the scrimmage starts!
Over the next few plays, Ben does outstanding. He makes easy shots, smart passes, and plays tough defense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope I can play like this against Wilson High!
Unfortunately, things don't go nearly as well for Owen. Early on, Owen guards Jane by mistake!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm open!
Jane passes the ball to a wide-open Kim, and she makes a three-pointer!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What are you doing?! Jane isn't your man! Kim is!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey! Who are you calling a man?!
And later...
After Kim's shot clangs off the rim, Megan steps in front of Owen, grabs the rebound, and puts the ball in!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude! How could you let her do that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... I just forgot to box out.
Near the end of the practice scrimmage, the guys set up one final play trailing by one point...
Jacob dribbles the ball down and passes it to Owen... But it slips through his fingers and right into Jane's hands!
Coach blows his whistle. The scrimmage is over.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Who's a man now, losers?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I mean... You know what I mean!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: They do! You mean we crushed them like metal in a compactor!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Awww, it's okay, boys. You came close. Just not close enough! Ha ha!
The girls walk away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I played so well... And we lost... I can't believe we lost.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It isn't hard to believe! Owen here gave them the game!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Seriously! You need to wake up, Owen!
For one brief moment, Ben feels like there's something he can say... Some way to come to Owen's defense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, guys... Uh...
But he doesn't know what it is, so instead he says...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let her act weird for a while. Sooner or later, you'll see an opportunity when she'll want to talk.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You think so?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me. Emily gets into funks sometimes. But eventually, she always let me know what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right. I think I can do that. I just don't like the idea of waiting...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, no one does.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your whole relationship, or whatever it is, seems to be you two acting like jerks to each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think that's oversimplifying things.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever. Sometimes things are simple. If she tries to change the subject, don't let her. Make her talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I'm not going to do that. It sounds `way` too aggressive.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, I'm not going to do that. It sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too aggressive.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. Don't listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why ask my advice if you're not going to take it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because I didn't know it would suck when I asked for it!
The doors to the gym fly open, and Coach storms in, flanked by the girls' basketball team!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Maggots! Scrimmage! Two minutes!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Against the girls?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Something wrong, Fatty?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fatty?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Who are you calling fat, you--

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Be really careful how you finish that sentence, punk!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: When did Megan join the team?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You guys are going to get owned!
While the guys are distracted, Ben pulls Owen aside.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Owen, you haven't said much... You okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To be honest, not really.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige and I have been spending a lot more time together.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, spending time with Paige could bring any person down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, watch yourself!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Did you just `defend` Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Did you just [color=#e23b3b][i]defend[/i][/color] Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sounds like you two are on a speedboat to the relation-`ship!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like you two are on a speedboat to the relation-[color=#e23b3b][i]ship![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That is `not` a phrase. And she is `not` my girlfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a phrase. And she is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] my girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least... I don't think she's my girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All I'm saying is... You two. Tree. K-i-s-s, you know the rest.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, she's changed since we came back from winter break, so there won't be very much k-i-anything.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Changed? Changed how?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's... `Nice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: She's... [color=#e23b3b][i]Nice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, say what now? This is the same Paige who called your grandmother's house a dump, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, I know. It's hard to believe. But she actually complimented me the other day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, I can see how that must be horrible for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha ha. With any other girl, no. But with Paige, it means something's definitely up. I just don't know `what.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha. With any other girl, no. But with Paige, it means something's definitely up. I just don't know [color=#e23b3b][i]what.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Have you tried talking to her about it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, but she always changes the subject.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then you probably just need to...

nodes.prompt: Then you probably just need to...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Then you probably just need to...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Really? 'Let's win?'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It's super lame, that's what's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Our game isn't even today.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You sound like a bad commercial for healthy snacks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even `I` thought that sounded lame, Benjamin! And I `love` healthy snacks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] thought that sounded lame, Benjamin! And I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] healthy snacks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... I'm still new to this.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! We just need to focus on today!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to grab like a hundred rebounds!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'm going to make all my shots!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll make the bench `so` warm, it'll be like sitting on a just-used toilet seat!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll make the bench [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] warm, it'll be like sitting on a just-used toilet seat!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Gross, dude!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gross? Or comfy?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's do this, guys!

nodes.title: Girl Trouble
nodes.subtitle: Can Ben help Owen with his Paige problems?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Ben...
Before basketball practice starts, Ben gathers the team for a quick huddle. He catches a quick look of sadness on Owen's face...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... So... How's everyone doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale?! Did you just call a huddle to ask us about our feelings?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Lame.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look! I'm new to being Team Captain, okay?! Whenever I watch sports, the leaders are always huddling everyone up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I like it in here! Talk about cozy!
Jacob scoffs at Erik and turns to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're supposed to talk about what we're going to do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That makes a lotta sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Well, we're about to have our last practice before we play Wilson High. And everyone knows if we don't beat them, our season's over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course, if we win we go to Sectionals and have a chance to get revenge on Willow Glen!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So...
The music suddenly stops!
Everyone turns to see Paige's mother and soon-to-be stepfather standing in the foyer, aghast at the party before them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What dreadful sounds were coming out of these speakers?! You call that music?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Never mind `that!` What is this, Paige?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] What is this, Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not supposed to be back for another week!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `Surprise.` Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Surprise.[/i][/color] Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are my friends, mom.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ha! Now I know you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: This is exactly what I've been telling you about, Margot. The rebelliousness comes from her peers.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You're right. So right. This abomination here is the reason, Paige, why we decided you will no longer be attending that public school!
The partygoers gasp!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's why you'll be going `back` to Monarch Prep!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's why you'll be going [color=#3b78e2][i]back[/i][/color] to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 4: Girl Trouble!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 4, Episode 4: Girl Trouble![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Want to catch up?
Season 3: The Dance Dilemma is available in More Episodes now!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
`No one` has failed.
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]No one[/b] has failed.

nodes.text: That escalated quickly, didn't it?! Try playing the second half of the game and see if you can avoid that awful mess you just saw!

nodes.text: Okay, `that` was unexpected! But, then again, only a superhero could have caught that pass from Jacob!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [b]that[/b] was unexpected! But, then again, only a superhero could have caught that pass from Jacob!

nodes.text: If you want even more superhero action, check out the Super New Girl Bundle, available in More Episodes!
But now, let's see what happens when Owen `doesn't` catch that pass!
nodes.text_bbcode: But now, let's see what happens when Owen [b]doesn't[/b] catch that pass!

nodes.text: And yes, we know it's unprecedented, but we `are` asking you to get this one wrong! Humor us!
nodes.text_bbcode: And yes, we know it's unprecedented, but we [b]are[/b] asking you to get this one wrong! Humor us!
