nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Sowphelia panics, and her mind goes blank!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Shoot the arrow now!
She looses the arrow! It hits the grass!
Sowphelia and Hamlet gain on the car, its bumper just within hoof's reach...
Hamlet flutters his wings to send a huge blast of air at the tires, hoping to take the car out...
But the car is too durable! It doesn't even veer off course!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Can you move it?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's too big! Use the other arrow! Take out its tire!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But it's our last one!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Do we really have any other choice?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Oink... I guess not...
Sowphelia nods, takes out her bow and arrow, and aims for...
Sowphelia pumps her wings faster and gains on the car!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: So close... I just need a little more...
Sowphelia flaps her wings, bringing her closer to the car! She sees Hamlet follow suit...
Owen and Paige pull away from the market area with Sowphelia and Hamlet hovering invisibly behind them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where to?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We should probably head back. My mom and Tad went out for dinner, but they're probably going to get home soon.
The cupigs fly high above the couple, and that's when Sowphelia notices Tad and Margot in a car on a road parallel to Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Paige's parents! They're on their way home now too!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is the last chance for Owen and Paige to kiss and get together! We have to deal with them!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: On it!
Sowphelia and Hamlet veer away from Paige to fly after Margot and Tad's car.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We have to make it break down somehow! But it's going too fast!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to go faster!
Sowphelia grits her pig teeth and...
The arrow strikes the florist!
The florist is suddenly filled with the radiance of love. She looks over at a quiet, brown-haired clerk who works at the cheese counter opposite from hers.
She clasps her hands to her heart and flutters her eyelashes. She's still staring at him when Owen walks up to her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, hi. I was wondering about those roses in front...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Oh, those roses are perfect, aren't they? Just like `him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, those roses are perfect, aren't they? Just like [color=#3b78e2][i]him.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She looks dreamily above Owen's shoulder. Owen turns to see what she's looking at and spots the cheese clerk.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sure, I guess. I don't know him...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: I do. We have the same lunch break, and sometimes we talk. But it's never anything more than that.
She sighs.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Young man, do you know what love is?

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Oh, how silly of me. Of course you do. You're with that girl...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're not `really` anything more than just fr--
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] anything more than just fr--

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: It's okay. You don't have to tell me. I know. I'm in love myself.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: You know, I've been watching him the past four years I've worked here. And never once have I told him just how much he means to me.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: He's going away soon. Setting up shop somewhere else. I may never see him again...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: And even now, I can't gather up the courage to say something. I don't have the nerve.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandmother says that it's better to be scared and brave than confident and cowardly.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: You're right... Of course you're right. I owe it to both him and me to let him know how I feel. Especially now that he's leaving.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: You remember that now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Er, right...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: I'm going to close up shop and go over right now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So about those flowers...

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Just take them. Give them to the one you love.
Owen takes the bouquet as he and Paige are hurried out of the store.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's her hurry?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's in love.
Owen hands Paige the flowers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here you go. Sometimes all you have to do is ask.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thank you... They're even more beautiful now that I own them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure you actually learned a lesson here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, you can't always get something something.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Close enough... For you.
Hamlet playfully nudges Sowphelia.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Good aim.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Thanks!
The arrow strikes Owen!
Owen is suddenly filled with the radiance of love. Struck, he turns his head, and his gaze lands on a tall vase of flowers at the front of the store!
He stares at them in wonder.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen? What are you looking at?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: These flowers. They're `perfect.`
nodes.text_bbcode: These flowers. They're [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... `Perfect...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're `color blind.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you're [color=#3b78e2][i]color blind.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I `have` to get these. I love them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to get these. I love them.

nodes.text: Paige scowls as the cupigs look at one another.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What `is` wrong with him?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] wrong with him?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You know how the cupig's arrow instills great love in whosoever it pierces?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Well, in this case, it must've accidentally instilled a great love for the flowers Owen was looking at.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nothing's wrong with me! It's these `flowers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing's wrong with me! It's these [color=#e23b3b][i]flowers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're petunias!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Petunias'? What a great flower name! How much are they?

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: I'm so happy you enjoy that bouquet. It's seven dollars.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I only have five... But I'd be lost without them.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Well, you do seem to truly enjoy them... And it is Valentine's Day. I'll make them five for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh thank you!
Owen pays, and Paige drags him and his bouquet out of the flower shop.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you crazy?
Owen tears his gaze away from the flowers to Paige's face. He squints, then shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait, what just happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You just haggled a vendor down for `petunias!` And with the last of our money!
nodes.text_bbcode: You just haggled a vendor down for [color=#3b78e2][i]petunias![/i][/color] And with the last of our money!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I kind of remember that... But these flowers were just so nice.
He hands them to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I must have gotten them for you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're not roses... But okay.
Behind them, Sowphelia gives Hamlet a sorrowful look.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That went `terribly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That went [color=#3b78e2][i]terribly.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Hey, at last he got her flowers. Even if they're not the ones she wanted...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Owen!
Hamlet looses the arrow!
Half an hour later, Paige and Owen gather up their food and walk back into the downtown.
They pass by a flower stall, and Paige stops in front of a pail of pink roses.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really stopping to smell the roses?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, these are gorgeous. But I wouldn't expect you to recognize something with class.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And they smell amazing. How much are they?
The vendor tending the flowers looks up with a pleasant smile.

nodes.speaker: Florist
nodes.text: Fifteen for the bouquet...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You do remember that you don't have a credit card, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. Rub my face in it. How do you manage?
Owen checks his wallet and realizes he's on his last five dollars.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not much left...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But maybe this is a good lesson for you. Sometimes, you don't always get what you want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As a heart attack. It's a concept I'm sure you don't get at all... But it might make you a better person.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Sure.` Well, I may not be able to buy them, but I can still `shop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sure.[/i][/color] Well, I may not be able to buy them, but I can still [color=#3b78e2][i]shop![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige goes from bouquet to bouquet in the stall, admiring each bloom.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hamlet, this is perfect! They're in a `flower` shop, the place where love `blossoms`... He can buy her flowers!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hamlet, this is perfect! They're in a [color=#3b78e2][i]flower[/i][/color] shop, the place where love [color=#3b78e2][i]blossoms[/i][/color]... He can buy her flowers!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: With five dollars?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We'll think of something...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I can steal a bouquet and drop it off somewhere...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The flower vendor might think they did it, and nothing's going to kill the mood faster than one of them getting in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What about a Cupig's Arrow?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We only have `two`...
nodes.text_bbcode: We only have [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: And their date is nearly over. We're running out of time!
Hamlet shrugs and closes his eyes. A gilded bow primed with a heart-tipped arrow appears in his hooves.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Who do I aim for?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Aim for...
Aided by Hamlet's wings, the rain clouds drift over Paige and Owen. A light drizzle starts to fall from the skies, stopping their conversation.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The food!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget the food! What about my hair?! I `knew` I hated the outdoors!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget the food! What about my hair?! I [color=#3b78e2][i]knew[/i][/color] I hated the outdoors!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's get out of here before it gets worse!
Owen bundles up their meal, grabs Paige's hand, and leads her into the cover of some close trees.
From underneath thick branches, they look out at the falling rain together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got the food. How's the hair?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It'll manage.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So you seriously don't think you're a snob? You just tried to save your `hair.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you seriously don't think you're a snob? You just tried to save your [color=#e23b3b][i]hair.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige glares at him... Then suddenly, she laughs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, `fine.` So I'm not exactly low-maintenance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color] So I'm not exactly low-maintenance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Say it. You're a snob.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha, no way!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Say it! 'I am a snob'!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I will say `this...` You're still holding my hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: I will say [color=#3b78e2][i]this...[/i][/color] You're still holding my hand!

nodes.text: Owen drops it and wipes his hand on his shirt.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Gross. I feel slimy and rich.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Looks like you know a thing or two about setting the mood, Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I've learned from the best, Sowphelia.
They grin at one another, as Paige and Owen sit down on a fallen tree to wait the rain out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I know I flipped out, but maybe I just don't want to be seen like that, okay? That's how everyone at Monarch Prep is, and... I'll admit, it's going to be hard going back.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've gotten used to being at Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've even gotten used to you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There are no boys at Monarch Prep. And it's going to be boring if there's no one to make fun of.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm just your regular punching bag, am I?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. A punching bag puts up more of a fight.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, maybe it'd suck not having you around either. I mean, what am I going to do in Psych without you? Your life is so messed up.
Paige stares at him for a moment, as if trying to decide whether his sentence is funny or awful.
Then she starts laughing. And he joins in too.
When they quiet, they sit close to one another until the rain passes. From their vantage point in the trees, Sowphelia huddles happily next to Hamlet.
Aided by Hamlet's wings, the clouds part, clearing a swath of sunlight onto Paige and Owen's picnic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's getting bright out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, and I suppose now you're going to make jokes about how I need a dainty little umbrella to shade myself.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I didn't mean like that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't get it. I make fun of you all the time. Why are you being so sensitive about it now?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, can't we just talk about something else?
They sit in silence as Owen fumbles for what to say.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... You and this, uh, Monarch Prep thing, huh? What's that all about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, could you begin a painful conversation `more` awkwardly?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, could you begin a painful conversation [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] awkwardly?

nodes.text: Paige glares at him, and he shrugs uncomfortably.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Monarch Prep is my mom's way of getting rid of me so she can travel and play tongue polo with Tad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ew, well, that image just killed my appetite.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Welcome to my life.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And there's no way you can get out of this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course not. My mother's determined to get me out of her uptight French twist. I won't be able to back out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Besides, Monarch Prep's the better school. If I go there, I'm set. I have everything. My nice clothes, my private dorm, my spending accounts...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's probably good that I'm leaving.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't say that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What, are you going to miss me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, Psych `is` going to be a whole lot more boring without your messed up brain to analyze.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Psych [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] going to be a whole lot more boring without your messed up brain to analyze.

nodes.text: Sowphelia sees that it's the wrong thing to say as Paige rolls her eyes and slows her chewing so she won't have to talk.
With the warm sunlight beating down on them, Paige and Owen spend the rest of their meal in silence. From their vantage point in the trees, Sowphelia huddles sulkily next to Hamlet.
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly low, following Owen and Paige to their picnic spot in the park.
He sets down the grocery bag and spreads his jacket out, putting it on the ground for Paige to sit on.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you sure you're the same Owen? The Owen I know isn't this gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't need to know what every fork is to have good manners.
He plops down next to her and opens the grocery bag. They eat hungrily while they enjoy the view of the park.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who needs five-star food when you've got groceries?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyone who has standards?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not all of us can be so snobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not snobby!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You live in a four-story mansion and eat on plates of gold. You can't tell me you're not a prissy snob.
Above them, Sowphelia shoots Hamlet a worried glance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: They can't start fighting now... Not when they're in a beautiful park together!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's not fighting. They're just ribbing each other. It's like flirting.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure? Paige is a little `emotional`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure? Paige is a little [color=#3b78e2][i]emotional[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that really what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Do you have a problem with it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Usually, you love the fact that you're a mean rich girl who thinks she's better than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just because that's what I `am` doesn't mean I `like` being called that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because that's what I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] doesn't mean I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] being called that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You just don't get it...
Hamlet looks at Sowphelia worriedly.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Is there something we can throw at him? Or her?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: The clouds!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We can use the weather. There are rainy clouds over there... Or I can push them back and make it sunny.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: A warm sunny day might put them in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I say, let it rain.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not `romantic` to get cold and wet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]romantic[/i][/color] to get cold and wet!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: But there are a lot of good rainy scenes in the humans' romantic comedies...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hmm...
The phone rings. Ben moves to answer it, but Emily gives him a look that could freeze fire.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We're in the middle of something. If you answer that, I won't be coming to your Sectionals game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You know how important that game is to me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I would. Because `this` is that important, Ben. You need to have a relationship with `your` dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: I would. Because [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] is that important, Ben. You need to have a relationship with [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] dad.

nodes.text: Ben doesn't hesitate. He answers the phone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's up, Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm so glad you answered! I know we're not best friends or anything, but I'm in a bind! I'm having trouble with Sam, she--
Emily reaches over and snatches the phone out of Ben's hand.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do all boys not understand girls? Tell her the truth, you idiot!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And stop calling! Ben and I are either on a very romantic date, or we're about to be arrested for public disturbance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Time. Will. Tell.
Emily hangs up. She and Ben stare at each other, neither backing down.
He has failed.
Nick and Sam might never know what would have happened if Nick had kept up the lie, but that doesn't mean `you` won't!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nick and Sam might never know what would have happened if Nick had kept up the lie, but that doesn't mean [b]you[/b] won't!

nodes.text: Find out what happens when Nick calls Spencer right now!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Ben takes a deep breath and feels some of his anger subside.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just don't want to talk about this right now, Emily. We might say something we'll regret.
Ben goes right on arguing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, then maybe I don't need you!
The hurt immediately registers on Emily's face.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You don't mean that... But I know one thing. You need me `a lot more` than I need you.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't mean that... But I know one thing. You need me [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot more[/i][/color] than I need you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that so?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Will you excuse me for a minute? I need to run to the restroom real quick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure.
Sam walks out of the shop toward some nearby restrooms. The shopkeep comes out of the backroom, tears in her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I heard everything. How could you? How could you, Nick?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Listen, it's more complicated than you think.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Aha! Then it is love!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: To be honest, I don't know anymore...
Nick steps out of the shop. He takes out his phone and calls Ben...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I bet things are going a lot better for Ben...
You are now playing as Ben...
And he's in the middle of a fight with Emily!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! They're not!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They're not the same thing at all!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How is talking to `my` father any easier than talking to yours?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How is talking to [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] father any easier than talking to yours?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because your father's actually around!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What difference does it make?! Just to refresh your memory... My dad isn't exactly Mr. Sunshine.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least if I had to talk to him, I'd know what I was getting! I'd know how to deal with it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's `a lot` harder to have a serious conversation with a stranger!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] harder to have a serious conversation with a stranger!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're being `way` too dramatic about this! Your dad isn't a stranger, Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're being [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too dramatic about this! Your dad isn't a stranger, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: All I'm asking is that you sit down and have a talk with him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know what you're asking, but I think it's a bad idea!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because! My dad and I `don't` talk. I go to school. He goes to work. That's the way it's always been!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because! My dad and I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] talk. I go to school. He goes to work. That's the way it's always been!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Which is exactly the problem!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stop pretending like you know me so well! You know me now, but you don't know what I've been through!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know you? I know you, Ben. I know this bothers you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Leave. It. Alone.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No! I'm not going to let this slide. I'm not going to give it the Kale treatment.
Ben feels the fury of his anger rising up inside him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? It sounded pretty romantic to me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's, uh, that's probably because you've got Valentine's on your mind.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I totally see how you could misinterpret it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about 'All I ask, I ask for you, this Valentine's?'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That... That `sounds` very romantic. But, uh, it actually just means I'd like you with me on Valentine's.
nodes.text_bbcode: That... That [color=#e23b3b][i]sounds[/i][/color] very romantic. But, uh, it actually just means I'd like you with me on Valentine's.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Cause that's not romantic.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As friends! I meant because without you, you know, I might be thinking about how I'm alone on Valentine's... Which sucks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, it does.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... Cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, cool. I guess...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The 'you' is actually Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So 'the rocky times?'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, past Valentine's Days.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And crossing unbreakable lines?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know... I was just looking for a rhyme.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't even rhyme.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It would rhyme in a rap song.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about 'what we have, it must be real,' and the whole strong steel bit?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was being ironic, since I hate Valentine's so much. Such a dumb day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then I guess I don't get Anti-Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought it was supposed to be a fun way of spending time together on Valentine's Day as friends.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It... It is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, whatever this was, it sucked.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll show you.
Nick picks up a piece of chocolate and unceremoniously tosses it at Sam's face! It grazes her cheek and skitters across the floor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! You little twerp!
She flashes Nick a devilish smile as she picks up a nearby piece of chocolate from among the samples and throws it at Nick. It ricochets off his glasses!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know what this means, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chocolate war!
In a flash, Nick and Sam both snatch up handfuls of the chocolate, peppering each other with them!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait! Cease fire! Cease fire!
Sam stops. Her arm poised to throw another piece.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're... We're kind of creating a mess here...
Nick gestures to the shopkeeper who is giving them an angry look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...
Sam lowers her arm.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: End the cease fire!
Nick tosses a handful of chocolate pieces at Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You cheater!
As Sam whirls to go on the offensive, she catches a chocolate piece right in her mouth! Both of them immediately stop, their eyes wide!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha! No way! Did that just happen?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmm-hmmf! It torary did!
Nick puts a hand on Sam's shoulder, trying to brace himself from laughing too hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Nick quickly removes his hand. Sam leans back away from him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, uh, hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I just got a call from Taylor. She needs to meet up with me about funding for the theater department.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I think I have to bail on Anti-Valentine's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Life of a Social Chair!
$ZOE gives both Nick and Sam quick hugs goodbye and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That was sudden.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE's been like that lately. One minute she's here, the next she's gone.
The shopkeeper comes over and starts to sweep up Nick and Sam's mess.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, we're sorry. We got a little carried away. We'll clean it up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And we'll reimburse you for it!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: What's the point of throwing chocolate?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick and I just got a little carried away!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Wait! Wait! Wait! `You're` Nick?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! Wait! Wait! [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] Nick?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh no! I forgot to cancel the order!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: When I saw the love note you left for your true love, Samantha, I couldn't help myself!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I read it to all the girls who work here! And when I finished reading it, they all sighed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's a love note?

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: You must be Samantha! Oh my goodness!

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I'll go get the note... And my camera!
The shopkeeper scurries off, still talking from the backroom.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: And my scrapbook!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What does this note say?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's not what you think!
The shopkeeper returns holding a box of chocolates, with a note attached to it.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Can I read it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think that's really neces--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. Read it. Definitely read it.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Okay...
The shopkeeper's hands shake as she unfolds the note and gently clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'My dear Samantha...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'Though I've taken you through rocky times...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'Though I've walked across unbreakable lines...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'What we have, it must be real...'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'Stronger than the strongest steel.'

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: 'So all I ask, I ask for you, this Valentine's.'
The shopkeeper lets out a satisfied sigh.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I'll leave you two alone.
She takes a picture of Nick and Sam and then leaves, singing softly, a beaming smile across her face.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got `a lot` of explaining to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've got [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of explaining to do!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's really not what you think!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh really? 'Cause I `think` you wrote me a love poem and attached it to some chocolates!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? 'Cause I [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] you wrote me a love poem and attached it to some chocolates!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's exactly it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not exactly it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then `what` exactly is it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] exactly is it?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... It isn't a love poem.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's a...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds fun, but I don't understand... Won't that be really hard with the blindfolds on?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe... We should at least try it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That could be fun!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah!
The shopkeeper sets out an assortment of chocolate samples...
Nick wraps his sweater over his eyes, and Sam does the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is stupid.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Or not...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, it's stupid.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I'll throw first...
Nick reaches out in front of him, trying to find a chocolate piece.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How long do I have to sit here with my mouth open like an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not long. Sorry.
Nick grabs a piece of chocolate...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Here we go! Three! Two! One!
He tosses it blindly into the air!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow! You bounced that off of my head!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I admit it. The blindfolds are a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But the throwing isn't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll throw first.
Nick grabs a handful of chocolates.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ready!
He tosses a chocolate into the air...
And Sam catches it in her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My turn to throw!
Sam takes a chocolate from the display and tosses it up for Nick...
It goes over his head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fail!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: On who?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: On you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No way! That was not a catchable chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not for an amateur catcher such as yourself.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Amateur?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, let me get this straight... Your alternative to us wearing blindfolds and hand feeding each other chocolate is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Us wearing blindfolds and hand feeding each other chocolate?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So let me get this straight... Your alternative to us wearing blindfolds and hand feeding each other chocolate is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Getting rid of the blindfolds?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Think about it... It's `so` Valentine's it becomes Anti-Valentine's!
nodes.text_bbcode: Think about it... It's [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] Valentine's it becomes Anti-Valentine's!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, no. I don't think it works that way. And did you not hear me talk about vomiting two seconds ago?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, but this time, no blindfolds!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I get it. Now I'll be able to see myself vomiting.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: No, miss! No vomiting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, lady! I am `not` going to vomit in your store!
nodes.text_bbcode: Relax, lady! I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to vomit in your store!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not unless he tries to jam his warm, chocolate-y fingers into my mouth!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Got it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know what we could do instead?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that? And it better be a lot smarter than your last idea...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Kind of crazy, but we could still hand feed each other!

options.label: Throw food in each other's mouths!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... But?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But we...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay! And?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And we...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, we'll probably still blindfold each other...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... But?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But we...
You are now playing as Nick...
After a short drive, Nick, Sam, and $ZOE reach `Chocolateria,` a downtown chocolate shop.
nodes.text_bbcode: After a short drive, Nick, Sam, and $ZOE reach [b]Chocolateria,[/b] a downtown chocolate shop.

nodes.text: As soon as they step in, the sweet aroma of chocolate brings smiles to their faces.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: I'll be with you in just a moment...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Chocolate. Paradise. Must. Eat. All.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think this place broke Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think so!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... You're sure you're okay with me tagging along?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? I had to ask!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Like I said on the way over, it's okay. Of course you can be here. It's not like this is a date!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's really more of an outing...
Sam mouths the word 'See!' to $ZOE, but she's distracted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oooh! Look! Chocolate marshmallow rabbits!
$ZOE wanders off. Nick walks to Sam, who is eying the display case.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Would you like to try a sample?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, does a bear knit in the woods?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, Sam, just so you know, I don't think that's the phrase...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. I'm a girl. Just give me chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Sure thing.
The shopkeeper disappears in the back room.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is `way` better than what I had originally planned. No box of chocolates. No love note. No obvious romance.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] better than what I had originally planned. No box of chocolates. No love note. No obvious romance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, how do we anti-Valentine's this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I think if this were a proper date, we'd hand feed each other chocolate samples while blindfolded.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. I didn't think it was possible to want to vomit inside a chocolate shop.

nodes.speaker: Chocolate Shop Owner
nodes.text: Please, miss, go outside if you're going to--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry! Just an expression!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess the anti-Valentine's version of this means we...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Having three people on a date would be a little awkward, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, but I also know my cousin. You're clever, Sam. And having me come along ensures that you don't risk getting hurt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All I heard there was you saying I'm clever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Face it. You want me along because if I'm there, it's definitely not a date.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're afraid that if I don't come, there's a chance something could happen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's... That's not true at all.
Sam throws on a faded, yellow top.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then again, if you really thought this was a date, you'd probably be wearing cuter clothes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm trying very hard to remember that you think I'm clever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And perfume.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great, now you're saying I smell?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! But I `am` saying that I'll come along... Just let me finish putting on my make-up.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! But I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] saying that I'll come along... Just let me finish putting on my make-up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd wear my nice heels, a much hotter top than this, and the jasmine perfume I got for Christmas. But look...
Sam does a half-hearted spin, her arms extended.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My comfy shoes, a casual but not too casual top, and no perfume.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true... You do smell like you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what does that smell like?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So good! Roses and lavender! So `so` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: So good! Roses and lavender! So [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're a horrible liar. So you'll come then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, all right, I'll come! Let me just put on the finishing touches of my Anti-Valentine's Day make-up!
You are now playing as Sam...
Fifteen minutes later...
$ZOE comes into Sam's room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's here, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, and he looks... `Good.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, and he looks... [color=#3b78e2][i]Good.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? That's weird. Does that mean I'm underdressed?
Sam steps into a comfortable but dull pair of shoes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think we both are. Are you sure I should come to this thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's picking you up, he looks nice, and you're nervous. It `feels` an awful lot like a date.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's picking you up, he looks nice, and you're nervous. It [color=#3b78e2][i]feels[/i][/color] an awful lot like a date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're just friends, $ZOE! Nothing's going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on! He practically painted the lines of the friend zone with this Anti-Valentine's thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But don't you think it's another sign that your fortune's going to come true?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You're still going on about Madame Fortuna's fortune? That was like three months ago!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But she said you'd find love on a Friday between February 8th and February 15th!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She also said there'd be sparks! Have you seen any sparks this week?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! Everywhere!
Earlier that week...
Sam and $ZOE walk by a construction site just as a bandsaw goes to work on a piece of metal. The sparks fly out!
$ZOE nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?
Later that week...
They're walking through the mall when...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Get your fireworks here! Get your very legal fireworks here! No need to tell the cops!
Ryan lights one of the sparklers on fire!
$ZOE nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew!
Yesterday...
As they're about to head off to school, they see their neighbor scooping up the morning paper.
A cat comes running out.

nodes.speaker: Sparkles
nodes.text: Mrow!

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Bad Sparkles! Bad! Back inside!

nodes.speaker: Sparkles
nodes.text: Mrow!
$ZOE nudges Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you hear that kitten's name?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow... I nudge you `a lot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... I nudge you [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd like to think that when Madame Fortuna read me my fortune, she wasn't referring to Sparkles the Kitten.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, that one might be a reach, but still, this is the time when she said you'd find love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She was wrong. Face it. You're just trying to make things fit with her prediction.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today is the last day... I don't think Nick and I are going to fall in love at Cowboy Burger in one night!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Based on our history, he's lucky we're even friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, if this were a real date...

nodes.prompt: If this were a real date...

options.label: I wouldn't ask you to come along.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If this were a real date...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you're saying that a `chocolate shop` isn't romantic?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're saying that a [color=#3b78e2][i]chocolate shop[/i][/color] isn't romantic?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Yes, it seems that that's exactly what I'm saying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please explain whatever ludicrous viewpoint you have on chocolate shops.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, chocolate shops are filled with allergy catalysts. Nuts, for example.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chocolate shops usually operate at warm, humid temperatures, making everyone in them sweaty.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And while I'm on the subject, people love chocolate, which means crowds. Annoying, consumer-filled crowds.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. Just taking the fun out of everything, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess you're the type of person who finds allergies, sweat, and long lines romantic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what you're up to Nick Brown, but fine, I'll go along with it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm... I'm on the way. I should be at your place in ten minutes. Cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. See you then.
Sam hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She didn't buy any of that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If we went to places that weren't romantic, today wouldn't really be Anti-Valentine's Day. It'd just be any old day...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's a good point...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In order to do Anti-Valentine's Day right, you have to do Valentine's Day stuff, but in a way that's completely platonic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like that! I just got a lot more excited for this!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good. By the way, I should be at your place in ten minutes. Cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. See you soon!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben seemed odd and unusually adamant about calling. I guess I could always talk to Spencer on the way over to Sam's house...
Nick texts Sam that he's running late...
He spends the next minute racing about, getting ready!
Later, on the way to Sam's house, he gets Spencer up to speed.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...And I'm supposed to call her back so I need your help quick!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude! Ben's on a date with Emily... Of course he said that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Emily's probably right there next to him, drinking soda out of the same straw!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're saying Ben was compromised?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He did everything but fire a signal flare!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, uh, you dated Sam. Should I tell her that I want this to be a date?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Noooo! Do `not` do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Noooo! Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] do that!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? Is the idea that bad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you want to get your face punched or you enjoy an ice-water bath, go for it, dude! Bare your weird soul!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Cause chicks love it when guys they don't trust spring dates on them!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I see the point you're making.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good. You'll get your moment, but it isn't now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do I do until then?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The only thing you can, man. You've got to push this thing you promised. You know, just be like...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Samface, we're celebrating not-Valentine's! Here's a black flower. Don't you like my sad man make-up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's listen to disco on my '90's CD player!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't really know what a hipster is, do you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No clue. But I do know that for now you have to keep how you feel about Samface in the dark.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not going to be easy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, it isn't. Deal with it.
Nick's phone buzzes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's Sam on the other line! I gotta go.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good luck. And Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you hurt her, I'll turn you into a stuffed teddy bear. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, the message was subtle, but I think I got it.
Spencer hangs up, and Nick answers Sam's call.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think I can really trust Spencer... And Ben's advice seems sound enough. I should tell her the truth.
A few minutes later, Nick is standing on the front porch of Sam's house.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ready for our Anti-Valentine's Day non-date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, Sam, I had to get here as soon as I could so that I could tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Tell me what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The truth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I want a second chance. I know I blew it the first time, and I know I don't deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I couldn't help how I felt then, and I can't help how I feel now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I want to go out with you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! What happened to Anti-Valentine's Day?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's a lie! It's all just an excuse to spend time with you! But I couldn't go through with it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I couldn't manipulate you like that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I want to go out with you today... Tonight... Right now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: On a `real` Valentine's Day date! What do you say?
nodes.text_bbcode: On a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] Valentine's Day date! What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. I don't want to go out with you, Nick. I was interested in Anti-Valentine's Day...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... We'll do that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, I was interested in it back when it was all about us hanging out together `as friends.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I was interested in it back when it was all about us hanging out together [color=#3b78e2][i]as friends.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But not anymore?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think it would be a little awkward now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. But... But what if I hadn't said anything? If I had just gone through with the lie?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Honestly, who knows what might have happened? It doesn't matter, does it? Because we'll never know.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess we'll never know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See you at school.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: See ya.
Sam closes the door, and Nick trudges away, knowing full well that...
You are now playing as Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Pick up! Come on, Ben! Answer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Nick! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ben! I'm in trouble, and you have a girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, at the moment, yes. Why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I need advice from someone with a girlfriend! I told Sam that I'd take her out on an Anti-Valentine's Day hangout...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But while I was planning it, it kind of turned into an `actual` Valentine's Day date.
nodes.text_bbcode: But while I was planning it, it kind of turned into an [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] Valentine's Day date.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How'd that happen?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know! One second I was making ironic reservations at Cowboy Burger, and the next thing I knew I had booked a table at `Les Horribles.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know! One second I was making ironic reservations at Cowboy Burger, and the next thing I knew I had booked a table at [color=#e23b3b][i]Les Horribles.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That French restaurant where everyone sings and acts sad? It's impossible to get a table there! How'd you do it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just told them I was bringing the girl my heart betrayed. They said they'd make a table for me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This sounds `way` dangerous. Can't you get out of it?
nodes.text_bbcode: This sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] dangerous. Can't you get out of it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! It's too late! I'm picking her up in like...
Nick panics as he looks at his vintage, cartoon character wrist-watch.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh no! I've gotta pick her up like right now, and I'm not ready!
He scrambles to his closet, yanking his outfit down off the hanger!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Can you help me, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That depends... What exactly do you want with Sam? Do you want to be good friends? Or do you want this to be a date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I want this to be a date. But should I tell `her` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I want this to be a date. But should I tell [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Ben looks across the table at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You should probably call Spencer about that. But if you want `my` advice, I'd tell the truth.
nodes.text_bbcode: You should probably call Spencer about that. But if you want [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] advice, I'd tell the truth.

nodes.text: Emily nods.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem. I'm with Emily `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem. I'm with Emily [color=#e23b3b][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, uh, you should always tell the truth to girls you're dating. If you want another opinion, `call Spencer.` Got that?
nodes.text_bbcode: But, uh, you should always tell the truth to girls you're dating. If you want another opinion, [color=#e23b3b][i]call Spencer.[/i][/color] Got that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're sure I should tell her? Sam might flip out and--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Call. Spencer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Call. Spencer.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben hangs up. Nick starts putting on his date outfit.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do I really want to call Spencer? He and Sam used to date, and I've gotta pick her up in like... Negative two minutes!

options.label: Follow Ben's advice and tell Sam the truth.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel like both of us are starting to get upset.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sometimes it's good to take a step back.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess so. I wouldn't want to say something I'd regret.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Exactly. I was one second away from insulting your mother.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee. Answer the phone already.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nick would only call me if something was really wrong.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess the person who never calls you is more important than the person who calls you `every` day.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess the person who never calls you is more important than the person who calls you [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on... It's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Whatever. Just answer the phone already.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Listen, can I call you back?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Suuuuure.
Nick hangs up and frantically makes a call...
You are now playing as Ben...
Meanwhile, Ben and Emily are having a Valentine's Day date of their own in the park.
Fancy tea cups are set up between them on a table beneath the park's gazebo.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think? Not a bad date, right? Right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, Colonel Insecure. Relax, would you? I'm having a great time!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How could I not when there are crumpets to eat?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, I guess I wanted to make sure we were still good after our fight about, you know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me becoming your dad's BFF because my dad is never around.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Of course we're good!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But when did we get so deep?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Are you going to talk to him?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee. No, silly. I was talking about yours.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why would I talk to my dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How about the fact that there's obviously a huge, elephant-sized issue between the two of you?!
Ben's phone rings. He checks and sees that it's Nick.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you really going to take that call in the middle of this discussion?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, but only because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'a chocolate shop'?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'a fancy restaurant'?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Out on the town?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yup. Out... On the town!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, that sounds nice!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It does.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it also sounds like we're about to start a Broadway musical number.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Could I get a little bit more from you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... A chocolate shop?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you say 'a chocolate shop'?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.title: Anti-Valentine's Day
nodes.subtitle: Will Nick be the one for Sam?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nick...
After school on Valentine's Day, Nick paces back and forth across his room!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What did you do, Nick?!
The phone rings. He sees that it's Sam and takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Keep it together. Don't say anything about the chocolate shop or the fancy restaurant you booked for tonight!
He answers the phone.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. You're not getting cold feet, are you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Last I checked, this isn't a wedding.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know, you `can` get cold feet for things other than weddings.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, you [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] get cold feet for things other than weddings.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. Birthdays, dances, icy foot baths.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll give you that last one. Anyway, I don't have cold feet. It's just...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'll admit this is my first Anti-Valentine's Day non-date.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Such a sheltered life you lead... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just wondering what I'm supposed to wear to this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whatever. Nice but not too nice. Casual but not too casual.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Helpful. What are you wearing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Um...
Nick stares at an outfit hanging in his closet... A dark, formal shirt and a pair of black slacks.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The, uh, the usual.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to wear skinny jeans, so that doesn't help. Where are we going, anyway?
Nick leaps, jumps, and bounds his way through the chocolate minefield!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Phew!
He finds an empty street, no trace of Sam anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She... She got away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't get a chance to explain to her how I feel.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And now...
Nick hangs his head and turns back toward the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now it'll be completely awkward at school.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Any chance I had to be more than friends just disappeared...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Along with a chance of even being friends.
It's pretty clear...
Inside, he discovers a quiet, darkened room.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam? You in here?
Nick creeps forward, hoping his eyes will adjust.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't see a thing...
His foot slips off a small ledge!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ack!
`Sploosh!` His leg is suddenly knee-deep in water!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Sploosh![/b] His leg is suddenly knee-deep in water!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What the! Where am I?
Nick reaches the edge of the water and climbs up onto a ledge. Unseen hands pull him up to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You caught me. Now what?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam! Where are we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind that! You lied to me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I did.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?!
Sam grabs him by the shirt, threatening to dump him back into the water.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay! Okay! I was worried that if we really went through with Anti-Valentine's Day, you'd think we were friends and nothing more.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'd be stuck, you know, in--
Sam lets him go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In the friendzone?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah. What was I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about just ask me out on a date?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Would you have said yes? Honestly?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So then it didn't matter what I did... At least this way I tried!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean `you lied!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean [color=#3b78e2][i]you lied![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which we just established was the only way you'd go out with me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So tonight `was` a date then?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So tonight [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a date then?!

nodes.text: Nick sighs...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Date. Not a date. I don't know... I think the real question is which did you want it to be?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because I know `exactly` what I wanted tonight to be, Sam... Do you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I know [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what I wanted tonight to be, Sam... Do you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... That... That's not important!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Come on, Sam. Why'd you even sit down with me at the restaurant tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I sat down because... Because you asked me! Because...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The Sam I know would never do that unless she thought that we actually have something... Something real.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Something new this time around, something special...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what's that?
A voice calls out in the darkness...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Give it a shot now, Earl, I think the power's back on!
Nick and Sam are standing on a maintenance platform beneath a sign that says `Tunnel of Love`. Around them is a flowing river with several boats stranded in the water.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nick and Sam are standing on a maintenance platform beneath a sign that says [b]Tunnel of Love[/b]. Around them is a flowing river with several boats stranded in the water.

nodes.text: Each boat has an electric lead, a long pole that rubs flush with a mesh of metal overhead. Sparks burst from each lead, blooming like flowery fireworks and raining down all around Nick and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, what we have... `Is a spark.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, what we have... [color=#e23b3b][i]Is a spark.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's... There's no way you could have planned this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't!
A voice calls out from one of the boats...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo hipster, kiss her already!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How is Sam going to kiss herself, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm talking to Nick...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, duh! Kiss her, hot guy!
As the sparks continue to burst around them, Nick leans in and kisses Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like Madame Fortuna's fortune came true.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You knew about it?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... I know about the one she gave me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Oh, of course. What was it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That I'd find love doing what I love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, isn't 'what you love' photography?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What I love most is spending time with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha! Okay, that was pretty smooth.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How could I not love spending time with you with this new perfume you're wearing?!
Sam blushes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You smell like jasmine... Have you been wearing it all night?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I put it on when I went to the restroom. Can you do me a favor?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't mention the perfume to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. Question for you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you hungry?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Starving. I'm really regretting running out before the entree got there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Want to go to Cowboy Burger?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick Brown, are you asking me out on a date?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I am, Sam. I am.

nodes.text: It's okay, Monte Carlos! Forget about him!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh! Wrong!
He runs away as fast as he can! When he passes the carriage...
The carriage trots in front of him, blocking his path.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam's getting away!
Nick runs around the back of the carriage and...
Nick hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like I'm waiting here...
Nick steps on a piece of chocolate, his feet start to slip...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoop!
...But he regains his balance, as he leaps toward another patch of open concrete...
Only to watch in horror as a chocolate candy rolls into the space his foot is heading!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh oh!
His foot lands squarely on the chocolate and slides out from under him, sending his body flying through the air!
He crashes down on his back a split second later!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Slowly, he gets back on his feet...

nodes.text: Nick runs after her!

Nick puts on the brakes just in time!

$Travis points down the street, where Sam is sprinting away!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, flower guy!
Nick flies into a display of roses!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! I spent all morning making those look nice!
Nick sees Sam far away down the street! He scrambles to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry!
Hesitant, Nick closes his eyes and leaps to the side!
Sam glares daggers at Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I can't believe you did this!
She tosses her glass of water in Nick's face and storms out of the restaurant!

nodes.text: Sam, I know you're going to be upset, but this whole night's been a lie.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just wanted to take you out for a romantic night... And this ruse was the only way I could do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... You lied to me?!

nodes.text: Yes, but I only lied to you because--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry! It's just that--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait... Are you at the gym?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not all of us have fake dates, Brown! What happened with Sam?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wooed her. Then she doused me with water.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's gone?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She just ran out of here...

nodes.text: Even after you told her how you feel?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not exactly. I started to, but I ran out of time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... She ran before you could say anything? And you're sitting there talking to me? Are you an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Chase after her, man! Tell her how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How do I know she won't punch me like you said? Or throw more water on me? Or drown me in a lake?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't! Loving chicks means risking drowning!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It does? You know, you should write a book...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I should go after Sam!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, Nick, one more thing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know! I know! If I hurt her... You'll turn my intestines into a bouquet of flowers.

nodes.text: Wait, Sam! Please!
