nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grr! If I had been in, that wouldn't have happened!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Yeah, but you're not in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm sorry!
As Lars drives to the hoop, Erik trips!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoopsy doop!
Lars lays the ball in!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It may not seem like it, but that's `your` fault, Kale!
nodes.text_bbcode: It may not seem like it, but that's [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] fault, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It is?
Tensions rise as both teams battle back and forth!
Midway through the quarter, Ben gets called for a foul.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! You're out! Erikson! Get in there!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Looks like I'm getting my wish! Buh-bye, Weak Link!
Ben runs over to Coach...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why are you taking me out?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That was your fourth foul, Kale. One more and you're out. And we can't have you fouling out before the fourth quarter even starts!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Rest up. We'll need you. And don't get all mopey!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: The team feeds off `your` energy! You want to be a leader? Lead now!
nodes.text_bbcode: The team feeds off [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] energy! You want to be a leader? Lead now!

nodes.text: On the next play, Erik tries to make a tough pass, but Lars steals it!
At the end of the first half, Twin Branches is ahead by five points!
Lars smiles as he crosses over to his left hand!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: You're on! I can do anything with you guarding me!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's see it!
Lars dribbles in with his left hand and pulls up for an awkward left-handed shot!
It ricochets off the backboard hard, and Spencer snatches it out of the air!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Mine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe you can't do `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you can't do [color=#e23b3b][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Grr!
Lars grits his teeth and accelerates right past Ben!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Outta my way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa!
He flips the ball up into the hoop for an easy layup!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: I can do anything against `you`, Weak Link!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can do anything against [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color], Weak Link!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess dribbling past a guy doesn't require much thought...
In the second quarter, both teams are already starting to tire...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm exhausted! But if I'm exhausted, that means Lars is too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that means it'll be easy to psych him out!
Lars dribbles the ball up for Willow Glen...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Lars, bet you can't...
Ben takes a long three-point shot, but the ball clangs off the rim!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've just gotta keep shooting three-pointers, I guess...
Ben keeps taking outside shots, but his accuracy does not improve!
By the end of the quarter, Twin Branches is down by seven!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I can't score, maybe someone else can...
Ben passes the ball to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why are you passing it to me?!
Owen takes a shot, but the ball doesn't go in!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Why are you passing it to Owen?! `You` should be the one shooting!
nodes.text_bbcode: Kale! Why are you passing it to Owen?! [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] should be the one shooting!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So much for that plan...
By the end of the quarter, Twin Branches is down by seven!
Ben dribbles in for a closer shot and sinks a mid-range jumper!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Good shot, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's how you gain confidence!
By the end of the quarter, Twin Branches is ahead by two!
From the get-go, it's clear that both teams are evenly matched, and that the game is going to be a fight...
But without Emily's support, Ben is struggling!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't make `any` outside shots!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't make [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] outside shots!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Hey, Weak Link... Maybe you should have the kid with the glasses sub in for you! Hey, Glasses, why don't you sub in?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My name's not Glasses! And I don't fraternize with enemies!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Too bad, Weak Link. I bet Glasses can see the hoop better than you can!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've gotta find a way to score!
Midway through the first quarter, Ben catches the ball at the three-point line...

options.label: Dribble in for a closer shot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess she's not coming...
Ben lunges forward, shoving Lars back!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: That's it!
The ref blows hard on his whistle and makes an emphatic 'T' gesture with his hands.

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Technical Foul! Number 32 on Twin Branches! Unsportsmanlike conduct! One free throw for Willow Glen!
Lars takes the ball from the ref and makes the free throw, putting Willow Glen ahead by 1.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! How'd you manage to give them a point before the first tip?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He tricked me, that's all!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe we're losing before we've even played!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Get your head in the game, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Anyone could have seen that trap! Even me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah yeah! One eye, I get it!
As the guys deride Ben, he looks up into the stands, but he doesn't see Emily...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Wow. So since molecules are made up of atoms, I `am` superior to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. So since molecules are made up of atoms, I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] superior to you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, uh...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Glad you agree with me, Weak Link!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grr!
The ref returns and goes over his notes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe I let Lars get to me!
While Ben fumes, he looks into the stands, but he doesn't see Emily...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Too stupid to wrap your head around an analogy?
Furious, Lars lunges forward to push Ben again, but the ref is there to stop him!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Oh no you don't!
The ref blows hard on his whistle and makes an emphatic 'T' gesture with his hands.

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Technical Foul! Number 1 on Willow Glen! Unsportsmanlike conduct! One free throw for Twin Branches!
Ben takes the ball from the ref and makes the free throw, putting Twin Branches ahead by 1.
Ben returns to the team...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, Kale, you'll have to teach me how you get a lead before opening tip-off!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just a little pre-game psychology, that's all!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I bet his teammates are all kinds of angry!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He won't be invited back to their book club, that's for sure!
As the guys congratulate Ben, he looks up into the stands, but he doesn't see Emily...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: To what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To... An atom!
Ben keeps his cool and doesn't retaliate...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stay calm, Ben...
Turning away from them again, the ref rummages through a bag near the scorekeeper's bench...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: That's what I thought. It must feel pretty awful knowing that I'm both your physical `and` intellectual superior.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I thought. It must feel pretty awful knowing that I'm both your physical [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] intellectual superior.

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Found it!
As the ref jogs back to the boys, Ben has just enough time to slip in his comeback...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're about as superior to me as a molecule is to...
Ben hesitates for a second, letting his anger seethe through him...
Then he lunges forward, shoving Lars back!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Anyway, a couple of notes about the rules...
The ref reaches into his pocket but can't seem to find what he's looking for.

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Mustard! I've left my notes back at the bench. One moment, gentlemen!
As soon as the ref turns his back...
Lars steps over the halfcourt line and shoves Ben!
The Twin Branches fans in the stands boo, causing the ref to turn back to the boys...
Ben blinks first, and Lars cracks a wicked smile.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: That's what I thought, Weak Link!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Something got in my eye!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Yeah, weakness! Weakness runs through you! The same weakness that's going to cost you the game!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Okay, okay, break it up, gentlemen!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: I don't want to have to give either of you a technical foul before the game even starts!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Okay, okay, break it up, gentlemen!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: I don't want to have to give either of you a technical foul before the game even starts!
Lars blinks first! He takes an inadvertent step backward.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: You flinched at me or something!
Then he tries to play it off...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: I was just trying to avoid getting that technical foul...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you succeeded.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Don't look so smug!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry so much! I'm pretty sure Paige will make it to the game. She won't miss it, no matter how mad at you she is!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not so sure...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on. The game's starting soon. Let's get you back...
They drive off toward Twin Branches...
You are now playing as Ben...
Later...
It's two minutes before tip-off! The referee blows the whistle and asks for the team captains to meet at halfcourt.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ben! Get your butt out there!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't let that Lars jerk psych you out, Ben. Be tough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got it. Thanks.
Ben runs out to halfcourt. Willow Glen's star player, Lars, meets him.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Saw you warming up... Can you even jump? It looks like you're experiencing Jupiter's gravity over there!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you look like you're a black hole... Since everything you do sucks.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Technically, nothing sucks. But you're too dense to know that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dense? Ha! You're so dense you'd sink in a vat of osmium!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Grr!
They get right in each other's face, their eyes locked for ten intense seconds!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I guess that is the silver lining of this really dark cloud.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nice to remind yourself from time to time that you don't have malaria.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For the perspective... And the chuckle. I needed that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe the word you were looking for was 'horrible'...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Or 'awful'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Or 'disasterful'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Not a word.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever. The point is... This sucks, and not even you can spin this positively!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just can't believe she would send something like this... `In a text!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just can't believe she would send something like this... [color=#e23b3b][i]In a text![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen cues it up again and shows $ZOE. It says: 'Owen, stop texting. I don't ever want to talk to you again. Delete my number.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It doesn't even sound like her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you `know` Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, the message

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And usually, I can't understand half the words she uses... But this is so... Formal.
They both get out of the car and walk to the front gate... Owen nudges it, and it opens without resistance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hmm... Security is usually a little tighter.
They step inside the gate toward the front doors.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... You and Paige have texted a lot?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Some.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess you care about each other...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, now I'm not so sure. `I` care about `her.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, now I'm not so sure. [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] care about [color=#e23b3b][i]her.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: They reach the front doors, and Owen knocks.
A minute passes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think anyone's home.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think anyone is either... But I have to know for sure!
Owen walks around the side of the house... And starts scaling a tall trellis!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, what are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Her room's up here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He knows which room is hers!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, be careful!
A moment later, Owen climbs back down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No sign of her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like I can feel Owen's heartbreak from over here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, it's going to be okay...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is it? 'Cause it doesn't seem like things are okay...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She didn't show up to school, she sent me an insulting text that doesn't sound like her, and from the looks of things...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Her house is abandoned. What about this makes you think things are going to be okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I know you do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of course. I'm pretty sure helping me find Paige is, like, at the bottom of your funtivity list.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll admit, I hesitated. But then I saw how hurt you were, and I knew how bad I'd feel if I didn't help!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because the game's important! And you're a good player! So, that means it's important that you play, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When you're one of six players on the team, every player's important.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did I just hurt Owen's feelings?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, you're sure you're okay helping me find Paige?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Of course!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Bye, son!
Ben's father hops in the cab, and it drives off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't say `anything...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't say [color=#e23b3b][i]anything...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! We can't talk about this later! There never is a later!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's only me growing up without you!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Calm down! You're being melodramatic, and I really don't have time for it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you even know who I am now? You do understand that I'm not a chemistry nerd anymore, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Of... Of course I do!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you name any of my friends? Any of the players on the basketball team? Any of the classes I'm taking?
Ben's father frowns, thinking...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Look... I... I can't go to your game. But, uh, I'll make it up to you! How about that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, sure, whatever. Just go.
Ben's father gestures to the cab driver to drive off. The cab pulls away, leaving Ben standing there alone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When are you ever going to make it up?
Ben looks down at his phone and sees that the call's still going with Emily. Knowing that he's failed, he does the only thing he can to save face...
He hangs up on her...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This isn't `just` about my game, Dad!
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]just[/i][/color] about my game, Dad!

nodes.text: Ben's father closes the door and rolls down the window.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not just about my game! It's about something more!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Can we talk about this later, son? I have to catch a plane!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad, I know you're late, but I need to talk to you about something.
Ben's father checks his pocket and realizes that he's forgotten something.
He gestures for the cab driver to open the trunk back up.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I know this is about your game, son... I really want to be there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you don't `need` to be...
nodes.text_bbcode: But you don't [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] to be...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Where is that ticket? I know I printed it out!
Ben's father rummages through his bag and pulls out a sheet of paper.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Aha! Got it!
He walks past Ben and climbs into the back seat.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I... I got to see Sara!
Emily stops swimming and treads water.
Wiping the water out of her eyes, she sees her sister, Sara, sitting at the pool's edge!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, sis.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sara! You're... You're `here!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sara! You're... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]here![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I am.
She wipes the water out of her eyes and sees her sister, Sara, sitting at the edge, her toes dipped into the pool.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sara! You're... You're `here!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sara! You're... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]here![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You couldn't listen to me? I told you that you didn't have to race!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Please, please don't be mad at me...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You'd think you'd have a little more respect, considering...
An awkward silence hangs between them.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Then this means I'm... I'm dreaming, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, you did just fall through a basketball court.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh... There are `so` many things I want to talk to you about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh... There are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many things I want to talk to you about!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know, and I want to talk about all of them, but that can't happen now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not while you're like this.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're totally distressed, Em.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We probably don't have much time before something crazy happens in your subconscious...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And we can't have a conversation when crazy things are happening, can we?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But what if I promise that nothing crazy will happen?
The pool starts to rumble...
A second later, a full-sized whale breaches the water!
It hovers in mid-air, winks at Emily and Sara, and crashes back down, showering them with diamonds!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Starting now. Nothing crazy starting now.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You need to find peace in your subconscious, sis. Then we can talk...
All around them, the pool begins to disintegrate! A crack forms in Sara's body, and she begins to crumble with it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sara opens her mouth one last time...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `Bzz! Bzz! Bzz!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Bzz! Bzz! Bzz![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily wakes with a start, her phone buzzing nearby.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Bzz! Bzz! Bzz!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Bzz! Bzz! Bzz![/i]

nodes.text: Emily swims to her point of exhaustion, finally giving up and hanging onto the pool's edge with shaking arms.
Despite the fatigue in her muscles, Emily swims on to the point of exhaustion, finally giving up and hanging onto the pool's edge with shaking arms.
But Emily doesn't have time to stop. She feels like she has to keep swimming. She has to swim as fast as she can.
Her arms tire. Her body begins to quit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No!
She feels herself slowing...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Stop, Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Tired...
Ignoring the voice, Emily swims on...
Emily puts her head down and swims as fast as she can...
Unsure of what to do, Emily swims on...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And currently in last place, Emily Kessler!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What? This is a race? I can't even see the other swimmers!
Emily swims a little bit faster. Just then, a voice calls out to her.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: You don't have to swim, Emily...
Emily transforms into a sharp blade, whirling down toward the pool!
`SHOOP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SHOOP![/b]

nodes.text: She knifes through the water with ease!
When she surfaces, she returns to her normal form...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That was a good time to be a blade!
An announcer calls out on his microphone!
Emily transforms into a monkey! She howls as she continues to fall toward the pool!
She belly flops into it! Ice-cold water stings her body in one sudden and painful jolt!
Her human form returns...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Ahh!` Why did I choose to be a monkey?! It's not like monkeys are renowned for diving!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahh![/i][/color] Why did I choose to be a monkey?! It's not like monkeys are renowned for diving!

nodes.text: Shocked, Emily numbly starts swimming toward the far end of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Form of, uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Monkey!

nodes.title: Sectionals
nodes.subtitle: Can Ben lead the team to victory... Without Emily?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Emily...
Emily tosses and turns in her bed in the early morning, asleep but uneasy.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Ngggh...
The whole world shifts, rushing by impossibly fast in a starry blur of lights, until suddenly...
Emily finds herself sitting next to Ben, across from the fortune teller, Madame Fortuna, on the night of the Halloween Dance.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why are we here again? Ben, didn't we fix our relationship problems that night?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess not... Otherwise, why would we be here?
Madame Fortuna randomly draws two tarot cards from her deck and lays them face-down on the table. She motions for Ben to pick one.
He picks one, and the fortune teller turns it over. The image on the card is a large boulder.
The boulder morphs into a basketball!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, `that` was cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was cool!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?! I like special effects!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You should be concerned about what it means!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, right... So, what `does` it mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, right... So, what [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] it mean?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Without full acceptance of one another, your relationship will suffer and end.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But that's the same thing you said that night! What does the basketball mean? Is this about our fight over me not going to Ben's basketball game?
Madame Fortuna cackles!

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: You two should break up! You don't stand a chance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! How can you say that? How can she--?
Emily looks toward Ben, but his chair is now empty.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Ben?
Emily is standing at the edge of a basketball court. On the court, Ben is playing a game of one-on-one with her father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You think you can stop me?! I'm the team's best player! Basketball's all that matters!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's the right attitude, son!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!
Neither Ben nor Emily's father can hear her as they play on, oblivious to her presence.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've got everything I could ever need right here.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Consider me your new father!
Emily steps onto the court...
...And falls right through, hurtling through space!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hundreds of feet below her, a swimming pool comes rushing upward!
A bizarre thought enters her head!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I have to choose my form!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Form of...
Through the crowd of fans, Ben sees Emily's ponytail bobbing back and forth as she slices her way towards him...
And then, they're staring at each other face-to-face. Before Ben can say anything, she gives him a `huge` hug!
nodes.text_bbcode: And then, they're staring at each other face-to-face. Before Ben can say anything, she gives him a [b]huge[/b] hug!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, 'cause girls are not confusing `at all.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, 'cause girls are not confusing [color=#e23b3b][i]at all.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee! What are you talking about?
Ben tries to imitate Emily's voice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm Emily, and I'm mad at my devilishly handsome boyfriend, Ben! He's an idiot who won't talk to his father, so I will never never `never` go to his game!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm Emily, and I'm mad at my devilishly handsome boyfriend, Ben! He's an idiot who won't talk to his father, so I will never never [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] go to his game!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You really think my voice is that high?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then again, Ben is `soooooo` handsome and perfect and dreamy I just don't think I could resist `not` seeing him play!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then again, Ben is [color=#e23b3b][i]soooooo[/i][/color] handsome and perfect and dreamy I just don't think I could resist [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] seeing him play!

nodes.text: Emily gives Ben a good whack across the arm.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I `heard` your conversation with your dad over the phone.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]heard[/i][/color] your conversation with your dad over the phone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it didn't really work...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not the point. The point is that you tried, and that's all I really wanted...
She pulls him in for another squeeze.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Besides, it did work a little...
Ben's father is standing there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad? You made it?! But, the conference?
Emily excuses herself and steps away...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: There will be other conferences, son.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What... What changed your mind?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What you said. The idea that maybe I don't know who you are anymore. It scared me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry. But, also, you know... `Good.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry. But, also, you know... [color=#e23b3b][i]Good.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I know that I haven't been in your life much lately, and I'm sorry for that.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I... I can't make that up in one fell swoop... But I'd like to start.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I think you just did.
Ben's father steps forward and pulls Ben into a tight hug.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Great shot, son. I'm so proud of you.
Ben closes his eyes and tries to preserve the moment for as long as he can...
You are now playing as $ZOE...
Meanwhile, $ZOE watches from afar as Owen scans the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's looking for Paige...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: She's not here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Your rival in the quest for Owen's heart. The Posh Princess. She's not here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me guess... You know where she is?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I do indeed. That, and more.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where is she?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ah ah ah. Information like that does not come cheap, my sugary-sweet friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're `not` friends. And I don't need to make a deal with someone shady like you to figure out where she is.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] friends. And I don't need to make a deal with someone shady like you to figure out where she is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can do it just fine on my own.
$ZOE heads away from Wes, toward Owen. Wes calls out to her...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: By all means, follow `all` the thousands of leads you have!
nodes.text_bbcode: By all means, follow [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] the thousands of leads you have!

nodes.text: $ZOE stops and sighs. She comes back to Wes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How much?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Now we're talking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `How much?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]How much?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You think that I would accept money from someone who has contacts with practically `every` clique in the school?
nodes.text_bbcode: You think that I would accept money from someone who has contacts with practically [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] clique in the school?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What then?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Nothing much. Just a favor at a later date. No questions asked.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Will it be illegal?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `That` is a question.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] is a question.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least tell me what the favor will be for.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Now that I can do. It's about justice for a mutual friend of ours.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn?
Wes smiles and extends his hand. $ZOE checks back over both her shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to regret this, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Some do... Some don't...
$ZOE takes Wes's hand. He leans in, putting his mouth close to her ear, and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! But knowing that will destroy Owen!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It `could...` But now you know, and that means it's your choice what to tell him... And `when...`
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]could...[/i][/color] But now you know, and that means it's your choice what to tell him... And [color=#e23b3b][i]when...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: One princess's bad luck is her kind-hearted rival's good fortune, right?
Wes lets go of $ZOE's hand and walks toward the gym exit.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'll be in touch about that favor...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Remember, a deal's a deal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Right...
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 8: Sectionals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 4, Episode 8: Sectionals![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
