menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: The ball hangs in the air, falls toward the hoop...
And goes right through the net!
The buzzer sounds!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I made it! I made it! We won!
The crowd erupts with cheers!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: No no no! He wasn't supposed to make that! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No no no! He wasn't supposed to make that! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha ha! I can't lose! Doesn't matter what sport I play!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to say the same thing!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: My vision is just 20, and I still won!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, can someone help me up?! If I cheer from a prone position, I'll get a nosebleed!
The fans rush the court!
The ball hangs in the air, falls toward the hoop...
And goes right through the net!
The buzzer sounds!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I made it! I made it! We won!
The crowd erupts with cheers!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: No no no! He wasn't supposed to make that! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No no no! He wasn't supposed to make that! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha ha! I can't lose! Doesn't matter what sport I play!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to say the same thing!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: My vision is just 20, and I still won!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, can someone help me up?! If I cheer from a prone position, I'll get a nosebleed!
The fans rush the court!
Ben hurls up an exceptionally wild shot! The ball doesn't even hit the backboard!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no... We've lost!
Ben trudges back to the bench, where his teammates are waiting for him, sour looks on all their faces.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. Well, all that matters is that we had fun, right?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What happened out there, Kale?! It didn't even look like you tried!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know. It just got away from me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Got away from you? Dude! You looked like a wounded bird!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I could've made that shot with a patch over `both` my eyes!
nodes.text_bbcode: I could've made that shot with a patch over [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] my eyes!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can't believe you even made this team!
Ben looks to Erik, who is still hobbled on the bench.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik? Surely you've got something positive to say to lift my spirits?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I got nothing, Benjamin! That stunk like a dead skunk in my trunk!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So then... I guess there won't be an afterparty?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: There will be. But I wouldn't come if I were you.
Ben turns and heads for the locker room by himself, knowing full well that...
The ball hangs in the air, falls toward the hoop...
And goes right through the net!
The buzzer sounds!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I made it! I made it! We won!
The crowd erupts with cheers!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: No no no! He wasn't supposed to make that! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No no no! He wasn't supposed to make that! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha ha! I can't lose! Doesn't matter what sport I play!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to say the same thing!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: My vision is just 20, and I still won!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, can someone help me up?! If I cheer from a prone position, I'll get a nosebleed!
The fans rush the court!
Nothing!
Ben reaches a state of complete zen! For one moment, the game seems completely inconsequential!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! Is this what inner peace feels like?
But it's quickly wiped away by the idea that everyone will hate him if he doesn't at least attempt a shot!
He lunges forward! Knocking away the ball but slapping Lars on the arm!
The ref blows his whistle!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: Foul on number 32 on Twin Branches! That's five fouls, number 32, you're out of the game!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I didn't mean it!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What did I just tell you, Kale?! Ericson can't play! We've only got four players!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It means we have to forfeit!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Bu-bye for good, Weak Link! Don't be so hard on yourself about the foul...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: You would have blown the game anyway!
Ben trudges to the sidelines, trying to avoid the disgusted glares of his teammates.
He knows that...
Ben hangs back, staying in his defensive stance.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You really think I'm going to fall for that?

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: I guess you're not as dumb as you look.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, too bad you are.
Ben hesitates, for just a second.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't reach in...
But the ball is too tempting!
At the start of the fourth quarter, Erik suddenly starts playing really well!
After an around-the-back pass to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nice pass, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Benjamin! I don't even know what I did there! I just moved my hands around my body and zamboni-macaroni... Two points!
But the next time Erik catches the ball, Lars slams into him, sending him flying into the stands!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Yow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Erik!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Erik![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen and Spencer help Erik off the court and carry him back to the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm hurt real bad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's hurt?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My ankle! I twisted it when I landed! That's what I get for finally having self-esteem!
The fans boo as Lars pleads with the ref not to give him a technical foul.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: I didn't mean it!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: You're on thin ice, son!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Looks like you're back in, Kale. Sooner than I wanted. `Don't` foul out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like you're back in, Kale. Sooner than I wanted. [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't[/i][/color] foul out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got it...
Ben turns to check in at the scorekeeper's table, but Erik hobbles over and grabs him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Listen to me, Benjamin! Everything's getting dark. I feel the walls closing in. I... I don't think I have much time left!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You twisted your ankle, Erik. You should be better in, like, four to six weeks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... You forget about me, Ben! You have to move on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just do one thing for me, would you? Say you'll win the game! Say you'll win one for your ol' pal, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah, I'll... I'll win for you.
Ben runs out onto the court and guards Lars.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Hope you don't foul out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You injured Erik on purpose, didn't you?!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: What can I say? I missed you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's low, even for you.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: It's strategy. Glasses was playing well. You're in foul trouble...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Consider it an imposed substitution.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll consider it you acting like a piece of sewer garbage.
Ben gets right in Lars's face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nobody messes with my team. `Nobody.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nobody messes with my team. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nobody.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: On the first play after Erik's injury, Lars dribbles the ball across mid-court.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Be cautious, Ben... Give him space. Foul him, and you're out of the game...
Lars dribbles in a way that exposes the ball just a little more than normal...
Owen shows up a minute later...
Not long after, Jacob and Andy come into the gym and start warming up...
Coach storms into the gym!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: After our loss to Willow Glen, I told you there'd be plenty of running to do and I wasn't lying.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All of you get on the baseline now.
As the players head toward the baseline...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know why he's making `us` run. His bonehead plays are the reason we lost.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know why he's making [color=#e23b3b][i]us[/i][/color] run. His bonehead plays are the reason we lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll go to the principal right now, and...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No! Please don't!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Going to the principal will just make everything worse. I'll be branded a 'rat'!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And I can't handle seeing my art destroyed like this again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the principal can actually `do` something about this.
nodes.text_bbcode: But the principal can actually [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] something about this.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, but don't you see that it'll make my life harder than it already is?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This is the `second` bad thing that's happened this week. I don't think I can take it anymore...
nodes.text_bbcode: This is the [color=#3b78e2][i]second[/i][/color] bad thing that's happened this week. I don't think I can take it anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Nothing. Never mind. I'll get all my photos up again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just don't tell the principal. Please, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, it'll be worse if you don't tell anyone. You have to do `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Autumn, it'll be worse if you don't tell anyone. You have to do [color=#3b78e2][i]something.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Before $ZOE can say another word, Autumn turns on her heel and runs out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What just happened?
The next day before school, $ZOE and Sam find Taylor and Justin in Taylor's office.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What brings you two into my office?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha, `my office.` That never gets old.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha, [color=#3b78e2][i]my office.[/i][/color] That never gets old.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, let me guess. It's about your Art Showcase. Autumn can't show her pictures now that someone painted all over them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have my ways.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If by your 'ways', you mean me eavesdropping in the girls' bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, gross!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Under `her` orders!
nodes.text_bbcode: Under [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] orders!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's my personal philosophy that a good President stays ahead of the gossip so she can stay on top of her regime.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I believe `I` was the one who told you that--
nodes.text_bbcode: I believe [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] was the one who told you that--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway! Autumn and the Art Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. We're going to have to reschedule it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm thinking next Friday will be enough time to set it back up. Some of the flyers have been given out, but they can be changed, and--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No. The Art Showcase is `cancelled.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No. The Art Showcase is [color=#3b78e2][i]cancelled.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But, Taylor, this is our chance to make things right!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay there, High Horse. Dismount for a second, and let me explain myself.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I feel bad for Autumn, sure. But we can't schedule a Showcase after something like this because there's no guarantee that another incident won't take place!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Taylor... If we stop the Art Showcase because of vandalism, then...

nodes.prompt: If we stop the Art Showcase, then..

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If we stop the Art Showcase, then..

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dad! You timed me secretly?!
After practice, Ben and Emily are walking through the halls, when Ben turns away from Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Where are you going? Class is this way.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I forgot to tell you. I've gotta talk to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. I need to talk to all the guys before basketball practice. I'm the leader.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And what brought this idea on?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Something your dad said...
Emily crosses her arms.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what did my dad say now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax. It's not worth getting your swimsuit in a bunch over.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll decide that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, he just said that I should...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh good!
A door at the far end of the swim center opens abruptly, and Ben strolls through.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!
Ben puts an arm around her shoulders, and she leans into him, her face illuminated by the sudden light from the door.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's a great shot!
Autumn tries to take a picture, but realizes she's out of film. She grabs a spare roll in her pocket and hurries to...
She lowers her camera. The coach wraps up practice and sends the boys to the locker room.
Ben comes over to them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you take some good pictures during practice? Need any more?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn wants to--
$ZOE stops as her text alarm goes off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmmm... It's from Amanda.
Another text alarm goes off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And she's sending me a message one word at a time. I'm just going to call her. Autumn, let Ben know what you want.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yep!
$ZOE takes off, dialing as she runs out of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Happy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sad?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Angry?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Focused, actually.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I took some pictures of you on the court. You looked so determined during your scrimmage that it inspired me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Our game's on Friday. I'm trying to push myself, so we won't lose.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It shows. That focus is going to be the central theme of your photos for the showcase.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh. How do I pose for that?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not something you really force. What else makes you focus?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Competition. My mind's been all basketball since we lost to Willow Glen a couple weeks ago.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I heard that loss was pretty upsetting to everyone on the team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying not to let that happen again. We'll be fine. I just have to put Lars and that stupid game out of my head.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Who's Lars?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's a `really` annoying guy on the Willow Glen team. He's... He's like an evil version of me.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's a [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] annoying guy on the Willow Glen team. He's... He's like an evil version of me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Down to the lame science metaphors. He quoted Newton's law of physics on me during a basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ouch. That's must've burned.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like a Bunsen burner.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know science?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used to do pretty well in chemistry... Until I found it was more fun to use chemicals to pull pranks than to pull up my GPA.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm... These are two very interesting sides to Ben. I wonder if I can use his pranking or his interest in chemistry for 'focus'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Ben's pictures?
They pore over Ben's photos...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What do you think of the pictures so far?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad it worked out.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Me too. And with that... I should be getting to class myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'll have all these photos done by the end of day. Thank you for everything, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me know if you need anything else, okay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I just hope I can get all my photos developed in time!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I hope the picture will still show up!
A tense twenty minutes goes by as Autumn develops the photo. She looks at the finished product...
And sees nothing. The image didn't take on the paper.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no...
Paige turns her attention back to the guys.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In the living room, there's a dance floor shaped like...
She turns to the team.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everybody stay loose. We're going to be playing a game later on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh...
While most of the team goes off toward the dance floor, Ben finds Emily hanging out with Kimi and the girls from the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily... Can we talk?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's something I have to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Take a hint.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She doesn't want to talk, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I'll talk with you if you want! I love talking!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. I'll totally talk to you, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!
Ben positions himself so that Emily is in between him and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wanted to say I'm sorry, Em... Er, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I accept your apology!
Emily turns to Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's okay! I don't even remember being there!
Ben gives up the pretense of talking to Amanda and looks right at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do. You told me I've been acting nice to your father because of the distance between me and `my` father.
nodes.text_bbcode: I do. You told me I've been acting nice to your father because of the distance between me and [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: About how my father is never even around long enough to be proud of anything I accomplish.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sounds like me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just wanted to say that you were right.
Ben reaches into his pocket and pulls out the Father's Day note he had gotten for his dad a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I gave him ten free hugs... But he never asked for any of them.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Awww! That's so sad!
Emily turns to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What I mean to say is... I'm done trying to impress your father, and I'm glad that you came to my game. It just means so much--
Emily doesn't let him finish, wrapping her arms around him and squeezing him for a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I love you, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does this mean I'm forgiven?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, now let's stop being so serious and enjoy this party!
Emily leads Ben away...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love parties!
You are now playing as Owen...
Meanwhile, in another part of Paige's family estate, Owen and the rest of the team move toward the hot tub when Owen sees Paige off by herself.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'll meet up with you guys later.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Your loss, bro!
Owen walks over to Paige. When he gets close, he can tell that she's been crying.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'd ask if everything's okay, but I'm pretty sure you'd just lie to me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. I should have had you come cheer me up a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, I haven't been playing very well lately...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My mind's been occupied with... With whatever it is that's going on with us.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And I thought... I thought that the team was going to disown me, pretty much.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But Ben said that sometimes when someone's having issues there isn't a quick fix.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm guessing that's the kind of issue you're going through now.
Paige nods.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It is.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So all I can do is try to pick you up, the way the team picked me up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It means that I tell you nice things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. I don't know if I can handle `both` of us being nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. I don't know if I can handle [color=#3b78e2][i]both[/i][/color] of us being nice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's what makes my nice thing so great.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...

options.label: You don't have to act nice for me.

nodes.text: The ball caroms off the rim right into Steve's hands! He puts the ball back in for two points!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guess I fell asleep on that play...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Owen! Could you play any worse?!
Hamlet and Sowphelia fly frantically around, checking each window... But Paige is nowhere to be found.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: This house is too big! We'll never find it now...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: You can't give up yet! I'm checking one more window...
Sowphelia peeks into one last window and spots Paige brushing her hair at her vanity table.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is the room! I see Paige!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Yes! Finally! But we gotta do something fast, Owen looks like that he's about to leave!
Just ahead, Sam crosses the street!
Nick starts to cross the street after her, but turns just in time to see a horse-drawn carriage about to cut him off!
He walks away, leaving Autumn to catch up with him.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm starting to hate that habit.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks again for coming, Owen.
Shaking her head, Autumn catches up with Mr. Vanderwall.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Autumn, I've seen enough to know what I think of your art exhibit...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, but there's one more--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: One more photo? I know. But I share my opinions when I form them...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: The utter shallowness of the subject, the pride, the vanity... It's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's not what I intended!
Autumn turns to apologize to Lindsay, but Mr. Vanderwall catches Autumn's attention.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I am quite pleased, delighted, effervescent! Shall we walk to the door? I am content.
As they walk away, Lindsay angrily rounds on the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: My picture isn't about being 'self-centered'! It's about being pretty!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You can be both...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That kind of `does` describe you.
nodes.text_bbcode: That kind of [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] describe you.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Self-centered. It's totally `not` a bad thing! Being self-centered just means loving yourself more. Obviously.
nodes.text_bbcode: Self-centered. It's totally [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a bad thing! Being self-centered just means loving yourself more. Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: `Arg!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Arg![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As the rest of the cheerleaders talk about it, nearby patrons listen in. Eventually, strangers in the crowd are pointing at the photos then at Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A tribute to vanity? Of course!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I can see it...
As people talk, Lindsay gets more and more angry!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That two-faced little nothing is `NOT` going to get away with `THIS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That two-faced little nothing is [color=#3b78e2][i]NOT[/i][/color] going to get away with [color=#3b78e2][i]THIS![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Lindsay spies the camera sitting on a stand amidst the photos and makes a beeline for it!
On the other side of the art gallery, Autumn says good-bye to Mr. Vanderwall.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I'm impressed, Autumn. We'd love to have you. You'll let me know what your decision is?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes... I will!
Autumn and Mr. Vanderwall part ways. Humming happily to herself, Autumn tries to find $ZOE in the crowd when suddenly...
`CRASH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CRASH!!![/b]

nodes.text: A loud, ugly crack resounds through the art gallery! And Autumn knows that something is wrong...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no...
Autumn runs across the room, shouldering between guests who have paused, circling tightly around the source of the commotion...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No no NO NO...
Autumn emerges from the crowd at the display where her mother's camera was...
And she sees the camera shattered on the floor!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Dozens of twisted, shattered, and mangled pieces are strewn everywhere. And in the center of the carnage, smirking, right now the very furthest thing from 'pretty'...
...Is `Lindsay!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Is [b]Lindsay![/b]

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What do you think of my exhibit?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I call it 'The Girl Who Messed With The Wrong Cheerleader'!
Autumn drops to her knees and gathers the pieces to her chest, heart-broken, remembering her mother, all the photos she'd taken, and all the memories she'd stowed with the camera...
$ZOE bursts through the thick crowd and finds Autumn clutching the broken pieces of her camera to her heart. It only takes her a second to know who's responsible.
Immediately, $ZOE glares at Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could you? That was low, even for you...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: `Low?!` It's all `her` fault that everyone's making fun of me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Low?![/i][/color] It's all [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] fault that everyone's making fun of me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have no right!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What are you going to do? Tell Principal McCormick?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the `least` I'll do...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the [color=#3b78e2][i]least[/i][/color] I'll do...

nodes.text: $ZOE trails off when she sees Autumn get to her feet...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can't... I just can't...
Autumn turns and flees the gallery!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn!
She chases Autumn, running out of the crowded room and into a different section of the art gallery! Ahead of her, Autumn barrels past statues and paintings...
$ZOE takes off after her, pumping her legs faster and faster...
And that's when she trips on a bump in the red carpet of the gallery! She flies in the air, putting her hands out in front of her to...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I wish I hadn't been interrupted!
She sees that the call is from Ben, and she answers it...
You are now playing as Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Emily! I hope I didn't wake you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You did, but...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But that's okay. Listen, Ben, we need to talk about--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spoiler alert! You want to talk about how I need to connect with my father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And how you're `still` not coming to my basketball game until I do.
nodes.text_bbcode: And how you're [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] not coming to my basketball game until I do.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I've been thinking about it. I think the reason I haven't said anything is because I've been afraid.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Afraid that I might push him away... But then I realized that we can't be any farther apart than we are now!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's probably true...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, my dad came home from his trip last night!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I am thirty seconds away from talking to him, and I just wanted to let you know...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious? That's great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! And I know that I've been stubborn about talking to him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But now that I've actually decided to do it, I feel like this weight's been--
A taxicab pulls up outside Ben's house and honks twice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What the--?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Ben! I've got to get to the airport! There's money on the table!
Ben's father rolls his suitcase down the hallway and out the front door!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad! Wait!
Ben runs out of the house after him!
When Ben reaches his father, he's already handing his luggage over to the cab driver.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're leaving already?! You just got here!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I know, son. I'm really sorry about that. But I've got a conference meeting to attend in...
He checks his watch.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: ...Five hours! Shoot! I'm already late!
Ben sees that the call with Emily is still going...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's nothing I can do now to persuade her to come...
With trembling fingers, he ends the call.
That night, at Sectionals...
The Twin Branches Squirrels are down by two points with only seconds left in the game. Ben gets the ball just outside the three-point line...
He glances to an empty seat in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily's not here...
Just before the buzzers sounds, Ben takes a desperate shot! It hangs in the air for what seems like an eternity...
And clangs off the rim!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I lost the game...
That night, when Ben comes home, he vows to finally have the conversation he needs to have with his father...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's... It's never too late!
But his father isn't home...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe he left a message...
Ben checks his phone.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Sorry, Ben! I'm going to be spending a few nights here! Don't blow anything up with your science experiments!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then again, maybe sometimes it is too late...
Ben sits down at the kitchen table, alone... In the dark...
With nobody to talk to.
You are now playing as $ZOE...
Later that day, $ZOE and Owen pull up outside Paige's family estate...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for driving me, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't let you take the bus all the way out here! Besides, the basketball game is in like two hours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just trying to make sure we win, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know that voice...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Emily is really disappointing her father, her friends, her family's legacy...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: It's okay, Emily... You can stop.

options.label: Episode Five: Paige and Owen's Valentine's Outing

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Now I just need to shine a light on the negative to project it onto the paper...
Autumn flips the light behind the enlarger on and waits as the photo paper exposes...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And now it's ready for its 'bath'...
She turns to three shallow trays with different solutions in them.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, now I have to remember the order... It's `developer solution` first, then the `stopper solution,` then the `fixer solution.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, now I have to remember the order... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]developer solution[/i][/color] first, then the [color=#3b78e2][i]stopper solution,[/i][/color] then the [color=#3b78e2][i]fixer solution.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She turns to put the photograph in the developer solution but realizes the tray is nearly empty.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot. I knew I was low on this. I hope there's enough concentrate to make more.
Autumn finds the developer solution jug and pours it into the tray. There's two cups worth.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, it's one part concentrate to four parts water. How much water do I need if I have two cups of concentrate?

nodes.prompt: How much water do you need?

menu.title: Hurry!
menu.text: How much water do you need?

nodes.text: Autumn takes the photo out and sticks it in the...

nodes.prompt: Where do you put the reel?

menu.title: Hurry!
menu.text: Where do you put the reel?

nodes.text: The next day...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly to the window outside Paige's room. They can hear Paige and her mother arguing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was a `party,` not a `gala.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a [color=#3b78e2][i]party,[/i][/color] not a [color=#3b78e2][i]gala.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: A party that would have ruined `my` home.
nodes.text_bbcode: A party that would have ruined [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] home.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: There were `hoodlums` jumping like cannon balls into the pool, and there were `strings of paper` hanging from my chandelier!
nodes.text_bbcode: There were [color=#3b78e2][i]hoodlums[/i][/color] jumping like cannon balls into the pool, and there were [color=#3b78e2][i]strings of paper[/i][/color] hanging from my chandelier!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called `crepe paper`, and it's a `decoration.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's called [color=#3b78e2][i]crepe paper[/i][/color], and it's a [color=#3b78e2][i]decoration.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: That's even more atrocious than I'd previously imagined.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I bet Dad wouldn't have minded. He'd have thought it was funny.
Margot glares at her daughter and shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Don't talk about him. You have a new father in your life.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And until further notice, you're `grounded.` You are forbidden to leave the grounds.
nodes.text_bbcode: And until further notice, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]grounded.[/i][/color] You are forbidden to leave the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's what 'grounded' means, doesn't it?
As soon as Margot shuts the door firmly behind her, Paige flops angrily down onto her bed.
Outside Paige's window, Sowphelia gives Hamlet a worried look.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: If Paige is stuck at home, how are we ever going to get them together?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We'll think of something. Let's go find Owen. Can you track him?
Sowphelia sniffs the air, her snout twitching.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We don't have to! He's here!
Still invisible, they fly down from the `fifth window` on the `third floor` and find Owen at the front door. He's talking to Tad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Still invisible, they fly down from the [b]fifth window[/b] on the [b]third floor[/b] and find Owen at the front door. He's talking to Tad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Young ruffian, Paige is currently 'grounded' and unable to see visitors at this time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right... Is there a better time when I can come back?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Certainly not for `you.` Paige is a very important young lady. You are not of suitable rank to her social standing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Certainly not for [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] Paige is a very important young lady. You are not of suitable rank to her social standing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's up for Paige to decide. Now if you'd just move aside--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It would be most inappropriate for me to let you in. Now good day! And do not call again.
The door shuts in Owen's face before Owen can so much as get another word out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Not of suitable rank'? Well, it's going to take a lot more than that to keep me from seeing her...
Owen glances at the formidable doors in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I guess it'll just have to be next week at school...
He starts walking away from the manor. Sowphelia and Hamlet exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Any ideas? Too bad we can't push one of these topiaries onto his head. Or talk to him directly.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: You know we can't reveal ourselves!
Sowphelia notices Owen's cell phone peeking out of his back pocket.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But we can send him a message...
Sowphelia flutters her wings, and a silver halo surrounds the phone. It begins to ring. Owen picks it up and glances at the caller.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?
He answers, but there's no one on the other line.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe she's sending me a message...
He walks back towards the manor, ducking behind the house to find Paige's room. He looks up and sees four floors with five windows on each level.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell which room's hers... She just has to live in a house with twenty windows, doesn't she?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to show him which one's Paige's room.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Where is it again?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Her room is on...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, I'm a little surprised by your reaction. Going to a chocolate shop is totally Anti-Valentine's.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because Anti-Valentine's Day is all about...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In what way is going to a chocolate shop a part of Anti-Valentine's Day?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Could you give me `some` hint about where we're going? Nice as it sounds, 'out on the town' is also pretty vague.
nodes.text_bbcode: Could you give me [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] hint about where we're going? Nice as it sounds, 'out on the town' is also pretty vague.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A hint, eh? Well, just promise to let me explain before you flip out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're going to a, uh, a chocolate shop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you said you'd call me back, but I'm trying to plan for this...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And judging from everything I've witnessed here... You are not fit to be an artist.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Surprised? A true artist wouldn't feel surprised, astonished, or taken aback by my words. She would just `know.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Surprised? A true artist wouldn't feel surprised, astonished, or taken aback by my words. She would just [color=#e23b3b][i]know.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's as ridiculous as... As flying pigs!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: In the time we've spent, you haven't displayed anything of an artistic sense at all. Your photos may be good, but I suspect it's more a matter of luck and the camera you wield than talent.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: A true artist would never fall into that trap.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And you, Autumn, are not a `true artist.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And you, Autumn, are not a [color=#e23b3b][i]true artist.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I don't need to see any more. I'm done here.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No! Wait! I know what my weaknesses are! I can explain!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: No... I'm afraid you can't.
Her shoulders slump as Mr. Vanderwall walks past her and out...
Autumn slumps to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's one of the most well-known art professionals here... If `he` thinks I'm a terrible artist...
nodes.text_bbcode: He's one of the most well-known art professionals here... If [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] thinks I'm a terrible artist...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe I should turn in my photo lab card and quit photography all together...
$ZOE jumps over the table just as Autumn crashes through the exit door! $ZOE sprints outside and manages to step in front of Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn! Wait! Please!
$ZOE's appearance causes Autumn to stumble. She catches herself, and $ZOE can see that she's been crying...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How could she do that? Does she even know what this camera means to me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... But I swear Autumn...

options.label: We'll find a way to fix it.

nodes.text: Ben sees that the call with Emily is still going...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's nothing I can do now to persuade her to come...
With trembling fingers, he ends the call.
That night, at Sectionals...
The Twin Branches Squirrels are down by two points with only seconds left in the game. Ben gets the ball just outside the three-point line...
He glances to an empty seat in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily's not here...
Just before the buzzers sounds, Ben takes a desperate shot! It hangs in the air for what seems like an eternity...
And clangs off the rim!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I lost the game...
That night, when Ben comes home, he vows to finally have the conversation he needs to have with his father...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's... It's never too late!
But his father isn't home...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe he left a message...
Ben checks his phone.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Sorry, Ben! I'm going to be spending a few nights here! Don't blow anything up with your science experiments!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then again, maybe sometimes it is too late...
Ben sits down at the kitchen table, alone... In the dark...
With nobody to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Bye, son!
Ben's father hops in the cab, and it drives off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't say `anything...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't say [color=#e23b3b][i]anything...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
You are now playing as $ZOE...
Later that day, $ZOE and Owen pull up outside Paige's family estate...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for driving me, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't let you take the bus all the way out here! Besides, the basketball game is in like two hours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just trying to make sure we win, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually...
The rest of the quarter plays out with Lars and Ben trading shots. Every time Willow Glen takes the lead, Twin Branches crawls its way back. Until...
With just ten seconds to go, Twin Branches has the ball, trailing by two points.
Coach calls timeout, and everyone huddles up around him.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It's no mystery what we're going to do. Get the ball to Kale!
Coach looks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It's up to you!
As the teams come out of the timeout, Lars mimes like he's choking himself.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Don't... Hccck... Choke!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: 'Cause remember? That's what you did last time!
Ben can feel the pressure as he thinks about everything that's led up to this moment...
His tryouts...
Ben looks to the empty bleachers...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wish Emily were here...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale, you're up first!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe I should just close my eyes.
The first game against Willow Glen...
Ben's eyes drift to the crowd for just a moment... And he remembers that Emily isn't there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's at the dance...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh!
Ben curls off Spencer's screen, catches a behind-the-back pass from Erik, turns, and shoots!
The ball hangs in the air, falls toward the hoop...
And clangs off the back of the rim!
In practice for Wilson High...
The other guys let out a big yell and head off toward the locker room, leaving Ben alone in the gym...
He picks up a basketball and slowly walks out toward the three-point line... Instinctively, he looks at the empty stands...
Then, he shoots... The ball bouncing off the backboard, not even close.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just like in the Willow Glen game, I can't shoot without Emily...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Without her support... I might not score `any` points. Without her...
nodes.text_bbcode: Without her support... I might not score [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] points. Without her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll lose...
The present...
More out of reflex than actual hope, Ben's eyes drift to the stands...
And finds Emily in the top row!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You got this, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's here! I can't believe it! She came to my game!
Ben bounds over to the ball.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: What are you so chipper about? Accepted the fact that you're going to blow it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't be nervous, Lars. It'll all be over soon.
The ref blows the whistle. Ben does a quick push-off move to get open, and Andy inbounds to him.
Ben takes a few aggressive dribbles, trying to create space for a last-second shot...
He creates just enough of a gap between him and Lars and goes up for the shot!
The only thing on his mind is...
Ben has failed.

nodes.text: After school, $ZOE finds Maria in a nearby park, dressed for a run and stretching with Lindsay. $ZOE approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! What's up? You've been so busy lately, that we never see you outside practice anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I didn't know how busy Social Chair would be...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: We're excited to see what event you're putting on for the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, I haven't quite planned--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah! We heard about the Art Showcase. If you're planning something amazing for those artist weirdos, then you've got to have something for us, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, sure! Nothing definite yet, but I'll look into it.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looking for you. I wanted to talk to you about...
$ZOE slowly finds her way back down into the park. She runs into Lindsay by the park's entrance.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How'd it go? Did you catch up with her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So what was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The photos Autumn was using for the Art Showcase were vandalized. Someone painted over all of them.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh. Well, they weren't very good anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: The photos were kind of crap. Just because you can make photos black-and-white doesn't mean you're a real artist. Isn't that a little lame?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought they looked pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that doesn't matter now. I didn't figure out who painted over them. I thought it must have been one of the cheerleaders since that's what all the photos were of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But after talking to all of them, I'm pretty sure they're innocent... I'm all out of ideas.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Sorry. Sounds like you're never going to find who splattered red paint on that loser's photos...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, that word you just said...
You are now playing as Autumn.
Autumn fiddles with the settings on an old camera as $ZOE leads the way to the swimming center.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I've ever seen a camera like that before. Is it new?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Actually, it's old. It's my mother's camera. She gave it to me before she passed away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's okay. It's been ten years. I've... Gotten used to it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But my mother was a photographer. This was her favorite camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That must make it special.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It is. In more ways than one. The pictures that come out of it are really unique.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, first, it's the only older camera I've ever heard of that holds the picture you take in its viewfinder for a slight second after you take a shot. It makes it easy to tell what my photos are going to look like.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And second, it gives every picture a 'soft focus'. It's when things look a little dream-like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh right. I saw that in your cheerleader pictures. It made everything look slightly blurry. But in a fun way.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's... One way to put it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I don't really know what I'm talking about when it comes to art.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You don't have to know anything. Art is part of who we are. When you see anything that makes you feel a certain way, it's art.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So me freaking out over a pop quiz is art?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, `that` might just be life.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] might just be life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Heh.
And that's when $ZOE's phone buzzes with an incoming text. She reads it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What is it? Cheer-mergency?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Amanda texted me saying they're having a... Cupcake party after school?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What happened to the last-minute cheer practice you might have to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe they didn't have to revise the routines and are now celebrating.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, Amanda did also text me to 'bring the party hats', so that must mean everything's been resolved.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like I can skip the after-school meeting after all. This is more important.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And the swim center's right up here.
$ZOE and Autumn walk into the swim center. The pool is empty, save for one lone girl swimming an extra couple laps.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmmm, I thought the swim team was bigger than this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder where everyone is...
In the pool, Emily surfaces and climbs out.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. Are you looking for Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of. Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, practice ended. They're all in the locker room changing.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm guessing they won't want to have their picture taken in there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not unless you want your theme to be 'scandal'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That'll definitely make my art show popular with the male half of the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Pictures? For yearbook?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For an Art Showcase. Autumn here wants some new subjects for her photo shoot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now that I think about it... Autumn, you said you wanted someone with depth and passion. Emily's got both!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'd love to, if that's okay with you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure... But I have to warn you. I'm no good at posing for pictures. You should see my yearbook photos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If you don't like posing, you shoudn't pose. I enjoy taking revealing candids more anyway. You just do what you do best.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And I hear you're our best swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I try. Want me to do a few laps in the pool? I have a couple minutes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That would be great! Just... Pretend I'm not here.
Emily begins stretching.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what do you look for when you're taking pictures?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The right time. As someone who wants to capture life, every single moment is a photo opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel like I'd be taking pictures all the time if I thought like that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this camera takes a special kind of film.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like actual film?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can only take three pictures before I have to reload, so I'm pretty careful about the shots I take. Otherwise, I'd be spending a ton of money on old film.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So I have to be really patient about waiting for the perfect shot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the perfect moment here?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, if I'm going to use Emily as a subject, I should kind of know what emotion I want her to express. In this case, I want to show how passionate she is, how much she cares about something.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So I'm looking for a great moments that show she's happy and proud to be where she is....
They turn to watch Emily as she hops into the pool and positions herself against the far ledge. Autumn raises her camera.
Emily pulls herself close to the pool edge, then she springs up and out!
Autumn sees the arc of Emily's body as she dives into her backstroke.
Autumn brings the roll of film into the darkroom and shuts off the lights.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, first things first... I make the negatives, and then I mount them on my enlarger `emulsion side down` for it to come out right... That's the dull side!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, first things first... I make the negatives, and then I mount them on my enlarger [color=#3b78e2][i]emulsion side down[/i][/color] for it to come out right... That's the dull side!

nodes.text: Working as fast as she can, Autumn develops the film, creating negatives for her photos.
Then, Autumn turns to her enlarger and mounts the first negative of Lindsay...
Okay, `that` was unexpected! But, then again, only a superhero could have caught that pass from Jacob!

While Owen still feels concerned about Paige, he also feels like a weight's been lifted from his shoulders...
The second half begins!
Skazz brings the ball up the court!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where's my man?!
Owen...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly down, shooting through the blanket of stars and clouds to earth below.
From the air, they can see the bright lights of a party at Paige's manor.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What could have gone wrong?! They were enjoying the party when we left!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Things change quickly. Come on, let's get into stealth mode before one of these young humans see us.
Sowphelia concentrates and flutters her wings. A shimmery halo rings her tiny body, then fades away.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Done. Let's fly in for a closer look.
Hamlet turns himself invisible and follows her.
The cupigs find their way inside...
Where Paige's mother Margot and soon-to-be stepfather Tad are standing in the foyer, yelling at Paige!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Never mind `that!` What is this, Paige?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] What is this, Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not supposed to be back for another week!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `Surprise.` Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Surprise.[/i][/color] Now answer me, young lady? Why is my house suddenly filled with... The bourgeoise?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are my friends, mom.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ha! Now I know you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: This is exactly what I've been telling you about, Margot. The rebelliousness comes from her peers.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You're right. So right. This abomination here is the reason, Paige, why we decided you will no longer be attending that public school!
The partygoers gasp!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's why you'll be going `back` to Monarch Prep!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's why you'll be going [color=#3b78e2][i]back[/i][/color] to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Now everyone else, get out of my house this instant, or I shall call the authorities!
Margot and Tad start marshaling everyone out of the house as Owen turns to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why didn't you tell me your mother was sending you back to Monarch?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why would I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe because we're friends? You didn't think this was something you could warn me about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe I didn't see why it would really `matter.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I didn't see why it would really [color=#3b78e2][i]matter.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I see...
Owen turns away from her and starts walking away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm leaving. Your mom is kicking everyone out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I don't see why that would `matter` to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't see why that would [color=#e23b3b][i]matter[/i][/color] to you.

nodes.text: As Owen walks away, Sowphelia hisses to Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: He's leaving! And they're never going to kiss tomorrow if we don't do something!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do you suggest I do? Tackle him?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: That's not a `bad` idea...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not a [color=#3b78e2][i]bad[/i][/color] idea...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You know we can't touch them directly. We can only move things around them...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you going to quote the entire Cupig's Hoofbook to me? Do something!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Do you have any suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What about using a Cupig's Arrow? We could make Owen change his mind!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We only have one each... We can't use them every time we run into a problem.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Good point. Okay, uh...
She has failed.

She tries to correct, but instead, flubs the shot! The arrow embeds itself in the green grass next to the road.
Pink flowers burst into life where the arrow hits, blooming rapidly then bursting into a flurry of pink petals before vanishing.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: No! The last arrow!
She looks mournfully from her bow to the car speeding off into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: There's no hope now... Margot'll find out Paige isn't home. She'll get in trouble. And she and Owen will never be together...

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: You don't know that... There's still `some` time.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't know that... There's still [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] time.

nodes.text: Sowphelia nods her head, but in her heart, she knows...
Sowphelia and Hamlet veer away from Paige to fly after Margot and Tad's car.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We have to make it break down somehow! But it's going too fast!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: We have to go faster!
Sowphelia grits her pig teeth and...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You should probably call Spencer about that. But if you want `my` advice, I'd tell the truth.
nodes.text_bbcode: You should probably call Spencer about that. But if you want [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] advice, I'd tell the truth.

nodes.text: Emily nods.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem. I'm with Emily `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem. I'm with Emily [color=#e23b3b][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, uh, you should always tell the truth to girls you're dating. If you want another opinion, `call Spencer.` Got that?
nodes.text_bbcode: But, uh, you should always tell the truth to girls you're dating. If you want another opinion, [color=#e23b3b][i]call Spencer.[/i][/color] Got that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're sure I should tell her? Sam might flip out and--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Call. Spencer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Call. Spencer.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben hangs up. Nick starts putting on his date outfit.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do I really want to call Spencer? He and Sam used to date, and I've gotta pick her up in like... Negative two minutes!

options.label: Follow Ben's advice and tell Sam the truth.

nodes.text: He sees Sam walking quickly several blocks away and runs after her!
Three steps into his run he trips and falls!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not... Athletic!
He gets up and speedwalks after her. When he's a block away, Sam turns, sees him, and quickens her pace.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go away, Nick!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, Sam! Please!
As he nears, Sam starts running!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you serious?! You know I don't run well!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Catch me if you can!
Sam makes a sharp turn along a busy street!
Nick runs around the corner just as $Travis is crossing the sidewalk into a flower shop!
Nick gets out his phone and calls Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why do you keep interrupting my sets?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry! It's just that--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait... Are you at the gym?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not all of us have fake dates, Brown! What happened with Sam?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wooed her. Then she doused me with water.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's gone?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She just ran out of here...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Even after you told her how you feel?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not exactly. I started to, but I ran out of time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... She ran before you could say anything? And you're sitting there talking to me? Are you an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Chase after her, man! Tell her how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How do I know she won't punch me like you said? Or throw more water on me? Or drown me in a lake?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't! Loving chicks means risking drowning!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It does? You know, you should write a book...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I should go after Sam!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, Nick, one more thing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know! I know! If I hurt her... You'll turn my intestines into a bouquet of flowers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Solid, man. You `have` been paying attention.
nodes.text_bbcode: Solid, man. You [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] been paying attention.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now shut up and go!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, right!
Nick hangs up the phone and runs out of the restaurant!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I know you're going to be upset, but this whole night's been a lie.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just wanted to take you out for a romantic night... And this ruse was the only way I could do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... You lied to me?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes, but I only lied to you because--
It's at that moment that the delivery man arrives holding the flowers for Sam.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Flower delivery for Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey, I went to school with you! You're pretty! Here's some flowers from some guy named Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Keep 'em!
She tosses her glass of water in Nick's face and storms out of the restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Ha ha! I love this job! See ya!
Autumn has failed, not passed, flunked!

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Mr. Vanderwall follows Autumn to the first exhibit of Emily. He scans both photos of Emily and then looks down at the chalkboard where 'Passion' is written in neat letters.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I find this set fascinating. You as an artist should know that the most important thing to do in an art exhibit such as this is getting to the `heart` of the `art.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I find this set fascinating. You as an artist should know that the most important thing to do in an art exhibit such as this is getting to the [color=#e23b3b][i]heart[/i][/color] of the [color=#e23b3b][i]art.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Your photos show a lot of depth of emotion, and the 'passion' that shows up in this girl's photos is remarkable. She must be very passionate in real life.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh yes, very much so. But don't get her wrong. She's not so intensely passionate in person.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: You mean, she's not like her photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: If your subject is nothing like your photos, then what you've printed would be a `lie...` It would be lacking the very 'truth' or 'heart' that it needs to be convincing.
nodes.text_bbcode: If your subject is nothing like your photos, then what you've printed would be a [color=#e23b3b][i]lie...[/i][/color] It would be lacking the very 'truth' or 'heart' that it needs to be convincing.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, I mean, she `is` passionate. Just not in a crazy way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I mean, she [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] passionate. Just not in a crazy way.

nodes.text: Vanderwall eyes her suspiciously, and suddenly, Autumn has an idea.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You should meet her. You could see for yourself how well I've caught her in portrait.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: An excellent idea.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You could meet all the models, if you wanted. They're all here tonight and...
Autumn's smile fades when she sees $ZOE's surprised look. And Autumn suddenly remembers that most of her subjects are distracted with their personal lives.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Let them show themselves then.
With no choice, Autumn nods at Emily who's standing a few feet away from her exhibit. Emily gives Mr. Vanderwall a tight, wary smile as she walks up.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Emily.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Emily. You're the inspiration behind these photos of 'passion'. Of course I'd like to hear more about how you came to be the subject, the inspiration, the focal point!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's nothing I did. Autumn has a good eye for picture-taking.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It helps that you have such strong interests. Emily, tell Mr. Vanderwall about...
When Ben reaches his father, he's already handing his luggage over to the cab driver.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're leaving already?! You just got here!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I know, son. I'm really sorry about that. But I've got a conference meeting to attend in...
He checks his watch.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: ...Five hours! Shoot! I'm already late!
You are now playing as Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Emily! I hope I didn't wake you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You did, but...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But that's okay. Listen, Ben, we need to talk about--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spoiler alert! You want to talk about how I need to connect with my father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And how you're `still` not coming to my basketball game until I do.
nodes.text_bbcode: And how you're [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] not coming to my basketball game until I do.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I've been thinking about it. I think the reason I haven't said anything is because I've been afraid.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Afraid that I might push him away... But then I realized that we can't be any farther apart than we are now!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's probably true...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, my dad came home from his trip last night!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I am thirty seconds away from talking to him, and I just wanted to let you know...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious? That's great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! And I know that I've been stubborn about talking to him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But now that I've actually decided to do it, I feel like this weight's been--
A taxicab pulls up outside Ben's house and honks twice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What the--?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Ben! I've got to get to the airport! There's money on the table!
Ben's father rolls his suitcase down the hallway and out the front door!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad! Wait!
Ben runs out of the house after him!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Then this means I'm... I'm dreaming, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, you did just fall through a basketball court.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh... There are `so` many things I want to talk to you about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh... There are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many things I want to talk to you about!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know, and I want to talk about all of them, but that can't happen now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not while you're like this.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're totally distressed, Em.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We probably don't have much time before something crazy happens in your subconscious...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And we can't have a conversation when crazy things are happening, can we?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But what if I promise that nothing crazy will happen?
The pool starts to rumble...
A second later, a full-sized whale breaches the water!
It hovers in mid-air, winks at Emily and Sara, and crashes back down, showering them with diamonds!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Starting now. Nothing crazy starting now.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You need to find peace in your subconscious, sis. Then we can talk...
All around them, the pool begins to disintegrate! A crack forms in Sara's body, and she begins to crumble with it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sara opens her mouth one last time...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `Bzz! Bzz! Bzz!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Bzz! Bzz! Bzz![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily wakes with a start, her phone buzzing nearby.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Bzz! Bzz! Bzz!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Bzz! Bzz! Bzz![/i]

nodes.text: She wipes the water out of her eyes and sees her sister, Sara, sitting at the edge, her toes dipped into the pool.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sara! You're... You're `here!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sara! You're... You're [color=#3b78e2][i]here![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You couldn't listen to me? I told you that you didn't have to race!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Please, please don't be mad at me...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You'd think you'd have a little more respect, considering...
An awkward silence hangs between them.
He has failed.
