nodes.text: On the first play after Erik's injury, Lars dribbles the ball across mid-court.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Be cautious, Ben... Give him space. Foul him, and you're out of the game...
Lars dribbles in a way that exposes the ball just a little more than normal...
You are now playing as Twin Branches' newest basketball star, Ben...
Ben is sitting poolside with his girlfriend, Emily, before swim practice starts. The other swimmers are hanging out in the water.
Ben takes the stopwatch dangling from his neck and holds it up for Emily to see.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I think I'm starting to get used to this thing. I might start wearing it around campus as an accessory.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Very fashionable.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's my way of spending `time` with you. Get it? 'Cause time.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's my way of spending [color=#e23b3b][i]time[/i][/color] with you. Get it? 'Cause time.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I get it. I get it. If I didn't groan yet, it's because I'm still in shock about how bad that was.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. I guess when it comes to puns, I'll have to `watch` myself.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. I guess when it comes to puns, I'll have to [color=#e23b3b][i]watch[/i][/color] myself.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, `that` was pretty good.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Brought it home.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You know, I'm glad my dad trusted you enough to help out at practices.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What can I say? Except...
After school, Ben waits in the gym for the basketball team to arrive...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are they even going to show?
The gym doors open, and Spencer walks in!
$ZOE and Autumn walk down the hall on their way to the art studio.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'm so glad you agreed to be the artist featured in the Art Showcase, Autumn! It'll be really good for the school!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `If` anyone comes. It's been my experience that no one cares about art. Artists are the gum stuck under life's table.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]If[/i][/color] anyone comes. It's been my experience that no one cares about art. Artists are the gum stuck under life's table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They'll come! I'm sure of it!
They chat until they finally reach the art studio.
Autumn opens the door, flicks on the light, and gasps!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?
$ZOE looks to where three elegant, glossy photos taken by Autumn hang on the far wall.
Large, ugly splotches of bright red paint mar each portrait, obliterating the faces on all her photos.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: My... My art!
Anguished, Autumn goes from piece to piece, running her hands on the red marks as if to erase the damage.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Every single one is ruined!
$ZOE looks over and sees tears forming in Autumn's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Everything's destroyed! All my paintings... Ruined!
$ZOE puts a comforting arm around Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, do you know who did this?
Autumn ignores her.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What about the Art Showcase? I can't show these!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, breathe. If you could just calm down for a minute--

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can't calm down! This is my life's work!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn...
At lunch, $ZOE finds the cheerleaders at the Center Table. Maria and Nicole are surrounded, so $ZOE sits next to Keith at the edge.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, cheerleaders! I just wanted to give a shout out to the new members of our team... Lindsay and Shannon!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's the first day they're sitting with us!
To her right, a pretty blonde girl and a quiet redhead wave and smile sheepishly.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` new people! Hi, I'm Amanda!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] new people! Hi, I'm Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Amanda, we're on the swim team together. I used to be friends with Dominique?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And we met at tryouts. We've hung out literally hundreds of times.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Taylor?!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Woo hoo! More girls!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, more girls to stand on in the pyramid!
On the other side of the Center Table, $ZOE turns to Keith.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So Keith, how are you?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I saw the photo that Autumn took of you for her Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ugh, that picture? It's not my greatest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you looked terrible. But you did look incredibly sad.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I've been better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh? What's up?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Eh. It's pretty obvious.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah... I can't eat, I can't think, and I can't even get up early enough in the morning to gel my hair...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know what's going on. This is about...
After school, $ZOE drops by the photo lab to check in on Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you get the prints done?
Autumn looks at her photos of Ben, Emily, and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong with the photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not that. I was just thinking about my exhibit and about what happened last time when Lindsay destroyed the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't have to worry about that now. Lindsay's not going to try something like that again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That may be so, but...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I want my art to make people `feel.` But that doesn't include wanting people to feel left out.
nodes.text_bbcode: I want my art to make people [color=#3b78e2][i]feel.[/i][/color] But that doesn't include wanting people to feel left out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't include everyone in the photo shoot.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I can include Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure, Autumn? You don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay did something awful to you. If you include her, she might think that she can get her way if she does bad things to people.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I thought about that. But what's the alternative? She hated me for not including her, she'll hate me more for getting punished...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe I can turn this Art Showcase into a peace offering. Even if I'm upset that she destroyed my photos, I kind of understand how she feels now.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No one wants to feel left out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do we have enough time?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If we hurry.
Autumn and $ZOE spot Lindsay coming out of the detention classroom.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay, do you have a second?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh, well, if it's little Miss Perky and her hipster sidekick.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I have to sit in detention with boring Ms. Fitzpootie for an hour all thanks to you, so I'm sure you can figure out why I don't want to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to sit in detention with boring Ms. Fitzpootie for an hour all thanks to you, so I'm sure you can figure out why I don't want to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She turns away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay, wait!
Lindsay stops.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm... I'm redoing my photo shoot. And I wanted you to be in it.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Give me one good reason why I should bother.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: Ben, Emily, and Owen are in it.
I left you out last time.

nodes.title: Girl Trouble
nodes.subtitle: Can Ben help Owen with his Paige problems?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Ben...
Before basketball practice starts, Ben gathers the team for a quick huddle. He catches a quick look of sadness on Owen's face...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... So... How's everyone doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale?! Did you just call a huddle to ask us about our feelings?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Lame.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look! I'm new to being Team Captain, okay?! Whenever I watch sports, the leaders are always huddling everyone up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I like it in here! Talk about cozy!
Jacob scoffs at Erik and turns to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're supposed to talk about what we're going to do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That makes a lotta sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Well, we're about to have our last practice before we play Wilson High. And everyone knows if we don't beat them, our season's over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course, if we win we go to Sectionals and have a chance to get revenge on Willow Glen!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So...
It's tipoff for the game against Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Is it just me, or are they making you guys smaller and smaller every year?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're not getting smaller! You keep getting held back!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: This one's got a squeaky voice!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Ha! It's not `that` squeaky.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! It's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] squeaky.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Seriously, Steve?!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh, my bad.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I meant, 'It's `really` squeaky.'
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant, 'It's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] squeaky.'

nodes.text: Steve gets into position next to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's your man, Owen! Cover him!
The referee tosses the ball into the air! Darren tips it back to Skazz, who dribbles the ball over the halfcourt line.
Owen gets screened! He fights through it and looks for his man!
Owen finds Steve and guards him!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not going to lose me that easily!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Glad to see you've got your head on straight.
Skazz looks to pass to Steve but sees that he's covered. Instead, he takes a long outside shot! Steve tries to fight his way in for a rebound!
Owen guards who he thinks his man is!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing?! Your man is Steve!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh.
Skazz whips the ball over to Steve, and Steve easily sinks a jumper!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Nice defense, Owen!
In the confusion, Owen gets completely turned around! Without looking he takes his defensive stance in front of...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Did you get hit on your head, Harris?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Coach?!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh.
Skazz whips the ball over to Steve, and Steve easily sinks a jumper!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Nice defense, Owen! Coach was definitely the biggest threat to score!
Owen gets distracted by the thought of Paige. He stops and looks around for her, hoping to find her sitting in the stands.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen! Wake up, man!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh.
Skazz whips the ball over to Steve, and Steve easily sinks a jumper!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Nice defense, Owen!
This Valentine's Day, we're doing things a little differently!
You are now playing as Sowphelia, a Cupid pig with extraordinary powers!
Sowphelia and her `cupig` partner, Hamlet, talk over a trough at their local hangout, The Pig Pen.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sowphelia and her [b]cupig[/b] partner, Hamlet, talk over a trough at their local hangout, The Pig Pen.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I don't know how you're so calm. Things are not looking good, Hamlet.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I'm talking about the assignment that the great and glorious Hogfather gave us. Tomorrow is Valentine's Day, and Paige and Owen aren't together yet!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Their love is written in the stars! I hope I don't have to remind you what the Hogfather will do if we miss the Valentine's Day deadline. He will `not` be pleased.
nodes.text_bbcode: Their love is written in the stars! I hope I don't have to remind you what the Hogfather will do if we miss the Valentine's Day deadline. He will [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] be pleased.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Don't get your pigtail in a curl, Sowphelia. They're right on schedule. We'll barely even have to lift a hoof to get them together. I swear a week's truffles on it.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: I... I don't know. I used to think that way, ever since Owen and Paige connected during the their psychology project...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: But they've had so many chances since then, and they still haven't committed to each other.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Eh, I don't know why you care so much. It's not like they're soulmates or anything.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: `Yes`, they are. Paige and Owen forever!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes[/i][/color], they are. Paige and Owen forever!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: 'Paige and Owen'? They don't even have a cool name to 'ship' them by. What are you going to call them? 'Powen'?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Yeah! What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's just that they've got nothing on $ZOE and Owen. Maybe the Hogfather got this one wrong.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The Hogfather is never wrong! Besides $ZOE always gets her way. She just got Social Chair. Why should she get Owen too?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: Because Paige is super mean. Why should she and Owen be together?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Because...
Sowphelia and Hamlet fly low, following Owen and Paige to their picnic spot in the park.
He sets down the grocery bag and spreads his jacket out, putting it on the ground for Paige to sit on.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you sure you're the same Owen? The Owen I know isn't this gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't need to know what every fork is to have good manners.
He plops down next to her and opens the grocery bag. They eat hungrily while they enjoy the view of the park.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who needs five-star food when you've got groceries?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyone who has standards?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not all of us can be so snobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not snobby!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You live in a four-story mansion and eat on plates of gold. You can't tell me you're not a prissy snob.
Above them, Sowphelia shoots Hamlet a worried glance.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: They can't start fighting now... Not when they're in a beautiful park together!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's not fighting. They're just ribbing each other. It's like flirting.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure? Paige is a little `emotional`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure? Paige is a little [color=#3b78e2][i]emotional[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that really what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Do you have a problem with it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Usually, you love the fact that you're a mean rich girl who thinks she's better than anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just because that's what I `am` doesn't mean I `like` being called that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because that's what I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] doesn't mean I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] being called that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You wouldn't. You just don't get it...
Hamlet looks at Sowphelia worriedly.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Is there something we can throw at him? Or her?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: The clouds!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We can use the weather. There are rainy clouds over there... Or I can push them back and make it sunny.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: A warm sunny day might put them in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: I say, let it rain.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not `romantic` to get cold and wet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure you're not trying to push your $ZOE and Owen agenda? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]romantic[/i][/color] to get cold and wet!

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: But there are a lot of good rainy scenes in the humans' romantic comedies...

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: Hmm...

nodes.title: Anti-Valentine's Day
nodes.subtitle: Will Nick be the one for Sam?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nick...
After school on Valentine's Day, Nick paces back and forth across his room!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What did you do, Nick?!
The phone rings. He sees that it's Sam and takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Keep it together. Don't say anything about the chocolate shop or the fancy restaurant you booked for tonight!
He answers the phone.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. You're not getting cold feet, are you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Last I checked, this isn't a wedding.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know, you `can` get cold feet for things other than weddings.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, you [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] get cold feet for things other than weddings.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. Birthdays, dances, icy foot baths.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll give you that last one. Anyway, I don't have cold feet. It's just...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'll admit this is my first Anti-Valentine's Day non-date.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Such a sheltered life you lead... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just wondering what I'm supposed to wear to this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whatever. Nice but not too nice. Casual but not too casual.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Helpful. What are you wearing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Um...
Nick stares at an outfit hanging in his closet... A dark, formal shirt and a pair of black slacks.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The, uh, the usual.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to wear skinny jeans, so that doesn't help. Where are we going, anyway?
You are now playing as Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that didn't go well.
He's about to call Spencer when Sam steps out of the restroom.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam! I'm sorry about the note!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just reassure me that you didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I did!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't! Maybe I went too far with the spirit of Anti-Valentine's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... So, what's next?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Dinner, if you're still up for it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am. I'm starving! Where do we go for Anti-Valentine's Day? Cowboy Burger?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I bet no one's there!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Just promise me you'll keep an open mind...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick... Where are we having dinner?
A few minutes later, Nick and Sam walk into `Les Horribles.` In the main room, a violinist plays a beautiful melody before a vast fireplace.
nodes.text_bbcode: A few minutes later, Nick and Sam walk into [b]Les Horribles.[/b] In the main room, a violinist plays a beautiful melody before a vast fireplace.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you serious?
Nick checks in with the host.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Monsieur Nick, Mademoiselle Samantha... With great pain, I show you to your table.
The host seats them at a candlelit table with a white tablecloth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm trying `real` hard to keep an open mind here, Nick. But this feels like the datiest date of all time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm trying [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] hard to keep an open mind here, Nick. But this feels like the datiest date of all time!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know it looks bad, but, uh... Uh, hold on, one second, okay? Gotta use the little hipsters' room!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine. Go. But I'm sure someone's already using it.
Nick races into the restroom and calls Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Pick up! Pick up! Pick up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is it, Brown?! Did you hurt Sam?! I will hunt you down, I swear--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, I didn't! Honest!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did she find out?! Did you blab, dummy?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! But she's onto me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: At any moment she's going to know for sure this is a date, and then I'm dead!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wish I could slap you through the phone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get a grip!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sooner or later, I'm going to have to tell her, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, and this is not the time! You can't tell her it's a date `before` you have the date!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and this is not the time! You can't tell her it's a date [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] you have the date!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You have to woo, man! Woo first, `then` tell her. That's the whole point!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to woo, man! Woo first, [color=#e23b3b][i]then[/i][/color] tell her. That's the whole point!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's going to be upset either way. But if she has a fun time with you first, you might just have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I can do this. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No problem. Oh, one more thing...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you hurt her, I'll rip out your heart and serve it at a party as candy. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Subtler than last time, but I think I caught the gist.
Nick returns to the table.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, I bet you're wondering how we're going to make `this` Anti-Valentine's, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, I bet you're wondering how we're going to make [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] Anti-Valentine's, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You hit the nail on the head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was thinking we could...

nodes.title: The Art Showcase
nodes.subtitle: Can Autumn impress her mystery guest?

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
It's the night of the Art Showcase, and in the local art gallery, the student artists of Twin Branches are setting up their work in anticipation of the big night!
In the central wing of the gallery, $ZOE and Autumn are hanging up the last of Autumn's artsy photographic portraits.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're almost done setting up, Autumn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your photos are matted against grey boards and hung in black frames, just like you wanted. The rope barriers will keep the guests at the optimum viewing angle...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to bring out the lemonade and the cookies for the snack table, and we'll be ready to open the doors and let people in.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wait! I still have one last thing I need you to do! I want to label each of the photos with these chalkboards, so people will know which attribute they'll be seeing in each of the photos.
She holds up four small, blank chalkboards and hands them to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Can you help me write the trait on the chalkboard and hang them up for me? The traits are 'Strength', 'Passion', 'Focus', and... And 'Pretty'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I would do it, but we're running out of time, and I need to make a last-minute adjustment to the gallery map. I wouldn't want people going to the wrong exhibit first.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you wouldn't want people to see Emily's photo when they're meant to see Ben's first...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll handle it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks.
Autumn fiddles with the gallery map, while $ZOE walks up to the chalkboard next to two photographs of Owen.
In one photo, Owen labors over battle ropes in the school's gym. In the other photo, he frowns with concern, giving him an aura of emotional stability.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do Autumn's photos show about Owen?
Mr. Vanderwall and Autumn walk up to Lindsay's photos. Lindsay and the other cheerleaders stand nearby, admiring them.
Both photos of Lindsay seem more glamorous in the professional lighting of the gallery.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Great. Why couldn't she take crazy awesome photos when `we` were her subjects?
nodes.text_bbcode: Great. Why couldn't she take crazy awesome photos when [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] were her subjects?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Aren't they amazing?
Mr. Vanderwall steps up to them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Hmmm... These photos seem a bit different than your other work.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I had a different subject...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: But I like these. More than any other photos in your collection!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `'More than any other photos'`?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]'More than any other photos'[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Aren't you glad you put me in your show, Autumn?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: You really did end with a fantastic finale, a shining jewel, the perfect finish!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I mean, the shots are pretty, but--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: They're more than pretty. These shots have so many layers of depth. The fact that you put 'Pretty' down on the label when this photo is a complete tribute to everything egotistical and megalomaniacal is genius!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What did he say? Did he just call me 'egotistical'? And unless it's about how cute I am, `nothing` about me is mega `anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What did he say? Did he just call me 'egotistical'? And unless it's about how cute I am, [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing[/i][/color] about me is mega [color=#3b78e2][i]anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `That's` fairly obvious.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That's[/i][/color] fairly obvious.

nodes.text: Lindsay smacks Keith across the chest.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Vanderwall, I'm not sure I understand. You think I put Lindsay's photo up ironically?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Yes, as a tribute to her vanity and self-centered nature!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: No, it's not! It's a tribute to beauty!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Yes, in an ironic way!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Granted, having your beauty displayed ironically isn't normally a cause for reverie...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: But it's such a therapeutic life lesson! Your flaws, out in the open! There, for all the world to see!
Autumn can see Lindsay flushing with anger. She steps up to Mr. Vanderwall before he can say anything else...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Vanderwall...

nodes.title: Sectionals
nodes.subtitle: Can Ben lead the team to victory... Without Emily?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Emily...
Emily tosses and turns in her bed in the early morning, asleep but uneasy.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Ngggh...
The whole world shifts, rushing by impossibly fast in a starry blur of lights, until suddenly...
Emily finds herself sitting next to Ben, across from the fortune teller, Madame Fortuna, on the night of the Halloween Dance.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why are we here again? Ben, didn't we fix our relationship problems that night?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess not... Otherwise, why would we be here?
Madame Fortuna randomly draws two tarot cards from her deck and lays them face-down on the table. She motions for Ben to pick one.
He picks one, and the fortune teller turns it over. The image on the card is a large boulder.
The boulder morphs into a basketball!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, `that` was cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was cool!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?! I like special effects!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You should be concerned about what it means!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, right... So, what `does` it mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, right... So, what [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] it mean?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Without full acceptance of one another, your relationship will suffer and end.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But that's the same thing you said that night! What does the basketball mean? Is this about our fight over me not going to Ben's basketball game?
Madame Fortuna cackles!

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: You two should break up! You don't stand a chance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! How can you say that? How can she--?
Emily looks toward Ben, but his chair is now empty.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Ben?
Emily is standing at the edge of a basketball court. On the court, Ben is playing a game of one-on-one with her father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You think you can stop me?! I'm the team's best player! Basketball's all that matters!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's the right attitude, son!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!
Neither Ben nor Emily's father can hear her as they play on, oblivious to her presence.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've got everything I could ever need right here.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Consider me your new father!
Emily steps onto the court...
...And falls right through, hurtling through space!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hundreds of feet below her, a swimming pool comes rushing upward!
A bizarre thought enters her head!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I have to choose my form!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Form of...
At the start of the fourth quarter, Erik suddenly starts playing really well!
After an around-the-back pass to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nice pass, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Benjamin! I don't even know what I did there! I just moved my hands around my body and zamboni-macaroni... Two points!
But the next time Erik catches the ball, Lars slams into him, sending him flying into the stands!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Yow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Erik!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Erik![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen and Spencer help Erik off the court and carry him back to the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm hurt real bad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's hurt?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My ankle! I twisted it when I landed! That's what I get for finally having self-esteem!
The fans boo as Lars pleads with the ref not to give him a technical foul.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: I didn't mean it!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: You're on thin ice, son!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Looks like you're back in, Kale. Sooner than I wanted. `Don't` foul out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like you're back in, Kale. Sooner than I wanted. [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't[/i][/color] foul out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got it...
Ben turns to check in at the scorekeeper's table, but Erik hobbles over and grabs him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Listen to me, Benjamin! Everything's getting dark. I feel the walls closing in. I... I don't think I have much time left!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You twisted your ankle, Erik. You should be better in, like, four to six weeks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... You forget about me, Ben! You have to move on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just do one thing for me, would you? Say you'll win the game! Say you'll win one for your ol' pal, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah, I'll... I'll win for you.
Ben runs out onto the court and guards Lars.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Hope you don't foul out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You injured Erik on purpose, didn't you?!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: What can I say? I missed you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's low, even for you.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: It's strategy. Glasses was playing well. You're in foul trouble...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Consider it an imposed substitution.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll consider it you acting like a piece of sewer garbage.
Ben gets right in Lars's face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nobody messes with my team. `Nobody.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nobody messes with my team. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nobody.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: On the first play after Erik's injury, Lars dribbles the ball across mid-court.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Be cautious, Ben... Give him space. Foul him, and you're out of the game...
Lars dribbles in a way that exposes the ball just a little more than normal...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I `love` these photos. Do you see the passion in Emily's eyes?
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] these photos. Do you see the passion in Emily's eyes?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And the absolute focus in Ben's face?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! Everyone's going to love them.
Autumn looks over all her pictures, evaluating each one. She bites her lip sadly.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: These pictures are awful...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: $ZOE, I don't know what I was thinking. These are terrible. There's no way I can be in the show with these.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe they're not your personal best, but they still work... Didn't you tell me that anything that makes you feel a certain way is art? And these photos make you feel--

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sad? Embarrassed? Like a failure?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Still feelings!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No, $ZOE. I can't do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't give up now. What about just using the old pictures you took earlier of Keith, Nicole, and Maria?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know I can't do that. I'm sorry, $ZOE. Tell Taylor I tried.
Autumn walks out of the classroom, her camera in hand. She hangs her head and, in her heart of hearts...
She feels an overwhelming sense of failure.
Uh-oh! Looks like Autumn could use a hand improving her photo shoots! Try again and see if you can get it right this time!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I have some good ones. It's not my `best` work, but they'll do.
nodes.text_bbcode: I have some good ones. It's not my [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] work, but they'll do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think they look great. I can't wait to see them at the showcase.
And when Maria banks left into more forest, $ZOE is ready and follows her closely on her heels!
And suddenly banks left, disappearing into the forest! $ZOE loses sight of her!
$ZOE stops, doubling over and resting her hands on her knees.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll have to talk to her tomorrow...
Maria runs to where the trail gives way to a rocky path up the mountain.
For one second, $ZOE hopes Maria has run out of road to run on, but the brunette jumps up on a rock and starts climbing up a short mountain path!
$ZOE rushes forward to follow, jumping onto the path and using big rocks to hoist herself up...
She can feel sweat trickle down her face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `need` to keep up with her...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] to keep up with her...

nodes.text: But Maria suddenly banks left, disappearing into the forest! $ZOE loses sight of her!
$ZOE stops, doubling over and resting her hands on her knees.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll have to talk to her tomorrow...
Maria runs to where the trail gives way to a rocky path up the mountain.
For one second, $ZOE hopes Maria has run out of road to run on, but the brunette jumps up on a rock and starts climbing up a short mountain path!
$ZOE rushes forward to follow, jumping onto the path and using big rocks to hoist herself up...
She can feel sweat trickle down her face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `need` to keep up with her...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] to keep up with her...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you're good company.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not so bad yourself, Monsieur Brown.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Careful, you might insult them for saying that with a smile.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... There's something I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: First off, I think that you're...
Nick sees a delivery man at the front of the restaurant holding a huge bouquet of roses!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...Crap!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Excuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... No not that you're crap, just that, uh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't believe I forgot about the roses! In thirty seconds, she's going to know how I feel! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ruined suits aside...
As Nick finally nears...
Sam reaches into her purse...
And hurls a bunch of brown objects behind her! As Nick approaches, he sees them bouncing on the sidewalk!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are those?
Realization dawns on him...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chocolate traps!
Chocolate pieces bounce along the sidewalk before him!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Every one of them's a potential twisted ankle!
He runs into the chocolate mine field, trying not to step on any!
Sam is now just a hundred yards away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you gaining on me? How embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That didn't go so well, did it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I was hoping that distracting her from Ben would make her more relaxed and 'passionate'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... That happens...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I just have to make sure that my other subjects are in the right frame of mind when they talk to Mr. Vanderwall.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ben doesn't look very happy.
They glance over at Ben who's frowning into a party glass while Spencer gesticulates wildly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen will probably pull through for you...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But where `is` he? I can't find him in the crowd...
nodes.text_bbcode: But where [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] he? I can't find him in the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll look for him. You just handle things with Ben and Mr. Vanderwall.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks!
$ZOE breaks away from Autumn to start her search...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Unable to find Owen inside, $ZOE leaves the showcase. She is relieved to find him outside in the parking lot, texting on his phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, there you are. I was wondering where you'd gone. What are you doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, just getting some fresh air. How are you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm good. Autumn wanted me to find you, so she can introduce you to this art critic who's visiting her show.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know anything about art...  What does she need me for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you're one of the most important subjects... Your photos will grace the walls of the school art gallery for at least two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha ha, I feel so honored now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that's why you have to come with me. Your adoring fans are waiting...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, uh, does it have to be right now?
$ZOE calculates how long it will take for Autumn to get through Ben's photos.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of. Your photos are coming up next... Are you busy?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not `really`... But I was kind of waiting for someone...
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color]... But I was kind of waiting for someone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Who? Maybe I saw him in the gallery...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's actually Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Oh.` I `see.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oh.[/i][/color] I [color=#3b78e2][i]see.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think she's here... Even though she texted that she was leaving. An hour ago.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you know how it is. You're about to walk out the door, and suddenly you realize you forgot to put on earrings. You put on earrings, but they don't match your shoes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now that they don't match your shoes, your entire outfit's awful.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This actually happens?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only when you're in a rush.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What I mean is Paige is probably just fashionably late. It's nothing to worry about. I'm sure she'll text when she gets here.
Owen looks out at the parking lot, and $ZOE's heart goes out to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can tell you really want to stay out here, so...

nodes.text: That went well!

What is the unit of measurement used to measure the height of a horse?

You are now playing as Sam...
Sam and Nick are just sitting down for a movie.
I heard that the zombies in this movie are really fast!
Aren't zombies supposed to be slow and plodding?
Yes! Finally! Someone who gets it!
Wait... Why are we watching this if you're not going to like it?
Because a movie with zombies in it is automatically better than every other movie.
Even if the zombies aren't really zombies?
Well... They're like a species of zombie.
Zombie's less attractive, frumpy cousin... The frombie.
I'm glad we're hanging out, Sam.
Me too. Whenever I try to go to a zombie movie with $ZOE, she just hides under a blanket the whole time.
That's sweet and unfortunate all at the same time.
Sam accidentally brushes her arm against Nick's. An odd look crosses his face.
So... Is there anything you want to talk about?
Actually, I want to talk about us.
Uh... I don't know if, uh...
I know we said we should hang out more, and that I asked you to the movies today, so I want to be really clear.
Hey! What's that supposed to mean?
No, don't take it the wrong way. I didn't know what going out to a movie with you meant. It's a relief to have that cleared up.
Besides, I don't think I'm really ready for dating.
Cool. We're just two friends enjoying each other's company... Nothing complicated about it.
Yeah, except the fact that we used to date, and then we broke up, and then I hated you.
Wait... You don't hate me now, do you?
Relax. Any hate I feel towards you is totally directed at your glasses.
What? You mean my hot guy goggles?
The lights darken, and the movie starts. Sam and Nick settle in their seats, two friends.
The next day, $ZOE and Autumn are walking together before class...
I'm so glad you agreed to participate in the Art Showcase, Autumn! It'll be really good for the school!
`If` anyone comes. It's been my experience that no one cares about art. Artists are the gum stuck under life's table.
They'll come! I'm sure of it!
You... Don't really talk like anyone else, do you?
I've got my own style, if that's what you mean?
Anyway, all the revenue we get from tickets will go into the Social Chair fund, so I can use the money for upcoming dances and events!
I'm anxious about showing you my work. All of it is horrible, and none of it feels finished.
Well, with the showcase in a couple of days, I'm sure it's great! I can't wait to see it!
They turn a corner and head toward the photo lab.
I'm getting a weird energy projecting off of you...
Are you stressed? Is something worrying you?
I'm... Frustrated. I kind of blew it with a guy I like, and I don't think I'll ever get him back...
Or if it's even right for me to go after him.
Autumn stops and takes $ZOE by the shoulders.
Figure out if what you feel about him is real. Figure out if what he feels for you is real.
If you both have `real` feelings for each other, then it is right.
There's no buts when it comes to love.
They reach the lab. Autumn opens the door, flicks on the light, and gasps!
$ZOE looks to where three elegant, glossy photos taken by Autumn hang on the far wall.
Large, ugly splotches of red paint mar each portrait, obliterating the faces on all her photos.
Every single one is ruined! Why?!
Who... Who could have done this?
Are you making a mockery of my quiz?
The correct answer was the hand.
You don't keep a diary! Stop yanking my chain!
The correct answer was The Declaration of Independence!

Autumn steps out of the dark photo processing room, blinking at the bright lights.
At least I managed to get some of my photos to come out...
She sighs when she hears her phone vibrate, signaling another text. It's from $ZOE.
Sorry, $ZOE... I can't deal with anything right now...
She puts her phone back in her pocket and looks up, startled to see Wes standing in the doorframe.
Wes? What are you doing here?
I'll admit, school events aren't really my thing.
But I don't mind being a patron of the arts every once in a while.
I figured I could get a sneak preview if I came a day early. The art, without the crowd.
Autumn gestures to her destroyed photos.
Wes's gaze travels from picture to picture, assessing each one of the school-related images.
I take it the red paint isn't an artistic representation of the romance that arises in school cultures, is it?
Autumn can feel herself tearing up, and she looks away from Wes.
Uh... I said the wrong thing.
There isn't a right thing to say.
Someone destroyed all my photos. They mean everything to me.
I... I don't really know for sure.
Let me guess, you'll tell me for a price?
I'd give you a discount. You know, for the starving artist.
It'd be like selling my soul to the devil. No thank you.
And to answer your question, of course I want to know.
But it's not going to make a difference.
Yes, it will. If I were in your place, I'd want to know just so I could get even.
I don't appreciate getting punished for something I didn't deserve. It'd be almost just.
He gestures at the pictures. She looks at each photograph sadly.
I don't want justice or revenge. I just want things to go back to the way they were.
I didn't mean to hurt anyone. Why are people so cruel?
She studies her best photograph, which she now notices has a curse word scrawled across it.
Well, let me know if you change your mind about revenge.

Back in the darkroom, Autumn looks over the photos she didn't use for the Art Showcase. She picks one up, studies it, and sighs.
It's too bad. This one is really good.
Autumn jumps, startled by a voice. She whirls around to find Wes looking over her shoulder at the picture she's holding.
I'd tell you, but I make it a habit of not telling anyone anything without naming a price first.
That's a convenient way of slithering out of that question.
Maybe I had some business talking to someone in yearbook.
Since that club meets on Monday, it's not likely.
Or maybe I wanted to see for myself what a darkroom looked like. You know for a room that's supposed to be dark, it's not very.
Ha. The lights only need to be off before the film is processed and developed. And with your exciting life, I don't think you'd find a darkroom very fascinating.
Perhaps I merely wanted to see you.
Autumn feels heat creep into her cheeks.
Have you given any thought to what I've said?
If you're talking about getting even... No. I've already made peace with Lindsay.
So you do know who did it.
Ah, industrious $ZOE. She's quite determined. Did $ZOE find out why Lindsay did it? I didn't get an accurate story from my informant.
I'm going to pretend that's not as creepy as that sounds.
Uh-huh. Lindsay defaced my photos because she felt left out. She felt like I was trying to insult her by `not` using her photo in my art piece.
`That` was her reasoning? It's not like you excluded her intentionally.
I don't like wasted effort. There's no reason to send a message for an insult that you imagined.
I don't know how you take this so calmly. I'd be angry.
I was. But I'm trying to see it from her perspective. She's not the only one I hurt with my photos.
Even so. There was nothing wrong with your photos. You have a right to express whatever you want.
Yes, but in this case, putting up photos that my subjects disliked isn't the way I wanted to express myself.
Is that why you didn't put this photo in your gallery?
He picks up the photo that Autumn had been looking at. It's of $ZOE and Owen talking, together. $ZOE's head is bent towards Owen's, and they talk as if they were conspirators.
$ZOE's smile is one of transparent joy.
I didn't use that picture because the theme was Owen's strength, not $ZOE's happiness.
Uh-huh. Who's slithering out of the question now?
All right, so that's not the entire truth. The truth is...
Yes. They have chemistry together. I don't know for sure if he's attracted to her or not...
Oh, he does. He likes her very much, but he's also torn. There's another girl he likes too. Of course, she's not going to be here much--
Heh... Look at that. I let my guard down. I almost told you something without naming a price.
Autumn looks up and meets Wes's eyes.
Would that have been so bad?
Autumn feels the heat creep into her cheeks again.
Anyway, that's why I can't use this photo for any public project. Aside from the fact that $ZOE's not my subject, it would tell people too much.
And what I've learned is that there are some truths in the world that aren't meant to be released.
She looks down at the photo one last time...
Before tucking it into a folder with other pictures she doesn't want to share with the world quite yet.

Yes. They have chemistry together. I don't know for sure if he's attracted to her or not...
Oh, he does. He likes her very much, but he's also torn. There's another girl he likes too. Of course, she's not going to be here much--
Heh... Look at that. I let my guard down. I almost told you something without naming a price.
Autumn looks up and meets Wes's eyes.
Would that have been so bad?
Autumn feels the heat creep into her cheeks again.
Anyway, that's why I can't use this photo for any public project. Aside from the fact that $ZOE's not my subject, it would tell people too much.
And what I've learned is that there are some truths in the world that aren't meant to be released.
She looks down at the photo one last time...
Before tucking it into a folder with other pictures she doesn't want to share with the world quite yet.

With the party broken up, Sam leaves Paige's house, heads to her car in the driveway, and is about to get in when...
Kind of a bummer about the party, yeah?
Did you want to talk to me about something? Today? Because I think my car might be blocking people.
Sam nods at the cars parked behind hers.
Nick starts to back away... Then stops abruptly.
Actually, I was going to ask you. Out. For Valentine's Day.
Oh no! I didn't mean, like, a date! I know that's what it sounded like. But, uh...
I meant since I'm not dating anyone, and you know, since you're not dating anyone...
Wow, this still sounds like I'm asking you out.
Sam looks back at the small line of cars that has formed behind hers.
Well, since Valentine's is pretty much a made-up holiday designed to sell cards and chocolates and flowers, I always celebrate Anti-Valentine's Day.
This suddenly explains why you're not dating anyone.
Nothing. Just that it's possible to be `too` hipster.
Glasses don't look good on me... Frames or no frames.
One of the cars behind Sam honks. She glares at the driver then turns back to Nick.
Wait... Anti-Valentine's Day is a day for celebrating the unromantic. It's meant to be shared by single people together! I guarantee a fun, totally platonic time.
So... The opposite of a date?
Sam smiles as she gets into her car.
Okay then, you've got yourself a non-date for Anti-Valentine's Day.
Well, that's just what I didn't `not` want.

Later, back at the Pig Pen, Sowphelia and Hamlet relax with other cupigs.
Did you see the look on the Hogfather's face when we told him the news?
Uh, yes! I was there! Right next to you.
Of course you were... How could I forget?
Sowphelia and Hamlet turn to find $NAMEOFFAMILIAR, a fellow cupig.
How are things going? I heard the Hogfather liked what you guys did.
He must have. He gave us two full weeks of vacation... And it's all because of Sowphelia.
If it weren't for you shooting that arrow into Tad and Margot's tire, we'd be in so much trouble with the Hogfather.
Well, Hamlet told me to take the shot. So it's really both of us...
Sowphelia nuzzles her nose with Hamlet's.
But it was pretty close. Paige and Owen are so dense, I was worried we weren't going to make it.
You think you've got it bad? That's nothing compared to my last few days.
You can't say you've been through the worst until you've chased down a `gryphon`...
You don't know the half of it.
The person I have to guard is always getting herself into trouble!
At least I get to fetch her sticks... That part's fun.
From behind them in a guttural grunt. All three of the cupigs turn to find an older, more experienced cupig shaking his pink head.
A gryphon's nothing compared to the likes of us. We're faster, smarter, and cuter...
And as for you, Sowphelia and Hamlet... At least your charges have `kissed` before...
And it was still a close one, let us tell you!
Be that as it may... Let me tell you the long, harrowing, and absolutely hoof-biting experience of managing `Mal and Natara`...
In the traffic-filled land of San Francisco, there was this `detective`...

After leaving the chocolate shop, $ZOE doesn't go to the school to meet Taylor. Instead, she heads home.
Sorry, Sam. But I know a date when I see one.
Back home, she curls up with a blanket on the couch and turns on the TV.
It's weird to spend Valentine's alone...
$ZOE picks up her phone and instinctively looks for Howard in her Contacts list...
She tosses her phone onto the couch pillow beside her.
Howard's got his own life now. I've got mine too...
Sometimes, it's okay to be single...
But that doesn't mean I have to be alone!
$ZOE picks her phone back up and dials! Not long after, a bubbly voice answers!
Hey, Amanda! How are you doing?
I'm... I'm doing all right. What are you up to?
$ZOE can hear Hector very faintly protesting in the background.
Oh, yeah! Hecky took me on a date! You should come too!
Oh, I guess this date is just a me-and-Hector date, but it's boring so far!
You know I don't like water, Hecky!
You asked me to take you here!
Oh, that's right. I love water! Still, I thought it would be more like a roller coaster...
Amanda talks to $ZOE again, her voice in a whisper.
This `is` actually really, really fun. But if I tell Hecky that, he won't try to top himself.
Oh no! You're all alone on Valentine's?!
It's okay, Amanda. I got sad at first, but... Then I remembered that I've always got good friends I can talk with, like you!
I'm good friends with you too!
You're sure you're okay being alone? Because I'm sure I could send you a boyfriend!
I... Don't want to know how that would work... Or who that would be.
And yes! I'm sure! I think I'll actually have a fun time just watching some movies over here!
Ohmygosh, the lights just went out over here!
Yeah, but I better not drain anymore power! Goodbye!
Uh, goodbye Amanda! Thanks for taking my call!
$ZOE hangs up and returns to watching TV, this time a broad smile across her face.

Autumn holds the camera to her chest and flees out the door!
The crowd parts for Autumn as she flees for the exit, $ZOE running off after her!
Lindsay frowns at $ZOE's back and leans over to talk to Nicole.
She's so dramatic... It's `just` a camera. She can buy `another one.`
Wes smoothly wedges himself between the two girls, giving Lindsay a toothy smile.
Ugh, go away. I don't talk to boys with stringy hair and a t-shirt that hasn't seen a washing machine since two weeks ago.
For someone who's supposed to represent 'pretty', you don't seem to fit the bill.
You shouldn't have destroyed Autumn's camera.
Autumn was nice, kind, and she reached out to you even when you were mean to her...
Lindsay tries to step aside, but Wes sidesteps in front of her.
You know who I am, Lindsay. You know that I can do the things I say that I can do. You should've known better than to make me mad.
Watch your back... After this, I have a feeling no one else will be watching it for you.
Wes nods to Lindsay sharply and backs away into the crowd. In an instant, he is gone, leaving only a sea of angry faces.
Like I should really be worried about the threats of some scrawny guy, right?
What will happen to Lindsay now? And will Owen ever find Paige? Find out soon!

Not bad, eh, sis? Totally stress-free consciousness or whatever.
Emily and Sara look out over the tranquil pool water. Everything is serene and calm.
A whale surfaces out of the water and swims past them quietly. They run their hands along it. A moment later, its fluke disappears beneath the water.
Pretty good, Em! So, what do you want to talk to me about?
Are you kidding?! Everything! Swimming! Dad! Kimi!
Of course, Ben! What do you think of him?
I admit I was worried for a bit there... But you guys seem really good together!
Emily curls up tight under the blankets and smiles...
Nick drops Sam off at her house.
Look at you... Nick the Sports Guy all of a sudden!
And just how many games are you comparing it to?
Touche... What I meant to say was, 'That was `a` game!'
That sounds more accurate from you.
Hey, I `am` getting a little more sports savvy.
Totally. For example, I know that we won...
Uh, I know that... Ben made a shot, and people got `really` excited.
And lastly... Uh, you look really `really` pretty.
Sam leans forward, and Nick kisses her.
When Sam reaches the front porch, she opens the door and waves goodbye to Nick, who drives off.
Sam's mother is waiting for her inside, a terrible look on her face.
What is it, Mom? What's wrong?!
It's about the loan that I applied for... The one that would pay for your college...
You... You've been rejected. I'm so sorry. I... I don't have enough money to pay for you to go.
Sam's mom starts crying! Sam puts an arm around her, trying to be strong...
And far `far` away from Twin Branches campus, $ZOE and Owen arrive outside a lesser known wing of Monarch Prep.
A sign outside reads 'Butterfly Detention Center'.
Never thought I'd see a sign like that...
$ZOE parks near a chain-link fence adjacent to a dormitory building.
We're really far from Twin Branches... You're sure Paige is here?
Pretty sure. But it depends on how much you trust anything Wes says.
That guy's shady. But I haven't known him to be wrong.
Just as long as you didn't make a deal with him...
You wouldn't want to owe `that` guy a favor.
Just then, a line of girls marches around a corner and into a windowless building.
A squat, stern old lady snorts and grumbles at the girls as they enter.
Paige is in the back of the line, her head down.
For one moment, their eyes meet...
Then Principal Whitford gives Owen an acidic glare right before she pushes Paige in and slams the door shut behind her!
I can't believe it! Paige is like... Like a prisoner here!
Are you okay, $ZOE? You look like you've seen a ghost!
It's nothing... I just... Thought I recognized one of the other girls. Someone from my past.
But I'm... I'm `really` sorry about Paige! There must be something we can do!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really fast, Emily! I clocked you at 35.2 seconds!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Nice job, Ben.
Coach Kessler pulls a stopwatch out of his pocket and shows it to Ben. The time is nearly identical.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What? I didn't know if Ben could do it. And I couldn't risk you setting a personal best and not having it recorded.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay. Better safe than sorry, right?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Exactly. Besides, now that I've seen him do it right, I won't have to do this again.
Ben and Emily share a secret smile.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: True to my word, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Glad you could make it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, even though that was a dirty trick you pulled!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What else was I going to do? Let the Pain Dispenser smash me into oblivion?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, that would have been fun for me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ready to be distracted! My mind's been a lot clearer since we talked!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's good news!
Ben gives Owen a fist bump as he walks by...
A moment later, Erik steps inside.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Benjamin! I tell you... I am pumpernickeled to be dedicating my time to the team today!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm going to be a fierce passer! A stalwart defender! And, of course, a gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A gentleman?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You should never lose touch with your humanity!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's really... Erik of you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks! Gotta go stretch my glutes!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I think I got the perfect shot.
One of Emily diving into her backstroke...
One of Emily's arm coming up out of the water...
A wonderfully clear picture of Emily's small smile of satisfaction...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `love` this one... She looks so intense.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] this one... She looks so intense.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, this picture is going to be perfect!
There's a photo of Emily staring at the cement floor...
A bunch of blurry photos of Emily climbing out of the pool...
And a photo of Emily leaning into Ben as he holds her...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And this one is great because it's another side of her 'passion'.
Autumn sees a clear picture of a determined Ben...
And another photo of Ben talking excitedly with the fake chemistry set in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't see that one. It's really good! You know that he used to be Sam's lab partner a long time ago?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's hard to see him being a nerd. If I didn't see him talk about it, I wouldn't have believed it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I snapped a great photo of him showing 'emotional strength' when he put his hand on your shoulder. Good job talking him up.
For the rest of the game, Owen manages to play solidly, encouraged by his teammates.
Twin Branches dominates Wilson High in the second half and wins the game handily.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: In everybody's faces!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: We won! Wooohooo!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're going to Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's official. I'm a jock now!
At midcourt, Owen meets Ben!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for the show of support, Captain!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No trouble. No trouble at all.
At a large table near the wall is an enormous display of snacks surrounding an emerald bowl brimming with salsa.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Awesome! Time to get my grub on!
Paige flashes Owen a smile as Jacob rushes over to the bowl.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Use the tongs!
Jacob hesitantly picks up a bright pair of tongs.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Why are they so sparkly?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...A baseball stadium! Since you guys are still sweaty and gross from the game, you're right in theme with sports!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We took showers after the game, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lucky for you, your natural odors are offensive enough to pass as disgusting.
Just then a couple of girls walk by wearing cheerleader outfits.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, guys! See you in the hot tub later!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I `love` this theme!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] this theme!

nodes.text: Paige smiles at Owen and gives him a playful punch on the arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Truth or glare! I'm sure you've all heard of it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When it's your turn, you either say something truthful about yourself or you glare really hard at--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you mean truth or dare?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh... Oh yeah! Ha! Just a joke! Truth or `dare!` Get ready for it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh... Oh yeah! Ha! Just a joke! Truth or [color=#3b78e2][i]dare![/i][/color] Get ready for it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Enjoy the party!
Paige whispers to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks for the save.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you know what he's apologizing for? Maybe he said something cruel and mean.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... What are you sorry `for,` Ben?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... What are you sorry [color=#3b78e2][i]for,[/i][/color] Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry for everything I said back when we were at my dad's place. I didn't mean it.
They fly up to it and see Paige brushing her hair at her vanity table.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: This is it! The third floor, fifth window!

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The third floor, first window!
They fly up to it and find one of the maids calmly stuffing some of the silver as she clears away the remains of a lavish breakfast buffet.

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: We got the wrong window!
He starts to fly away, but stops when Sowphelia doesn't move.

nodes.speaker: Sowphelia
nodes.text: The maid's stealing the silver! Should we do something?

nodes.speaker: Hamlet
nodes.text: It's not our job. Our job is getting Paige and Owen to kiss!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did I hear you right? We're going to a chocolate shop?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You heard correctly...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Remember? No flipping out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry! You can't suppress instinct.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did I hear you right? We're going to a fancy restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe... But first we're going to a chocolate shop.
He sees Sam ducking into a big building with a heart-shaped foyer!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes! Glad I kept up enough to see what building she went into. I might have lost her!
He follows in after her!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: So his eyes are the focal points of both photos?
Mr. Vanderwall processes her words and nods thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: The eyes are the windows to the soul... And in both cases, they capture such `focus`...
nodes.text_bbcode: The eyes are the windows to the soul... And in both cases, they capture such [color=#e23b3b][i]focus[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's exactly it!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: So the beaker and his eyes are the focal points of both photos?
Mr. Vanderwall tilts his head to the side quizzically...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean to say he has excellent scientific faculties? That's hardly `deep`, insightful, or thoughtful...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean to say he has excellent scientific faculties? That's hardly [color=#e23b3b][i]deep[/i][/color], insightful, or thoughtful...

nodes.text: Owen walks confidently through the gallery towards them.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Here he is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You must be the important person Autumn wanted me to meet.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Owen, this is Mr. Vanderwall. Mr. Vanderwall, this is Owen.
Owen shakes his hand firmly and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I can see Autumn did your photos justice. You are a pillar of strength.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That is my nickname on the football team...
Vanderwall stares at him, then laughs.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Indeed, it is. Well, I have seen enough.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I was happy to do it. $ZOE's helping me keep an eye out for Paige, so I was happy to help.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I'd better get back to $ZOE. I don't want her to wait alone.
He walks out the doors.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Waiting for Paige?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Poor $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And judging from all the photos I've seen and all the insights you've given me, I see that you are a talented, skilled, and gifted artist!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Those are all synonyms that I like!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Your grasp of your subjects and the medium is very thorough.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And judging from all the photos I've seen and all the insights you've given me, I see that you are a talented, skilled, and gifted artist!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Those are all synonyms that I like!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Your grasp of your subjects and the medium is very thorough.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And judging from all the photos I've seen and all the insights you've given me, I see that you are a strong, but growing artist.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: 'Growing'?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Not all your answers impressed me, but with time, you shall develop the skill and vocabulary necessary to become a `true` master of the arts.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not all your answers impressed me, but with time, you shall develop the skill and vocabulary necessary to become a [color=#e23b3b][i]true[/i][/color] master of the arts.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And judging from all the photos I've seen and all the insights you've given me, I see that you are a strong, but growing artist.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: 'Growing'?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Not all your answers impressed me, but with time, you shall develop the skill and vocabulary necessary to become a `true` master of the arts.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not all your answers impressed me, but with time, you shall develop the skill and vocabulary necessary to become a [color=#e23b3b][i]true[/i][/color] master of the arts.

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
$ZOE is outside with Owen, waiting for Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Any news?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Still nothing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You must really like her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe he cares so much about Paige... I thought that we might have had something...
For a moment, $ZOE considers bringing it up...
And that's when they hear a crash from inside!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What... What was that?
$ZOE doesn't answer. She just turns and runs into the gallery...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ugh. Why am I so tired? I feel like I swam forever...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: We'll talk about this later! I promise! I've gotta go!
Ben's father gestures to the cab driver, and the cab drives off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great... You promised.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: We'll talk about this later! I promise! I've gotta go!
Ben's father gestures to the cab driver, and the cab drives off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great... You promised.
At the end of the first half, Twin Branches is down by twelve points!
At the end of the first half, Twin Branches is down by only four points!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's okay!
Ben claps his hands!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We got this! Don't worry about it, Erik! You'll get him next time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! Thanks, Ben! I'll get him next time!
Coach nods at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Good.
By the end of the third quarter, Twin Branches is down by more than twenty points!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Coach, put me back in!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You've gotta be kidding me, Kale! You're the biggest reason we're in this mess!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you're benching me?!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Yeah! That means sit down and shut up!
Ben reluctantly sits down and shuts up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I lost the game for us...
As the clock ticks down, Ben leans forward and puts his head in his hands, unable to watch the game anymore...
And unable to shake the realization that...
As the third quarter comes to a close, Twin Branches is ahead by seven!
As the third quarter comes to a close, Twin Branches is down by six!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
